civil79-ud04ac24864304ecfec-1.text: In accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and Federal Law No. 58-ФЗ of 27 May 2003 ‘On the System of State Service of the Russian Federation’ (hereinafter the Federal Law ‘On the System of State Service of the Russian Federation’), this Federal Law establishes the legal, organizational, financial and economic foundations of the state civil service of the Russian Federation.

civil79-uec09ae9a3e479fa7e3-1.text: For the purposes of this Federal Law, the terms used mean:

civil79-ufcda59d9e710027cb7-1.text: 1) state offices of the Russian Federation and state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also state offices): offices established by the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws for the direct exercise of the powers of federal state bodies and public authorities of a federal territory, and offices established by constitutions (charters) and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for the direct exercise of the powers of state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;

civil79-ud8c05b8e5f404d4b61-1.text: 2) employer's representative: the head of a federal state body, a public authority of a federal territory or a state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a person holding a state office, or a representative of such head or person, exercising the employer's powers on behalf of the Russian Federation, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a federal territory;

civil79-u980047b852c72bf17f-1.text: 3) professional level: the level of knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties possessed by a citizen seeking a position in the federal state civil service or the state civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a federal state civil servant or a state civil servant of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also a civil servant);

civil79-uaad53f7b4a4352e5c8-1.text: 4) assessment of professional level: determination of the level of knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties possessed by a citizen seeking a position in the state civil service of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also a civil service position) or by a civil servant;

civil79-uc893557efca57f0823-1.text: 5) field of professional service activity: the set of tasks, powers and functions of federal state bodies, public authorities of a federal territory and state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter state bodies), and of persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation or of its constituent entities, towards whose implementation the performance of civil servants' official duties is directed;

civil79-u0f8fb0f06a6b186848-1.text: 6) type of professional service activity: specialization in particular tasks, powers and functions of a state body within a civil servant's field of professional service activity.

civil79-u0fd35f8fd6facf93e6-1.text: Article 2. Subject matter regulated by this Federal Law
civil79-u0fd35f8fd6facf93e6-1.locator: Article 2. Subject matter regulated by this Federal Law

civil79-ubeb204ca6b9cfb1ddb-1.text: This Federal Law regulates relations connected with entry into, performance and termination of the state civil service of the Russian Federation and with determination of the legal position (status) of a civil servant.
civil79-ubeb204ca6b9cfb1ddb-1.locator: Article 2. Subject matter regulated by this Federal Law

civil79-u484ac394b3e3ac0a3f-1.text: Article 3. State civil service of the Russian Federation
civil79-u484ac394b3e3ac0a3f-1.locator: Article 3. State civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u5e2402133a7af08b51-1.text: 1. The state civil service of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also the civil service) is a type of state service consisting of the professional service activity of citizens of the Russian Federation (hereinafter citizens) in civil service positions to support the exercise of the powers of state bodies, persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation and persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u5e2402133a7af08b51-1.locator: Article 3. State civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u69a2c6ab1c513e2d7f-1.text: 2. The state civil service of the Russian Federation is divided into the federal state civil service (hereinafter also the federal civil service) and the state civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also the civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation).
civil79-u69a2c6ab1c513e2d7f-1.locator: Article 3. State civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-ufa7845752825ddcc5b-1.text: Article 4. Principles of the civil service
civil79-ufa7845752825ddcc5b-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service

civil79-ue094ef30bbda9ab40d-1.text: The principles of the civil service are:
civil79-ue094ef30bbda9ab40d-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service

civil79-u0e238a6a32724c827c-1.text: 1) priority of human and civil rights and freedoms;
civil79-u0e238a6a32724c827c-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service

civil79-uc8dd4b9789683695e7-1.text: 2) unity of the legal and organizational foundations of the federal civil service and the civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
civil79-uc8dd4b9789683695e7-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service

civil79-ua0dacab3f155ca0401-1.text: 3) equal access to the civil service for citizens who know the state language of the Russian Federation and equal conditions of service regardless of sex, race, ethnicity, origin, property or official status, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, membership of public associations or other circumstances unrelated to a civil servant's professional qualities;
civil79-ua0dacab3f155ca0401-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service

civil79-u58f7174d75b7fc664f-1.text: 4) professionalism and competence of civil servants;
civil79-u58f7174d75b7fc664f-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service

civil79-ufbf7d2e701ce92a36a-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service

civil79-uac882a846b004aa0ab-1.text: 6) accessibility of information about the civil service;
civil79-uac882a846b004aa0ab-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service

civil79-u64c3d60f5962445f4e-1.text: 7) interaction with public associations and citizens;
civil79-u64c3d60f5962445f4e-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service

civil79-ub585b1360b8265ddd3-1.text: 8) protection of civil servants against unlawful interference in their professional service activity.
civil79-ub585b1360b8265ddd3-1.locator: Article 4. Principles of the civil service

civil79-u092ed7b2fe9eb0283d-1.text: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
civil79-u092ed7b2fe9eb0283d-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u9fd2b77cc28edd2ba4-1.text: 1. Relations connected with the civil service are regulated by:
civil79-u9fd2b77cc28edd2ba4-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u842d198106e8eb40c0-1.text: 1) the Constitution of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u842d198106e8eb40c0-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u4340932cee1ebaeb7b-1.text: 2) the Federal Law ‘On the System of State Service of the Russian Federation’;
civil79-u4340932cee1ebaeb7b-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-ud0b9f77042da4d8b02-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u7d420de1ce5e706e60-1.text: 4) other federal laws, including federal laws regulating specific features of civil service;
civil79-u7d420de1ce5e706e60-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-ue2045411556b3645df-1.text: 5) decrees of the President of the Russian Federation;
civil79-ue2045411556b3645df-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-ua03177ed753cb2c31b-1.text: 6) resolutions of the Government of the Russian Federation;
civil79-ua03177ed753cb2c31b-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-ub972c92eba31ea0f2e-1.text: 7) normative legal acts of federal executive bodies;
civil79-ub972c92eba31ea0f2e-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u94f0521de3da9d1aed-1.text: 8) constitutions (charters), laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u94f0521de3da9d1aed-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u5b823135dc4e2c6cb5-1.text: 9) normative legal acts of state bodies;
civil79-u5b823135dc4e2c6cb5-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u5324bc85695530d2e8-1.text: 10) normative legal acts of public authorities of federal territories.
civil79-u5324bc85695530d2e8-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u1da0707896d388d0c8-1.text: 2. If an international treaty of the Russian Federation establishes rules different from those provided for by this Federal Law, the rules of the international treaty apply.
civil79-u1da0707896d388d0c8-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u5abaad1be8dbc13e90-1.text: 3. Decisions of interstate bodies adopted on the basis of provisions of international treaties of the Russian Federation interpreted in a manner contrary to the Constitution of the Russian Federation are not enforceable in the Russian Federation. Such a contradiction may be established in the manner determined by federal constitutional law.
civil79-u5abaad1be8dbc13e90-1.locator: Article 5. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-ud6512ba5ba9a0d3d83-1.text: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation
civil79-ud6512ba5ba9a0d3d83-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation

civil79-ue7cbac56b778fb38dd-1.text: The relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation is ensured on the basis of the unity of the state service system of the Russian Federation and the principles of its structure and operation, and through:
civil79-ue7cbac56b778fb38dd-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u0a0ffdec5deab251c7-1.text: 1) comparability of the basic conditions and levels of remuneration and basic state social guarantees;
civil79-u0a0ffdec5deab251c7-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u73ebaa37126cee9043-1.text: 2) establishment of restrictions and obligations in the performance of different types of state service of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u73ebaa37126cee9043-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u1cc2542c7a7a9c6bcd-1.text: 3) taking account of service in other types of state service of the Russian Federation when calculating civil service length;
civil79-u1cc2542c7a7a9c6bcd-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u686cf7d30e9bee1e18-1.text: 4) comparability of the basic conditions of state pension provision for citizens who have performed state service of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u686cf7d30e9bee1e18-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between the civil service and other types of state service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u9e7053f8d660809feb-1.text: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service
civil79-u9e7053f8d660809feb-1.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service

civil79-u4de1e67a2354e3f371-1.text: The relationship between the civil service and municipal service is ensured through:
civil79-u4de1e67a2354e3f371-1.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service

civil79-ue5d5a56db60297031b-1.text: 1) uniform basic qualification requirements for civil service and municipal service positions;
civil79-ue5d5a56db60297031b-1.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service

civil79-u4f947db89665c75994-1.text: 2) uniform restrictions and obligations in civil service and municipal service;
civil79-u4f947db89665c75994-1.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service

civil79-u9cf7c1bd82a1b90fa3-1.text: 3) uniform requirements for training personnel for the civil service and municipal service and for the professional development of civil servants and municipal servants;
civil79-u9cf7c1bd82a1b90fa3-1.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service

civil79-u7cb008488c112a7573-1.text: 4) taking account of municipal service length when calculating civil service length, and civil service length when calculating municipal service length;
civil79-u7cb008488c112a7573-1.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service

civil79-u5a5fe96414017b5cd9-1.text: 5) comparability of the basic conditions of remuneration and social guarantees for civil servants and municipal servants;
civil79-u5a5fe96414017b5cd9-1.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service

civil79-ufcaf6c4b73b3abf5d1-1.text: 6) comparability of the basic conditions of state pension provision for citizens who have performed civil service and citizens who have performed municipal service, and for their families in the event of loss of a breadwinner.
civil79-ufcaf6c4b73b3abf5d1-1.locator: Article 7. Relationship between the civil service and municipal service

civil79-u65bf22f3dbe49f71d8-1.text: Positions in the federal state civil service are established by federal law or a decree of the President of the Russian Federation; positions in the state civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are established by laws or other normative legal acts of those constituent entities, taking account of this Federal Law, to support the exercise of the powers of a state body or a person holding a state office.

civil79-u4d775e315795606208-1.text: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
civil79-u4d775e315795606208-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-u58f26cb3441ceb90cc-1.text: 1. Civil service positions are divided into categories and groups.
civil79-u58f26cb3441ceb90cc-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-u11352133b652ae3066-1.text: 2. Civil service positions are divided into the following categories:
civil79-u11352133b652ae3066-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-u2ef8e843c722cecb30-1.text: 1) managers: positions of heads and deputy heads of state bodies and their structural subdivisions (hereinafter also subdivisions), heads and deputy heads of territorial bodies of federal executive bodies and their structural subdivisions, and heads and deputy heads of representative offices of state bodies and their structural subdivisions, held for a fixed term of office or without a limitation on the term of office;
civil79-u2ef8e843c722cecb30-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-ub277e59d9d8863280e-1.text: 2) assistants (advisers): positions established to assist persons holding state offices, heads of state bodies, heads of territorial bodies of federal executive bodies and heads of representative offices of state bodies in exercising their powers, and held for a fixed period limited by the term of office of those persons or heads;
civil79-ub277e59d9d8863280e-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-ufca40697a1d7b9f315-1.text: 3) specialists: positions established to provide professional support for the performance of the assigned tasks and functions of state bodies and held without a limitation on the term of office;
civil79-ufca40697a1d7b9f315-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-uf36098abda1a665aef-1.text: 4) support specialists: positions established to provide organizational, information, documentation, financial and economic, administrative and other support for the activities of state bodies and held without a limitation on the term of office.
civil79-uf36098abda1a665aef-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-ub77354cbe7e146f8b2-1.text: 3. Civil service positions are divided into the following groups:
civil79-ub77354cbe7e146f8b2-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-uf5706e5bb5fc4d7012-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-u6a83f088a682a21848-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-u3b5abfdd2132526455-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-u04877996d1021f1522-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-u7e3c2f629dbbb2eb29-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-u7aa1fa1101484a234b-1.text: 4. Positions in the categories ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ are divided into the highest, principal and leading groups of civil service positions.
civil79-u7aa1fa1101484a234b-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-uf6b0cbaeafab2aae06-1.text: 5. Positions in the category ‘specialists’ are divided into the highest, principal, leading and senior groups of civil service positions.
civil79-uf6b0cbaeafab2aae06-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-u8016aeac306cd9846d-1.text: 6. Positions in the category ‘support specialists’ are divided into the principal, leading, senior and junior groups of civil service positions.
civil79-u8016aeac306cd9846d-1.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions

civil79-u3f63711dc3f7d40749-1.text: Article 10. Registers of state civil service positions of the Russian Federation
civil79-u3f63711dc3f7d40749-1.locator: Article 10. Registers of state civil service positions of the Russian Federation

civil79-uf4caac8c417873d80c-1.text: 1. Federal state civil service positions, classified by state body, category, group and other criteria, form lists of federal state civil service positions constituting the corresponding sections of the Register of Federal State Civil Service Positions. The Register of Federal State Civil Service Positions is approved by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-uf4caac8c417873d80c-1.locator: Article 10. Registers of state civil service positions of the Russian Federation

civil79-uae365d6ee19db855b9-1.text: 2. State civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in its state bodies, established with regard to the structure of those bodies and classified by categories and groups of positions in accordance with Article 9 of this Federal Law, form lists of state civil service positions of that constituent entity constituting the corresponding sections of its register of state civil service positions. The register of state civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is compiled with regard to the principles used to structure the Register of Federal State Civil Service Positions and approved by a law or other normative legal act of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
civil79-uae365d6ee19db855b9-1.locator: Article 10. Registers of state civil service positions of the Russian Federation

civil79-u4a38f26f76d7885a9e-1.locator: Article 10. Registers of state civil service positions of the Russian Federation

civil79-uf94020c8a5f733040e-1.text: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
civil79-uf94020c8a5f733040e-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-ue03475c796e8d5c768-1.text: 1. A federal civil servant is awarded a class rank of the state civil service of the Russian Federation (hereinafter a civil service class rank of the Russian Federation), a justice class rank or a diplomatic rank. A civil servant of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is awarded a civil service class rank of that constituent entity.
civil79-ue03475c796e8d5c768-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-ufb98cf439f36c61873-1.text: 2. Civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation are awarded to federal civil servants holding civil service positions for which the award of justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks is not provided.
civil79-ufb98cf439f36c61873-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u20d8097c354201091f-1.text: 3. Justice class ranks are awarded to federal civil servants holding civil service positions for which legal education is a qualification requirement, in federal state bodies designated by the President of the Russian Federation and their territorial bodies (bodies), and in the staff offices of federal courts.
civil79-u20d8097c354201091f-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u34d806e608f09704c7-1.text: 4. Diplomatic ranks are awarded to federal civil servants in accordance with Federal Law No. 205-ФЗ of 27 July 2010 ‘On Specific Features of Federal State Civil Service in the System of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation’.
civil79-u34d806e608f09704c7-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u57459e7cdac5dc6455-1.text: 5. Class ranks — civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation, civil service class ranks of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and justice class ranks — are awarded to civil servants individually, in sequence, in accordance with the civil service position held and with regard to their professional level and length of civil service in the preceding class rank and in the civil service position held.
civil79-u57459e7cdac5dc6455-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u9abd796bab9ede86e3-1.text: 6. Federal civil servants holding positions in the highest group (except those awarded diplomatic ranks) are awarded the civil service class rank of the Russian Federation of Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3, or the justice class rank of Active State Councillor of Justice of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3. Civil servants holding positions in the highest group of the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are awarded the civil service class rank of that constituent entity of Active State Councillor of the Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3.
civil79-u9abd796bab9ede86e3-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u0794e35cbf22dd6b8c-1.text: 7. Federal civil servants holding positions in the principal group (except those awarded diplomatic ranks) are awarded the civil service class rank of the Russian Federation of State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3, or the justice class rank of State Councillor of Justice of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3. Civil servants holding positions in the principal group of the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are awarded the civil service class rank of that constituent entity of State Councillor of the Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3.
civil79-u0794e35cbf22dd6b8c-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u0afd33a82acfceacb9-1.text: 8. Federal civil servants holding positions in the leading group (except those awarded diplomatic ranks) are awarded the civil service class rank of the Russian Federation of Councillor of the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3, or the justice class rank of Councillor of Justice, class 1, 2 or 3. Civil servants holding positions in the leading group of the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are awarded the civil service class rank of that constituent entity of Councillor of the State Civil Service of the Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3.
civil79-u0afd33a82acfceacb9-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-ufdbbe15ea7bea6618b-1.text: 9. Federal civil servants holding positions in the senior group (except those awarded diplomatic ranks) are awarded the civil service class rank of the Russian Federation of Referent of the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3, or the justice class rank of Lawyer, class 1, 2 or 3. Civil servants holding positions in the senior group of the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are awarded the civil service class rank of that constituent entity of Referent of the State Civil Service of the Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3.
civil79-ufdbbe15ea7bea6618b-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-uaecbc33ae31060070b-1.text: 10. Federal civil servants holding positions in the junior group are awarded the civil service class rank of the Russian Federation of Secretary of the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3. Civil servants holding positions in the junior group of the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are awarded the civil service class rank of that constituent entity of Secretary of the State Civil Service of the Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3.
civil79-uaecbc33ae31060070b-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u1587399927e33bc15c-1.text: 11. The civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation of Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 1, Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 2, and Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 3, and the justice class ranks of Active State Councillor of Justice of the Russian Federation, class 1, Active State Councillor of Justice of the Russian Federation, class 2, and Active State Councillor of Justice of the Russian Federation, class 3, are awarded by the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u1587399927e33bc15c-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-ub2ff15b588c91b4f8a-1.text: 12. In federal executive bodies, the civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation of State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 1, State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 2, and State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 3, are awarded by the Government of the Russian Federation. In other federal state bodies and public authorities of a federal territory, those class ranks are awarded by the head of the respective body.
civil79-ub2ff15b588c91b4f8a-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u08acb033c5f9cebe9f-1.text: 13. The civil service class ranks provided for by parts 8–10 of this Article are awarded by the employer's representative.
civil79-u08acb033c5f9cebe9f-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-uf3a91f21cd3e8fef80-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-ud992b64a87bd301aed-1.text: 15. As an incentive for exceptional distinction in the civil service, a civil service class rank of the Russian Federation or a justice class rank may be awarded to a federal civil servant:
civil79-ud992b64a87bd301aed-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-ud6ee47f9dd1b964047-1.text: 1) before expiry of the period established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation for service in the relevant class rank, but no earlier than six months after taking up the civil service position held, at a rank no higher than that corresponding to that civil service position;
civil79-ud6ee47f9dd1b964047-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-uabf74b141aa7d11988-1.text: 2) after expiry of the period established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation for service in the relevant class rank, at one step above the class rank corresponding to the civil service position held, within the group of positions to which that position belongs.
civil79-uabf74b141aa7d11988-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u19f87bc9bec84a9f25-1.text: 16. The procedure for awarding and retaining civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation for federal civil servants, the correlation between civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation, military and special ranks, justice class ranks and prosecutorial class ranks, and the correspondence between civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation and federal civil service positions in the highest group are established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u19f87bc9bec84a9f25-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u3155cf8f4e4b6f6951-1.text: 17. The correspondence between civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation and federal civil service positions in the principal, leading, senior and junior groups in federal executive bodies is established by a resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation. In other federal state bodies and public authorities of a federal territory, that correspondence is established by legal acts of those bodies.
civil79-u3155cf8f4e4b6f6951-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u1a9e3e887f6e129936-1.text: 18. The procedure for awarding and retaining justice class ranks for federal civil servants, and the correspondence between justice class ranks and federal civil service positions, are established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u1a9e3e887f6e129936-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-u74ec92b00b6025f7a2-1.text: 19. The procedure for awarding and retaining civil service class ranks of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and their correspondence to civil service positions of that constituent entity, are established by a law of the constituent entity, taking account of the provisions of this Article.
civil79-u74ec92b00b6025f7a2-1.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks

civil79-ud14353e44edbe2f32e-1.text: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
civil79-ud14353e44edbe2f32e-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-u501e110355d687794f-1.text: 1. Holding a civil service position requires compliance with qualification requirements concerning the level of professional education, length of civil service or work in a specialty or field of training, and professional level, and, where the employer's representative has made a corresponding decision, the specialty or field of training (broader groups of specialties and fields of training) and the qualification obtained by completing an additional professional retraining programme.
civil79-u501e110355d687794f-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-u5c1aca23df55a81821-1.text: 2. Qualification requirements for civil service positions are established in accordance with the categories and groups of civil service positions and the field and type of a civil servant's professional service activity.
civil79-u5c1aca23df55a81821-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-u0c8f5d9503ebd5b902-1.text: 3. Holding positions in the ‘managers’, ‘assistants (advisers)’ and ‘specialists’ categories of the highest and principal groups of civil service positions requires higher education at no less than specialist degree or master's degree level.
civil79-u0c8f5d9503ebd5b902-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-uee9d0396df348842cf-1.text: 4. Higher education is mandatory for positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories of the leading group, the ‘specialists’ category of the leading and senior groups, and the ‘support specialists’ category of the principal and leading groups of civil service positions.
civil79-uee9d0396df348842cf-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-u95518dfe5e8f2380ef-1.text: 5. Professional education is mandatory for positions in the ‘support specialists’ category of the senior and junior groups of civil service positions.
civil79-u95518dfe5e8f2380ef-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-u083aa02c3404c77d03-1.text: 6. Qualification requirements for the length of civil service or work in a specialty or field of training necessary to hold federal civil service positions are established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation; those for civil service positions of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are established by laws of the constituent entities.
civil79-u083aa02c3404c77d03-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-u45a75cc7f91b1e9ede-1.text: 7. Qualification requirements concerning professional level are established by a civil servant's official duties regulations according to the category and group of the civil service position and the field and type of professional service activity. A civil servant's official duties regulations (hereinafter official duties regulations) may also prescribe qualification requirements concerning the specialty or field of training (broader groups of specialties and fields of training) and the qualification obtained through an additional professional retraining programme necessary to hold the civil service position.
civil79-u45a75cc7f91b1e9ede-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-ub25355366cc24be75b-1.text: 8. To provide methodological assistance to state bodies, the federal state body responsible for managing state service compiles a reference guide to qualification requirements concerning specialties, fields of training (broader groups of specialties and fields of training) and professional level necessary to hold civil service positions, with regard to the field and type of civil servants' professional service activity.
civil79-ub25355366cc24be75b-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-u681a370386fd6a527a-1.text: 9. Unless otherwise established by this Federal Law, compliance of a citizen seeking a civil service position or a civil servant with the qualification requirements for that position is checked by the state body's subdivision responsible for state service and personnel (hereinafter also the state body's personnel service).
civil79-u681a370386fd6a527a-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-ue7e880996fb4e8ff7d-1.text: 10. To check whether a citizen seeking a civil service position or a civil servant meets the qualification requirements concerning professional level, the state body's personnel service assesses that citizen's or civil servant's professional level for the position. The assessment uses methods not contrary to federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, with the participation of the state body's subdivision in which the position is established. By decision of the head of the state body or a person authorized by that head, scientific, educational and other organizations specializing in the relevant fields and types of civil servants' professional service activity or in personnel technologies and civil service matters, and their representatives, may be involved in the assessment.
civil79-ue7e880996fb4e8ff7d-1.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions

civil79-u01a08ca87bb85874bf-1.text: Chapter 3. LEGAL POSITION (STATUS) OF A CIVIL SERVANT
civil79-u01a08ca87bb85874bf-1.locator: Chapter 3. LEGAL POSITION (STATUS) OF A CIVIL SERVANT

civil79-u86de2d238dff87a7d4-1.text: A civil servant is a citizen of the Russian Federation who has undertaken obligations to perform civil service. A civil servant carries out professional service activity in a civil service position in accordance with an act of appointment and a service contract, and receives monetary remuneration funded by the federal budget, the budget of the Sirius federal territory taking account of Article 47 of Federal Law No. 437-ФЗ of 22 December 2020 ‘On the Sirius Federal Territory’, or the budget of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.

civil79-u8514ecffa396770dfa-1.text: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
civil79-u8514ecffa396770dfa-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-uc453a917836e24290c-1.text: 1. A civil servant has the right to:
civil79-uc453a917836e24290c-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u28ec39ab46e2301253-1.text: 1) provision of proper organizational and technical conditions necessary for performing official duties;
civil79-u28ec39ab46e2301253-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-uccfe13915b7839fef7-1.text: 2) access to the official duties regulations and other documents defining their rights and duties in the civil service position held, criteria for evaluating the efficiency of performance of official duties, indicators of the effectiveness of professional service activity and conditions for career advancement;
civil79-uccfe13915b7839fef7-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-uc6efd6abaf5e0527d8-1.text: 3) rest, secured through normal working hours, days off and nonworking public holidays, and annual paid basic and additional leave;
civil79-uc6efd6abaf5e0527d8-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u94096006107e24b745-1.text: 4) remuneration and other payments in accordance with this Federal Law, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and the service contract;
civil79-u94096006107e24b745-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u1d2de1f2f5dde21977-1.text: 5) receipt, in the prescribed manner, of information and materials necessary to perform official duties, and submission of proposals to improve the state body's activities;
civil79-u1d2de1f2f5dde21977-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u7c624bf3b174413f28-1.text: 6) access, in the prescribed manner, to information constituting state secrets if the performance of official duties involves the use of such information;
civil79-u7c624bf3b174413f28-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u77a6232645be6e397c-1.text: 7) access, in the prescribed manner, to state bodies, local self-government bodies, public associations and other organizations in connection with the performance of official duties;
civil79-u77a6232645be6e397c-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-ub1cfa59b918b9d99d9-1.text: 8) access to appraisals of their professional service activity and other documents before inclusion in their personnel file, access to personnel file materials, and inclusion of their written explanations and other documents and materials in that file;
civil79-ub1cfa59b918b9d99d9-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u967d579af08d4e972e-1.text: 9) protection of information about the civil servant;
civil79-u967d579af08d4e972e-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u4179c985ef76b16c25-1.text: 10) career advancement on a competitive basis;
civil79-u4179c985ef76b16c25-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u5ae3fd1e8edc75912a-1.text: 11) professional development in the manner established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
civil79-u5ae3fd1e8edc75912a-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-uf6df3dc50042f6c0ee-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-ucbd576f91b98afe1a8-1.text: 13) consideration of individual service disputes in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws;
civil79-ucbd576f91b98afe1a8-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-ub0e375fe5ae06850fd-1.text: 14) an internal service inquiry at their request;
civil79-ub0e375fe5ae06850fd-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u9846f6fb36df4d1b7a-1.text: 15) protection of their rights and lawful interests in the civil service, including judicial challenge of violations;
civil79-u9846f6fb36df4d1b7a-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-ua97dc28a3f1596c651-1.text: 16) medical insurance in accordance with this Federal Law and the federal law on medical insurance for state servants of the Russian Federation;
civil79-ua97dc28a3f1596c651-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u88f2524f520d3ae79a-1.text: 17) state protection of their life and health, the life and health of their family members, and their property;
civil79-u88f2524f520d3ae79a-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u2071194ff74853e6d3-1.text: 18) state pension provision in accordance with federal law.
civil79-u2071194ff74853e6d3-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-u52a7109babd7b2cc0f-1.text: 2. A civil servant may perform other paid work after prior notification of the employer's representative, provided this does not result in a conflict of interest.
civil79-u52a7109babd7b2cc0f-1.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant

civil79-ua652536aba29b3840c-1.text: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
civil79-ua652536aba29b3840c-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-uadffb30171f0077120-1.text: 1. A civil servant is obliged to:
civil79-uadffb30171f0077120-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u21256c5c0673a2199b-1.text: 1) observe the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, and the constitutions (charters), laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and ensure their implementation;
civil79-u21256c5c0673a2199b-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u2ae636c2b39dd0667e-1.text: 2) perform official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations;
civil79-u2ae636c2b39dd0667e-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u368f61de4bfa137445-1.text: 3) carry out instructions of the relevant managers issued within their powers established by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u368f61de4bfa137445-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-ua776b0112b031c2c44-1.text: 4) respect the rights and lawful interests of citizens and organizations when performing official duties;
civil79-ua776b0112b031c2c44-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u328acf174ddf264f8e-1.text: 5) observe the state body's service rules;
civil79-u328acf174ddf264f8e-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u016b92ac1e5be7ea24-1.text: 6) maintain the professional level necessary for proper performance of official duties;
civil79-u016b92ac1e5be7ea24-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-ufdde6d1d3ac4a0c4c6-1.text: 7) not disclose information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal law, or information learned in connection with the performance of official duties, including information concerning citizens' private lives or health or affecting their honour and dignity;
civil79-ufdde6d1d3ac4a0c4c6-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u298f449e100e1d6afe-1.text: 8) safeguard state property, including property provided for the performance of official duties;
civil79-u298f449e100e1d6afe-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u23fc2d056bae3a848a-1.text: 9) submit, in the prescribed manner, information about themselves and their family members required by federal law;
civil79-u23fc2d056bae3a848a-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u1ca7adca36d6761950-1.text: 10) notify the employer's representative in writing of termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation, acquisition of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign State, or receipt of a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen's right to permanent residence in a foreign State, on the day the civil servant learns of it, but no later than five working days after that termination, acquisition or receipt;
civil79-u1ca7adca36d6761950-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u27b1c0890005b38a19-1.text: 11) observe restrictions, fulfil obligations and requirements concerning official conduct, and not breach prohibitions established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
civil79-u27b1c0890005b38a19-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-uf8a6a2c50face6c67d-1.text: 12) notify the employer's representative of a personal interest in the performance of official duties that may lead to a conflict of interest, and take measures to prevent such a conflict;
civil79-uf8a6a2c50face6c67d-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u5af7b1f1353129157e-1.text: 13) notify the employer's representative in writing of changes that become known to the civil servant in the information in the questionnaire provided for by Article 20.3 of this Federal Law, except information changed by a decision of the employer's representative (hereinafter information contained in the questionnaire).
civil79-u5af7b1f1353129157e-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-uaf504c53a8b4ff02ef-1.text: 1.1. A civil servant must state monetary values in accordance with requirements established by federal laws and decrees of the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-uaf504c53a8b4ff02ef-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u6a7722742efc8167cd-1.text: 2. A civil servant may not carry out an unlawful instruction given to them. On receiving an instruction from the relevant manager which the civil servant considers unlawful, the civil servant must submit a written explanation of its unlawfulness, specifying the provisions of the legislation of the Russian Federation that may be violated by carrying it out, and obtain written confirmation of the instruction from the manager. If the manager confirms the instruction in writing, the civil servant must refuse to carry it out.
civil79-u6a7722742efc8167cd-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u6c10f6868b5d6856a6-1.text: 3. If a civil servant carries out an unlawful instruction, the civil servant and the manager who issued it bear disciplinary, civil, administrative or criminal liability in accordance with federal laws.
civil79-u6c10f6868b5d6856a6-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-ua4cca50f3b924aea15-1.text: 4. To exclude a conflict of interest in a state body, a civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ category of the highest group of civil service positions may not represent civil servants' interests in that state body's elected trade union body while holding that position.
civil79-ua4cca50f3b924aea15-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-u6690e2ce35dbd21867-1.text: 5. Civil servants are subject to compulsory state fingerprint registration and compulsory state genomic registration in the cases and in the manner established by federal laws.
civil79-u6690e2ce35dbd21867-1.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant

civil79-ua834a2cce8c35ccbef-1.text: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
civil79-ua834a2cce8c35ccbef-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u35091cb26da7f29566-1.text: 1. A civil servant may not remain in the civil service in the event of:
civil79-u35091cb26da7f29566-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u50ffb16d1c4b89e75c-1.text: 1) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court decision that has entered into legal force;
civil79-u50ffb16d1c4b89e75c-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-uda4fbc15daac8aa1a9-1.text: 2) being sentenced, by a court judgment that has entered into legal force, to a punishment precluding the performance of official duties in a state service (civil service) position, or having a conviction that has not been removed or expunged in the manner established by federal law;
civil79-uda4fbc15daac8aa1a9-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u05e3a423c003edd935-1.text: 3) refusal to undergo the procedure for obtaining access to information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal law, if the duties of the civil service position sought by the citizen or held by the civil servant involve use of such information;
civil79-u05e3a423c003edd935-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u1e60d47bf2553fa498-1.text: 4) an illness preventing entry into or performance of the civil service, confirmed by a medical organization's opinion. The procedure for medical examinations, the list of such illnesses and the form of the medical organization's opinion are established by a federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u1e60d47bf2553fa498-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-ua06bf1d5d897dc9dae-1.text: 5) close blood or marital relationship (parents, spouses, children, brothers, sisters, and the brothers, sisters, parents and children of spouses and spouses of children) with a civil servant, where holding the civil service position entails direct subordination or accountability of one to the other, except for civil service positions in executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorized in the field of forest relations in areas with low rural population density and in remote and hard-to-reach localities;
civil79-ua06bf1d5d897dc9dae-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u02a61550a71ad3a1b6-1.text: 6) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u02a61550a71ad3a1b6-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u4a25687ce2901d5e21-1.text: 7) possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign State, or a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen's right to permanent residence in a foreign State, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u4a25687ce2901d5e21-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-uebc37362e6fc5194bb-1.text: 8) submission, upon entry into and/or during civil service, of forged documents and/or knowingly false information purporting to confirm compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements whose violation precludes holding a civil service position, or failure to submit documents and/or information showing noncompliance with such restrictions, prohibitions and requirements;
civil79-uebc37362e6fc5194bb-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-ub09c844b5a1bc1bc4d-1.text: 9) failure to submit information on income, property and property-related obligations required by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’, and information on expenditure required by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’; submission of knowingly incomplete information, except in cases established by federal laws, or submission of knowingly inaccurate information;
civil79-ub09c844b5a1bc1bc4d-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u8d62aaf520dacd29ad-1.text: 10) loss of the employer's representative's trust in the civil servant for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or failure to perform duties established for combating corruption by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws;
civil79-u8d62aaf520dacd29ad-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-ubf2685b7b112d6aac6-1.text: 11) being found, in accordance with a conscription commission's opinion, not to have performed compulsory military service without lawful grounds (except citizens who performed military service under contract), for 10 years from expiry of the period for appealing that opinion to the conscription commission of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation; or, if that opinion and/or the decision of the constituent entity's conscription commission on the citizen's appeal against it were challenged in court, for 10 years from the entry into legal force of a court decision finding that the citizen's rights were not violated in issuing the opinion and/or the decision of the constituent entity's conscription commission on the appeal;
civil79-ubf2685b7b112d6aac6-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u4ff830d0531cf0178a-1.text: 12) failure to submit information provided for by Article 20.2 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u4ff830d0531cf0178a-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u681bd6954cae2b4e8c-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u792d9680115e714e85-1.text: 2. Restrictions connected with civil service other than those specified in part 1 of this Article are established by federal laws.
civil79-u792d9680115e714e85-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-u7e52abf438362db296-1.text: 3. Liability for failure to comply with the restrictions provided for by part 1 of this Article is established by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
civil79-u7e52abf438362db296-1.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service

civil79-uca3badb55fc7b168c9-1.text: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
civil79-uca3badb55fc7b168c9-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-uad0fcae6aef803ae68-1.text: 1. In connection with civil service, a civil servant is prohibited from:
civil79-uad0fcae6aef803ae68-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u7666b0df283da58249-1.text: 1) repealed from 1 January 2015. — Federal Law No. 431-ФЗ of 22.12.2014;
civil79-u7666b0df283da58249-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u9535cae58089d34ae2-1.text: 2) holding a civil service position in the event of:
civil79-u9535cae58089d34ae2-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u9e556037b0d6cd1581-1.text: а) election or appointment to a state office, except in the cases established by part two of Article 4 of Federal Constitutional Law No. 4-ФКЗ of 6 November 2020 ‘On the Government of the Russian Federation’ and part nine of Article 12 of Federal Law No. 437-ФЗ of 22 December 2020 ‘On the Sirius Federal Territory’;
civil79-u9e556037b0d6cd1581-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u870249a029d79219b9-1.text: б) election to an elected office in a local self-government body;
civil79-u870249a029d79219b9-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u971c3bbffa55b9e3bf-1.text: в) election to a paid elected office in a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body;
civil79-u971c3bbffa55b9e3bf-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u2574bb7f023ad451b4-1.text: 3) participating in the management of a commercial or nonprofit organization, except in the following cases:
civil79-u2574bb7f023ad451b4-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u61b75a52b14f5d41f3-1.text: а) unpaid participation in managing a political party or trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body; participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing-construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real-estate owners;
civil79-u61b75a52b14f5d41f3-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u526745c5da6699d3e3-1.text: б) unpaid participation in managing a nonprofit organization (other than participation in managing a political party or trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body, or participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing-construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real-estate owners), with permission from the employer's representative obtained in the manner established by a normative legal act of the state body;
civil79-u526745c5da6699d3e3-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-ube1044e7e9315d0f76-1.text: в) unpaid participation, as a member of its collegiate management body, in managing a commercial organization belonging to a state corporation, state company or public-law company, more than 50 per cent of whose shares (interests) are owned by that state corporation, state company or public-law company, in the manner established by normative legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation or of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation governing such participation, unless otherwise established by federal constitutional laws or federal laws;
civil79-ube1044e7e9315d0f76-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u349160feb1aaece196-1.text: г) unpaid membership of a collegiate body of a commercial or nonprofit organization on the basis of an act of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u349160feb1aaece196-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u846d94403aa5cb6889-1.text: д) unpaid representation of the interests of the Russian Federation, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a federal territory in the management bodies and audit commission of an organization whose founder (shareholder, participant) is the Russian Federation, a constituent entity or a federal territory, in accordance with normative legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation, of a constituent entity or of public authorities of a federal territory establishing the procedure for exercising the powers of an organization's founder on behalf of the Russian Federation, a constituent entity or a federal territory, or for managing shares (interests in charter capital) in federal ownership, ownership of a constituent entity or municipal ownership of a federal territory; or in accordance with normative legal acts of public authorities of a federal territory establishing the procedure for managing federally owned shares (interests in charter capital) in respect of which those public authorities exercise the owner's powers;
civil79-u846d94403aa5cb6889-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-ue589cde9e60fdfdea9-1.text: е) other cases provided for by international treaties of the Russian Federation or federal laws;
civil79-ue589cde9e60fdfdea9-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-udfbad3d2ed0897124c-1.text: 3.1) engaging in entrepreneurial activity personally or through trusted persons;
civil79-udfbad3d2ed0897124c-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-ucf826b3ab5fa42b417-1.text: 4) acquiring income-generating securities in cases established by federal law;
civil79-ucf826b3ab5fa42b417-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u12cb8e0ce785ce3df0-1.text: 5) acting as an attorney or representative in third parties' matters before the state body in which the civil servant holds a civil service position, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law or other federal laws;
civil79-u12cb8e0ce785ce3df0-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u4dad79509cb644f048-1.text: 6) receiving rewards from individuals or legal entities in connection with the performance of official duties (gifts, monetary rewards, loans, services, payment for entertainment, holidays or transport costs, and other rewards). Gifts received by a civil servant in connection with protocol events, official business trips and other official events are recognized as federal property or property of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, as appropriate, and are transferred by the civil servant under a transfer record to the state body in which they hold a civil service position, except in cases established by the Civil Code of the Russian Federation. A civil servant who has handed over a gift received in connection with a protocol event, official business trip or other official event may purchase it in the manner established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u4dad79509cb644f048-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u9186dcb3498d88c53d-1.text: 7) travelling outside the territory of the Russian Federation in connection with the performance of official duties at the expense of individuals or legal entities, except official business trips made in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation under agreements between state bodies of the Russian Federation, state bodies of its constituent entities or municipal bodies and state or municipal bodies of foreign States or international or foreign organizations;
civil79-u9186dcb3498d88c53d-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u3c61c76a8924d9f534-1.text: 8) using material, technical and other support resources or other state property for purposes unrelated to official duties, or transferring them to other persons;
civil79-u3c61c76a8924d9f534-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-ua19c4610cf192d748f-1.text: 9) disclosing or using for purposes unrelated to civil service information classified as confidential under federal law, or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties;
civil79-ua19c4610cf192d748f-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u1a397e6a1074ae2867-1.text: 10) making public statements, judgments or assessments, including through the mass media, concerning the activities of state bodies and their heads, including decisions of a superior state body or the state body in which the civil servant holds a civil service position, unless this forms part of the civil servant's official duties;
civil79-u1a397e6a1074ae2867-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-ue55e54e645816d9b31-1.text: 11) accepting, without written permission from the employer's representative, awards or honorary and special titles (except academic titles) from foreign States, international organizations, political parties, other public associations or religious associations, if the civil servant's official duties include interaction with those organizations and associations;
civil79-ue55e54e645816d9b31-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-uac80120a134166c2ee-1.text: 12) using the advantages of official position for election campaigning or campaigning on referendum issues;
civil79-uac80120a134166c2ee-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u7264b103ced68b44f5-1.text: 13) using official powers in the interests of political parties, other public associations, religious associations or other organizations, or publicly expressing an attitude towards them in the capacity of a civil servant, unless this forms part of official duties;
civil79-u7264b103ced68b44f5-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-ud41d6230e612fd234a-1.text: 14) establishing within state bodies structures of political parties, other public associations (except trade unions, veterans' bodies and other bodies of public initiative) or religious associations, or assisting their establishment;
civil79-ud41d6230e612fd234a-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u1bac64d5c24e037ab2-1.text: 15) ceasing to perform official duties for the purpose of settling a service dispute;
civil79-u1bac64d5c24e037ab2-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u03d321897b3fe8ed9d-1.text: 16) membership of management bodies, boards of trustees or supervisory boards, or other bodies of foreign nonprofit nongovernmental organizations and their structural subdivisions operating in the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty or the legislation of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u03d321897b3fe8ed9d-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-ua57084c169076b18d9-1.text: 17) engaging, without written permission from the employer's representative, in paid activity financed exclusively by foreign States, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens or stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty or the legislation of the Russian Federation.
civil79-ua57084c169076b18d9-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-ud49a40622d96206fa9-1.text: 1.1. A civil servant, their spouse and minor children are prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits), keeping cash and valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or owning and/or using foreign financial instruments in the cases provided for by the Federal Law ‘On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments’. The term ‘foreign financial instruments’ is used in this Federal Law in the meaning defined by that Federal Law.
civil79-ud49a40622d96206fa9-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u2dcf3516c54bcfa6a1-1.text: 2. If a civil servant's ownership of securities (participating interests or shares in organizations' charter or pooled capital) causes or may cause a conflict of interest, the civil servant must transfer those securities (participating interests or shares in organizations' charter or pooled capital) into trust management in accordance with the civil legislation of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u2dcf3516c54bcfa6a1-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u1975326b4a87f51ca4-1.text: 3. After dismissal from the civil service, a citizen may not disclose or use in the interests of organizations or individuals confidential or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties.
civil79-u1975326b4a87f51ca4-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-ud55e02ca27243c6f82-1.text: 3.1. A citizen who held a civil service position included in a list established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation may not, for two years after dismissal from the civil service, without the consent of the relevant commission on compliance with civil servants' official conduct requirements and resolution of conflicts of interest, hold positions in an organization under an employment contract and/or perform work for or provide services to that organization under a civil-law contract or contracts, in the cases provided for by federal laws, if certain state-administration functions concerning that organization formed part of the civil servant's official (service) duties. The commission's consent is given in the manner established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation. Its consent is not required where the citizen is appointed to that organization by decision of the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-ud55e02ca27243c6f82-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-ue078b80ded3ad240f8-1.text: 4. Liability for failure to comply with the prohibitions in this Article is established by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
civil79-ue078b80ded3ad240f8-1.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service

civil79-u55f1f823f9da908167-1.text: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
civil79-u55f1f823f9da908167-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-uadffb30171f0077120-2.text: 1. A civil servant is obliged to:
civil79-uadffb30171f0077120-2.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-u276f093b752ab2df76-1.text: 1) perform official duties conscientiously and to a high professional standard;
civil79-u276f093b752ab2df76-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-u46487beaa30a343b72-1.text: 2) proceed from the principle that recognition, observance and protection of human and civil rights and freedoms determine the meaning and content of their professional service activity;
civil79-u46487beaa30a343b72-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-u78021471adfea0d89c-1.text: 3) carry out professional service activity within the state body's competence established by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u78021471adfea0d89c-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-ucaef5c4ce09d92e6ed-1.text: 4) ensure equal and impartial treatment of all individuals and legal entities, give no preference to any public or religious association, professional or social group, citizen or organization, and avoid bias towards such associations, groups, citizens and organizations;
civil79-ucaef5c4ce09d92e6ed-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-u468ef8c47c4002ddb4-1.text: 5) refrain from actions influenced by any personal, property-related (financial) or other interests that obstruct conscientious performance of official duties;
civil79-u468ef8c47c4002ddb4-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-uff020a8638ac230c4e-1.text: 6) observe the restrictions established for civil servants by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
civil79-uff020a8638ac230c4e-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-ued920598caf6958e85-1.text: 7) maintain neutrality, excluding the possibility that decisions of political parties, other public associations, religious associations or other organizations influence their professional service activity;
civil79-ued920598caf6958e85-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-u92cf2eaeba7c3f976d-1.text: 8) refrain from acts disgracing their honour and dignity;
civil79-u92cf2eaeba7c3f976d-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-uaaeae581f9995d0cf4-1.text: 9) be courteous in dealings with citizens;
civil79-uaaeae581f9995d0cf4-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-u1e60ba816627c2a94c-1.text: 10) respect the moral customs and traditions of the peoples of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u1e60ba816627c2a94c-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-u2c792403646167197e-1.text: 11) take account of the cultural and other characteristics of different ethnic and social groups and religious denominations;
civil79-u2c792403646167197e-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-ucfcf632528744936a9-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-u2d9995ef1520568e7c-1.text: 13) avoid conflict situations capable of damaging their reputation or the state body's authority;
civil79-u2d9995ef1520568e7c-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-u4a2c6dda5f659e049e-1.text: 14) observe the established rules for public speaking and provision of official information.
civil79-u4a2c6dda5f659e049e-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-ue54b22ed78b3372c1d-1.text: 2. A civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ category must prevent civil servants from being compelled to participate in the activities of political parties, other public associations or religious associations.
civil79-ue54b22ed78b3372c1d-1.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct

civil79-u31c1e7714528fc2179-1.text: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
civil79-u31c1e7714528fc2179-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-u88004835fe6e3957f9-1.text: 1. For the purposes of this Federal Law, ‘conflict of interest’ has the meaning established by part 1 of Article 10 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’.
civil79-u88004835fe6e3957f9-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-u60737d706ff3f85b38-1.text: 2. The emergence of a civil servant's personal interest that causes or may cause a conflict of interest is prevented to avoid harm to the lawful interests of citizens, organizations, society, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the Russian Federation.
civil79-u60737d706ff3f85b38-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-u393c83f9f3224cb4f0-1.text: 3. For the purposes of this Federal Law, ‘personal interest’ has the meaning established by part 2 of Article 10 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’.
civil79-u393c83f9f3224cb4f0-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-u2dc1533bd07d3a1650-1.text: 3.1. Prevention or resolution of a conflict of interest may consist in changing the official or service position of the civil servant who is a party to it, up to suspension from official (service) duties in the prescribed manner, and/or relinquishment by that civil servant of the benefit that caused the conflict of interest.
civil79-u2dc1533bd07d3a1650-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-u67776555479b750e9c-1.text: 3.2. Failure by a civil servant who is a party to a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
civil79-u67776555479b750e9c-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-ue0e74d19e2d5035687-1.text: 4. An employer's representative who learns that a civil servant has a personal interest causing or potentially causing a conflict of interest must take measures to prevent or resolve it, up to suspending the civil servant who is a party to the conflict from the civil service position held in the manner established by this Federal Law.
civil79-ue0e74d19e2d5035687-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-u13014494507e00356f-1.text: 4.1. Failure by a civil servant acting as an employer's representative who has learned that a subordinate civil servant has a personal interest causing or potentially causing a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it is an offence entailing dismissal of the civil servant acting as the employer's representative from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
civil79-u13014494507e00356f-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-ue7b64fe2ecff48ab35-1.text: 5. To ensure compliance with civil servants' official conduct requirements and resolve conflicts of interest, commissions on compliance with civil servants' official conduct requirements and resolution of conflicts of interest (hereinafter conflict-of-interest commissions) are established in state bodies, the federal state body responsible for managing state service and the state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation responsible for managing state service (hereinafter a state service management body).
civil79-ue7b64fe2ecff48ab35-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-u3856503967b7cc0f43-1.text: 6. A conflict-of-interest commission is established by a legal act of a state body in the manner determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u3856503967b7cc0f43-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-u0d1f6124bc87a193c7-1.text: 7. Conflict-of-interest commissions are formed so as to exclude the possibility of conflicts of interest that could influence their decisions.
civil79-u0d1f6124bc87a193c7-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
