civil79-u8517a05fe6ac6763bc-1.text: 8. Regulations on commissions on compliance with federal state servants' official conduct requirements and resolution of conflicts of interest are approved in the manner determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u8517a05fe6ac6763bc-1.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service

civil79-uc5ab2bf45e1e75f095-1.text: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
civil79-uc5ab2bf45e1e75f095-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u644e6074f23501c448-1.text: 1. In the cases established by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’, the information on income, property and property-related obligations required by that Federal Law is submitted to the employer's representative by:
civil79-u644e6074f23501c448-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u74e389ad0688536b43-1.text: 1) a citizen seeking a civil service position;
civil79-u74e389ad0688536b43-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-ue2d3db635e8151ac35-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u1c7c70a8d120822335-1.text: 1.1. Repealed from 1 January 2026. — Federal Law No. 505-ФЗ of 28.12.2025.
civil79-u1c7c70a8d120822335-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u4307c302f1c7c4e5d5-1.text: 2. Regulations on submission, in accordance with this Article, of information on income, property and property-related obligations by a civil servant holding a civil service position included in a list established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation are approved, respectively, by an act of the President of the Russian Federation or a normative legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, taking account of this Article's requirements.
civil79-u4307c302f1c7c4e5d5-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u7d5feba62315f2e542-1.text: 3. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article is confidential unless classified as a state secret by federal law.
civil79-u7d5feba62315f2e542-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u7c067e4c7d89463c2f-1.text: 4. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article may not be used to establish or determine the solvency of the civil servant, their spouse or minor children, or to collect donations (contributions), directly or indirectly, for the funds of public or religious associations or other organizations, or for individuals.
civil79-u7c067e4c7d89463c2f-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u79dfec3059791ed853-1.text: 5. Persons guilty of disclosing information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article, or of using it for purposes not provided for by federal laws, bear liability under this Federal Law and other federal laws.
civil79-u79dfec3059791ed853-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u83867256a7034bffb9-1.text: 6. The accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article are verified in the manner established by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u83867256a7034bffb9-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u4a84eebcbf1cb29aa3-1.text: 6.1. A civil servant's failure to submit the information on income, property and property-related obligations required by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ where submission is mandatory, or submission of knowingly incomplete information, is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
civil79-u4a84eebcbf1cb29aa3-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u284b52b31ff358a1b4-1.text: 6.2. A civil servant's submission of knowingly inaccurate information referred to in part 6.1 of this Article is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service.
civil79-u284b52b31ff358a1b4-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-u6c9f21298408718772-1.text: 7. Repealed from 1 January 2026. — Federal Law No. 505-ФЗ of 28.12.2025.
civil79-u6c9f21298408718772-1.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

civil79-uc0a896ac2c333cb63a-1.text: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure
civil79-uc0a896ac2c333cb63a-1.locator: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure

civil79-uc3302a3fc7e372be9e-1.text: 1. A civil servant holding a civil service position included in a list established by the relevant normative legal act of the Russian Federation must submit to the employer's representative the expenditure information required by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, in the manner established by federal law and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
civil79-uc3302a3fc7e372be9e-1.locator: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure

civil79-u36b824dce1bc4abff0-1.text: 2. Correspondence between the expenditure and income of a civil servant, their spouse and minor children is monitored in the manner established by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’, Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u36b824dce1bc4abff0-1.locator: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure

civil79-u1d4551a38b263f9cea-1.text: 3. A civil servant's failure to submit the expenditure information required by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’ where submission is mandatory, or submission of knowingly incomplete information, is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
civil79-u1d4551a38b263f9cea-1.locator: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure

civil79-u833ae506ee173ebd2c-1.text: 4. A civil servant's submission of knowingly inaccurate information referred to in part 3 of this Article is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service.
civil79-u833ae506ee173ebd2c-1.locator: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure

civil79-u4fe92af88f9e48e558-1.text: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network
civil79-u4fe92af88f9e48e558-1.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network

civil79-uaf9ed03e184231db8b-1.text: 1. Information on the addresses of websites and/or website pages on the Internet information and telecommunications network on which a citizen seeking a civil service position or a civil servant has posted publicly accessible information, and data enabling their identification, is submitted to the employer's representative by:
civil79-uaf9ed03e184231db8b-1.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network

civil79-u28ca85bf056360ade3-1.text: 1) a citizen seeking a civil service position, upon entry into service, for the three calendar years preceding the year of entry into the civil service;
civil79-u28ca85bf056360ade3-1.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network

civil79-u13f6d890914c348377-1.text: 2) a civil servant, annually for the calendar year preceding the year in which the information is submitted, except where publicly accessible information was posted in the performance of the civil servant's official duties.
civil79-u13f6d890914c348377-1.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network

civil79-ufcfcc6138bf459f7d2-1.text: 2. The information specified in part 1 of this Article is submitted by citizens seeking civil service positions upon entry into the civil service, and by civil servants no later than 1 April of the year following the reporting year. The information specified in part 1 of this Article is submitted using the form established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
civil79-ufcfcc6138bf459f7d2-1.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network

civil79-ubc6f86628770212688-1.text: 3. By decision of the employer's representative, civil servants authorized by that representative process publicly accessible information posted on the Internet information and telecommunications network by applicants for civil service positions and civil servants, and verify the accuracy and completeness of the information provided for by part 1 of this Article.
civil79-ubc6f86628770212688-1.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network

civil79-uc8d640133056280edb-1.text: Article 20.3. Submission of a questionnaire, notification of changes to information in it and verification of that information
civil79-uc8d640133056280edb-1.locator: Article 20.3. Submission of a questionnaire, notification of changes to information in it and verification of that information

civil79-uedf564ce745b46231b-1.text: 1. On entering the civil service, a citizen submits a questionnaire using the form established by the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-uedf564ce745b46231b-1.locator: Article 20.3. Submission of a questionnaire, notification of changes to information in it and verification of that information

civil79-ucec94f538456c43432-1.text: 2. A civil servant notifies the employer's representative in writing of changes in the information in the questionnaire that become known to the civil servant.
civil79-ucec94f538456c43432-1.locator: Article 20.3. Submission of a questionnaire, notification of changes to information in it and verification of that information

civil79-uc7e20c4ece53990d67-1.text: 3. Information in the questionnaire may be verified by decision of the employer's representative or a person authorized by that representative. The state body's personnel service verifies it by sending written requests to public authorities and organizations possessing the relevant information, including through state information systems, among them those provided for by Article 44.1 of this Federal Law. Public authorities and organizations possessing the relevant information must provide the requested information no later than one month after receipt of the request.
civil79-uc7e20c4ece53990d67-1.locator: Article 20.3. Submission of a questionnaire, notification of changes to information in it and verification of that information

civil79-u6bf1cfbd085b0df3b6-1.text: Chapter 4. ENTRY INTO THE CIVIL SERVICE
civil79-u6bf1cfbd085b0df3b6-1.locator: Chapter 4. ENTRY INTO THE CIVIL SERVICE

civil79-u99da7a5eff348d70e5-1.text: Article 21. Right to enter the civil service
civil79-u99da7a5eff348d70e5-1.locator: Article 21. Right to enter the civil service

civil79-u6d1ba1fff985ed7b50-1.text: 1. Citizens of the Russian Federation who have reached 18 years of age, know the state language of the Russian Federation and meet the qualification requirements established by this Federal Law are entitled to enter the civil service.
civil79-u6d1ba1fff985ed7b50-1.locator: Article 21. Right to enter the civil service

civil79-u1bf3ae67867b1f07be-1.locator: Article 21. Right to enter the civil service

civil79-u2892cd0f94a0083037-1.text: 3. A citizen may not be admitted to the civil service in the cases provided for by points 1–9, 11 and 12 of part 1 of Article 16 of this Federal Law. Other restrictions on entry into the civil service are established by federal laws.
civil79-u2892cd0f94a0083037-1.locator: Article 21. Right to enter the civil service

civil79-u1d2d993507f905d5fc-1.text: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
civil79-u1d2d993507f905d5fc-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u93e596d0985dfe87bc-1.text: 1. Unless otherwise established by this Article, a citizen enters the civil service to hold a civil service position, or a civil servant takes another civil service position, on the basis of a competition. The competition consists of assessing the professional level of applicants, checking compliance with other established qualification requirements for the position, and selecting from among the applicants, on the basis of that assessment and check, a citizen or civil servant for appointment to the position.
civil79-u93e596d0985dfe87bc-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u6c0b92f46fcd71b24f-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u648352c2b54d3d5c0c-1.text: 1) on appointment to fixed-term civil service positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories;
civil79-u648352c2b54d3d5c0c-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u27074e7cd875ecc3e3-1.text: 2) on appointment to civil service positions in the ‘managers’ category for which appointment and removal are carried out by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u27074e7cd875ecc3e3-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-uace6ca2dce0491e3ad-1.text: 3) when concluding a fixed-term service contract;
civil79-uace6ca2dce0491e3ad-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u0c9a6517d75c49711e-1.text: 4) when appointing a civil servant by transfer to another civil service position in the cases provided for by points 3–14 of part 5 and points 3–5 of part 6 of Article 28 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u0c9a6517d75c49711e-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u04bd9db8d223d2f6b1-1.text: 5) when appointing to a civil service position a civil servant or citizen included in the civil service personnel reserve.
civil79-u04bd9db8d223d2f6b1-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-uc4ada296bac0773bbb-1.text: 3. A competition may be omitted for appointment to particular civil service positions whose duties involve the use of state secrets, according to a list of positions approved by a normative act of the state body.
civil79-uc4ada296bac0773bbb-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u8dea90ebacaa4fc633-1.text: 4. By decision of the employer's representative, a competition may be omitted for appointment to positions in the junior group of civil service positions, and in other cases provided for by federal laws.
civil79-u8dea90ebacaa4fc633-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u3044e6bb5f4530535e-1.text: 5. An applicant for a civil service position may be refused admission to a competition for failure to meet the qualification requirements for the vacant position or because of restrictions established by this Federal Law on entry into and performance of the civil service.
civil79-u3044e6bb5f4530535e-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u802ec2bcd2c611c744-1.text: 6. An applicant for a civil service position who is not admitted to a competition may challenge that decision in accordance with this Federal Law.
civil79-u802ec2bcd2c611c744-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u3b6334c011aafeb830-1.text: 7. A competition commission is established by a legal act of the relevant state body to conduct a competition for a vacant civil service position.
civil79-u3b6334c011aafeb830-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u37da060d954b83d706-1.text: 8. The competition commission includes the employer's representative and/or civil servants authorized by that representative (including from the subdivision responsible for state service and personnel and the subdivision where the vacancy is being filled), and independent experts included under part 8.2 of this Article: representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations specializing in the relevant fields and types of civil servants' professional service activity, personnel technologies and civil service matters. Independent experts must constitute at least one-quarter of the total membership of the commission.
civil79-u37da060d954b83d706-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u9c6cbf47714d9d2cee-1.text: 8.1. In a federal executive body with a public council established under Article 20 of Federal Law No. 32-ФЗ of 4 April 2005 ‘On the Public Chamber of the Russian Federation’, and in an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation with a public council established under a normative legal act of that constituent entity, representatives of those public councils are included in the competition commission alongside the persons specified in part 8 of this Article. The combined number of those representatives and independent experts must be at least one-quarter of the commission's total membership.
civil79-u9c6cbf47714d9d2cee-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u974a23177490f2dbe6-1.text: 8.2. Representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations included in competition commissions are invited and selected, at the employer's representative's request made without specifying the independent experts' personal data, by the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and normative legal regulation in the state civil service, or by an authorized state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation. This is done in the manner established by a normative legal act of the Government of the Russian Federation or a normative legal act of a constituent entity adopted with regard to the procedure established by the Government. Public council representatives included in competition commissions are designated by decisions of the respective public councils.
civil79-u974a23177490f2dbe6-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u792138c8192a91dcf5-1.text: 8.3. An independent expert's total period on a state body's competition commission may not exceed three years. The period is calculated from the expert's first inclusion in the commission. The same independent expert may be included again no earlier than three years after the end of their period on the commission.
civil79-u792138c8192a91dcf5-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u83f16c04ed14f389b9-1.text: 8.4. An independent expert's combined period on the competition and attestation commissions of the same state body may not exceed three years.
civil79-u83f16c04ed14f389b9-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u172846aa045b76bf2d-1.text: 9. A competition commission for a vacant civil service position whose duties involve use of state secrets is formed with regard to the provisions of the legislation of the Russian Federation on state secrets.
civil79-u172846aa045b76bf2d-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-ucd6d181873515be9d1-1.text: 10. The competition commission is formed so as to exclude the possibility of conflicts of interest that could influence its decisions.
civil79-ucd6d181873515be9d1-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-ud32fe50510bd5af26d-1.text: 11. An applicant for a civil service position may challenge the competition commission's decision in accordance with this Federal Law.
civil79-ud32fe50510bd5af26d-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-ud6b8efd24f0fcbfee6-1.text: 12. Regulations on competitions for vacant state civil service positions of the Russian Federation, determining the procedure and conditions for them, are approved by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-ud6b8efd24f0fcbfee6-1.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition

civil79-u881ac63bb95705e7f3-1.text: Article 23. Definition and parties to a service contract
civil79-u881ac63bb95705e7f3-1.locator: Article 23. Definition and parties to a service contract

civil79-uf333510fb393315199-1.text: 1. A service contract is an agreement between the employer's representative and a citizen entering the civil service or a civil servant concerning performance of civil service and holding a civil service position. The service contract establishes the parties' rights and duties.
civil79-uf333510fb393315199-1.locator: Article 23. Definition and parties to a service contract

civil79-u57b338bae1e82c2351-1.text: 2. The employer's representative undertakes to give a citizen entering the civil service the opportunity to perform civil service and to give that citizen or a civil servant the opportunity to hold a specified civil service position; to ensure performance of civil service and holding of the position in accordance with this Federal Law, other laws and other normative legal acts on civil service; to pay the civil servant's monetary remuneration promptly and in full; and to provide state social guarantees.
civil79-u57b338bae1e82c2351-1.locator: Article 23. Definition and parties to a service contract

civil79-ue31fe478416777d325-1.text: 3. A citizen entering the civil service, when concluding a service contract on performance of civil service and holding a civil service position, and a civil servant, when concluding a service contract on holding a civil service position, undertake to perform official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations and observe the state body's service rules.
civil79-ue31fe478416777d325-1.locator: Article 23. Definition and parties to a service contract

civil79-u5ae61b17d33a319b6d-1.text: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
civil79-u5ae61b17d33a319b6d-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u34cc4eb24cb35c419f-1.text: 1. A service contract states its date and place of conclusion; the name of the state body; the employer's representative's position, surname, given name and patronymic (if any); the title, date and number of the legal act determining that representative's legal status and authority to conclude the service contract; the surname, given name and patronymic (if any) of the citizen or civil servant appointed to the civil service position; and details of that person's identity document.
civil79-u34cc4eb24cb35c419f-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u9174a18190d45a2dfa-1.text: 2. The terms of a service contract include:
civil79-u9174a18190d45a2dfa-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u994037cd72b1490c9f-1.text: 1) the title of the civil service position held, specifying the state body's structural subdivision (if any) and the place of service;
civil79-u994037cd72b1490c9f-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u3416ac5dfe99d19753-1.text: 2) the date of commencement of official duties and the duration of the service contract;
civil79-u3416ac5dfe99d19753-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-ue626b29d44b3957c69-1.text: 3) the civil servant's rights, duties and liability under this Federal Law, other federal laws and other normative legal acts on civil service, and the official duties regulations;
civil79-ue626b29d44b3957c69-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u5e32b6fc2595cf52ad-1.text: 4) the types and conditions of the civil servant's medical insurance and other types of insurance;
civil79-u5e32b6fc2595cf52ad-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-ude171218bb66b8d91e-1.text: 5) the employer's representative's rights, duties and liability under this Federal Law, other federal laws and other normative legal acts on civil service;
civil79-ude171218bb66b8d91e-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-ud1da7c61d39d6220c8-1.text: 6) conditions of professional service activity, and compensation and benefits for professional service activity in arduous, harmful and/or dangerous conditions;
civil79-ud1da7c61d39d6220c8-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u7f32dfdb80a5b987d3-1.text: 7) the working and rest time arrangements, if they differ for the civil servant from the state body's service rules;
civil79-u7f32dfdb80a5b987d3-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u3527966ed38e5e6448-1.text: 8) remuneration terms (the civil servant's official salary, supplements and other payments, including those related to the effectiveness of professional service activity), as established by this Federal Law, other federal laws and other normative legal acts;
civil79-u3527966ed38e5e6448-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u03bdb04ccf6979d1e4-1.text: 9) types and conditions of social insurance connected with professional service activity;
civil79-u03bdb04ccf6979d1e4-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u4bd31e8a8bb584155c-1.text: 10) inclusion of the position held by the civil servant in the list of civil service positions for which rotation of civil servants is provided;
civil79-u4bd31e8a8bb584155c-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u9be2e47f2ad75a4902-1.text: 11) probation, if provided for by Article 27 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u9be2e47f2ad75a4902-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-ua9c14390bba4037ba7-1.text: 12) nondisclosure of state secrets, other secrets protected by federal law and official information, if the official duties regulations provide for the use of such information;
civil79-ua9c14390bba4037ba7-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u66bf66dd6efcb21f9b-1.text: 13) the person's obligation, after completing education at a vocational education organization or a higher education organization, to perform civil service for no less than the period established by the targeted education agreement, if the education was funded by the relevant budget;
civil79-u66bf66dd6efcb21f9b-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u3999fa982e75680b27-1.text: 14) other terms that do not worsen the civil servant's position compared with that established by this Federal Law, other laws and other normative legal acts.
civil79-u3999fa982e75680b27-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u6c5cf104543f773de3-1.text: 3. The terms of a service contract may be changed only by agreement of the parties and only in writing.
civil79-u6c5cf104543f773de3-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u7c80fc06dd08b81303-1.text: 4. A fixed-term service contract states the circumstances (reasons) constituting the grounds for its conclusion under this Federal Law and other federal laws.
civil79-u7c80fc06dd08b81303-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u7b9c35bd6eb814a0ad-1.text: 5. A service contract provides for the parties' liability under the legislation of the Russian Federation for nonperformance or improper performance of the duties and obligations undertaken. A civil servant may not be required to perform official duties not established by the service contract and official duties regulations.
civil79-u7b9c35bd6eb814a0ad-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u0ad90e05742b3a355b-1.text: 6. A service contract is concluded in writing in two copies, each signed by the parties. One copy is given to the civil servant and the other is kept in their personnel file. A model service contract form is established by the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u0ad90e05742b3a355b-1.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract

civil79-u2696ea1a9d52c55a7f-1.text: Article 25. Duration of a service contract
civil79-u2696ea1a9d52c55a7f-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u9f019771b18c2e2f50-1.text: 1. To fill a civil service position, the employer's representative may conclude with a civil servant:
civil79-u9f019771b18c2e2f50-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u76ad39482cdd84aa44-1.text: 1) a service contract for an indefinite period;
civil79-u76ad39482cdd84aa44-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u5a0e9f548e80260d87-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-ubb36673e0219ab71d3-1.text: 2. A fixed-term service contract is concluded for one to five years, unless this Federal Law establishes another period.
civil79-ubb36673e0219ab71d3-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u98cf1835d342259c85-1.text: 3. A fixed-term service contract is concluded where civil service relations cannot be established for an indefinite period in view of the category of the civil service position or the conditions of service, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
civil79-u98cf1835d342259c85-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-ue35adeac6c0f9ded03-1.text: 4. A fixed-term service contract is concluded in the case of:
civil79-ue35adeac6c0f9ded03-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-uf5c39907d45335b708-1.text: 1) holding particular civil service positions in the ‘managers’ category or positions in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category;
civil79-uf5c39907d45335b708-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-uaec7400854e90aa8bf-1.text: 2) filling a civil service position during the absence of a civil servant whose position is retained under this Federal Law and other federal laws;
civil79-uaec7400854e90aa8bf-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u823d2f49e2608eda18-1.text: 3) holding a civil service position after completion of education by a citizen who concluded a targeted education agreement at a vocational education organization or higher education organization undertaking subsequent civil service;
civil79-u823d2f49e2608eda18-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-ub1b26cb0689e7eb3d5-1.text: 4) holding a civil service position in diplomatic missions, consular institutions or other representative offices of the Russian Federation, or representative offices of state bodies, located outside the territory of the Russian Federation;
civil79-ub1b26cb0689e7eb3d5-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u219b2c25579ed41739-1.text: 5) holding a civil service position in a state body established for a specified period or to perform specified tasks and functions;
civil79-u219b2c25579ed41739-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u956295c5948717d71c-1.text: 6) holding a temporary civil service position or filling a position during a civil servant's temporary absence by agreement of the parties to the service contract;
civil79-u956295c5948717d71c-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-uab799df86b3634ee96-1.text: 6.1) holding a civil service position by a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and whose service has been extended beyond that age under part 1 of Article 25.1 of this Federal Law;
civil79-uab799df86b3634ee96-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u48acacd1d38df5c43a-1.text: 7) holding a civil service position for which part 14 of Article 50 of this Federal Law establishes a special remuneration procedure;
civil79-u48acacd1d38df5c43a-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u59c9578b5290b97f61-1.text: 7.1) holding a civil service position through rotation;
civil79-u59c9578b5290b97f61-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-uc62327d0bd26d2a5e9-1.text: 8) other cases provided for by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
civil79-uc62327d0bd26d2a5e9-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u7a84831bfb42e5fbf4-1.locator: Article 25. Duration of a service contract

civil79-u7f481f87fa9ab7e68d-1.text: Article 25.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
civil79-u7f481f87fa9ab7e68d-1.locator: Article 25.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service

civil79-uab45dffc282c7a5df9-1.text: 1. The maximum age for remaining in the civil service is 65. For a civil servant who has reached that age and holds a position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category established to assist a person holding a state office, service may be extended, with the civil servant's consent, by decision of the employer's representative until the end of that person's term of office. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the highest group, service may be extended with their consent, but not beyond age 70, by the state body or relevant official that appointed them. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group in the Staff of the Federation Council of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation or the Staff of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation, service may be extended with their consent, but not beyond age 70, by the appointing official in agreement with the chairman of the relevant chamber of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group in federal executive bodies whose activities are directed by the Government of the Russian Federation, service may be extended with their consent, but not beyond age 70, by the federal executive body or relevant official that appointed them, in agreement with the Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group in the staff office of a constituent entity's legislative body, service may be extended with their consent, but not beyond age 70, by the appointing official in agreement with the chairman of that legislative body. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum service age and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group in an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, service may be extended with their consent, but not beyond age 70, by the executive body or relevant official that appointed them, in agreement with the highest official of the constituent entity. When service is extended, the age-70 limitation does not apply to civil servants holding positions for which appointment and removal are carried out by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, or to civil servants holding positions in the ‘managers’ category of the highest group in the Staff of the Federation Council or the Staff of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation which correspond to the class rank of Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 1, and for which appointment and removal are carried out by the chairman of the relevant chamber of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation.
civil79-uab45dffc282c7a5df9-1.locator: Article 25.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service

civil79-u07f0e87097df993821-1.text: 1.1. A citizen who has reached the maximum civil service age may enter the civil service to hold a position for which appointment and removal are carried out by the President of the Russian Federation. Service is deemed extended under part 1 of this Article from the date of appointment to that position. A fixed-term service contract is concluded with the citizen.
civil79-u07f0e87097df993821-1.locator: Article 25.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service

civil79-ua67c379a332a1fde2e-1.text: 2. Upon reaching the maximum civil service age, a civil servant may, by decision of the employer's representative and with the citizen's consent, continue working in the state body under a fixed-term employment contract in a position that is not a civil service position.
civil79-ua67c379a332a1fde2e-1.locator: Article 25.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service

civil79-u6ce4491fadc6ff0465-1.text: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract
civil79-u6ce4491fadc6ff0465-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u35ad7a9fd9fef60100-1.text: 1. A service contract is concluded on the basis of a state body's act appointing a person to a civil service position.
civil79-u35ad7a9fd9fef60100-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u692e44080ccf89e776-1.text: 2. On concluding a service contract, a citizen entering the civil service presents to the employer's representative:
civil79-u692e44080ccf89e776-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u449d4f2d00523f9f50-1.text: 1) an application requesting admission to the civil service and appointment to a civil service position;
civil79-u449d4f2d00523f9f50-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u524c0b32dfa3675a42-1.text: 2) the questionnaire provided for by Article 20.3 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u524c0b32dfa3675a42-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u3780de830115a1a6b1-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u83c39789379158006c-1.text: 4) a work record book and/or employment history information prepared in the manner established by law, except where this is the person's first service (employment) activity;
civil79-u83c39789379158006c-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u54ad343b0dc9b75c75-1.text: 5) a document confirming registration in the individual (personalized) recordkeeping system, except where this is the person's first service (employment) activity;
civil79-u54ad343b0dc9b75c75-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u10e6acde30542ee845-1.text: 6) a certificate of registration of the individual with the tax authority at their place of residence in the Russian Federation;
civil79-u10e6acde30542ee845-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u2adbf667dd6676d29e-1.text: 7) military registration documents, for citizens in the reserve and persons liable to conscription;
civil79-u2adbf667dd6676d29e-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-ue8ba6da85f8e4510cd-1.text: 8) a document on education and qualifications;
civil79-ue8ba6da85f8e4510cd-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-ue0414d43c8a0a05852-1.text: 9) information on income, property and property-related obligations required by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’;
civil79-ue0414d43c8a0a05852-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u7f9be101899b0144c0-1.text: 10) the information provided for by Article 20.2 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u7f9be101899b0144c0-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u3135236f293c99349e-1.text: 11) a medical organization's opinion confirming the absence of an illness preventing entry into or performance of the civil service.
civil79-u3135236f293c99349e-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u17ae192b962e5e4808-1.text: 3. In particular cases, taking account of the conditions of civil service established by this Federal Law, other federal laws, decrees of the President of the Russian Federation and resolutions of the Government of the Russian Federation, submission of other documents may be required when concluding a service contract.
civil79-u17ae192b962e5e4808-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u796440d8c167df1b0d-1.text: 4. A service contract may not worsen the conditions of civil service or infringe a civil servant's rights established by this Federal Law, other federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u796440d8c167df1b0d-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u65680007485a973c10-1.text: 5. A service contract enters into force on the date the parties sign it, unless otherwise established by federal laws, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation or the service contract.
civil79-u65680007485a973c10-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-uecf7f162a0a2e6d3be-1.text: 6. When concluding a service contract, the employer's representative must familiarize the civil servant with the state body's service rules and other normative acts relevant to the performance of the civil servant's official duties.
civil79-uecf7f162a0a2e6d3be-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-ue098cd4dbdd10f5bb9-1.text: 7. After appointment to a civil service position, the civil servant is issued an official service identity card in the prescribed form.
civil79-ue098cd4dbdd10f5bb9-1.locator: Article 26. Conclusion of a service contract

civil79-u0dea586a0697d1c736-1.text: Article 27. Probation in the civil service
civil79-u0dea586a0697d1c736-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-ud3269baa374e7ee418-1.text: 1. When a service contract is concluded with a citizen entering the civil service for the first time, that contract and the state body's appointment act provide for a probationary period of one month to one year to assess the civil servant's suitability for the position held, unless otherwise provided by this Article.
civil79-ud3269baa374e7ee418-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-u9986e723998e07079e-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-ua41a05e892548b4a6f-1.text: 1) on appointment of a citizen or civil servant to a position for which appointment and removal are carried out by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, for one month to one year;
civil79-ua41a05e892548b4a6f-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-ua0592eab18002952e1-1.text: 2) on appointment to a civil service position of a citizen who previously performed state service of the Russian Federation, for one to six months;
civil79-ua0592eab18002952e1-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-uaf494533b9d1c6d714-1.text: 3) on appointment of a civil servant to a civil service position by transfer from another state body, for one to six months.
civil79-uaf494533b9d1c6d714-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-u723db2c6841178d671-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-u216a37fb7b57beabba-1.text: 1) citizens who obtained secondary vocational education through a programme for training middle-level specialists or higher education under a targeted education agreement undertaking subsequent civil service, and who enter the civil service for the first time;
civil79-u216a37fb7b57beabba-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-u8810283867d2399725-1.text: 2) civil servants appointed under point 1 of part 1 of Article 31 of this Federal Law by transfer due to reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body;
civil79-u8810283867d2399725-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-ud1c25a9e847ad21cba-1.text: 3) other citizens and civil servants for whom the legislation of the Russian Federation provides guarantees of retention of their job (position).
civil79-ud1c25a9e847ad21cba-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-u58e51f15f0dd47bc1c-1.text: 4. During probation, the civil servant is subject to this Federal Law, other laws and other normative legal acts on civil service.
civil79-u58e51f15f0dd47bc1c-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-u14fe49a312265fb7e3-1.text: 5. At the end of the prescribed probationary period, a civil servant who does not hold the class rank corresponding to the civil service position held is awarded a class rank in accordance with Article 11 of this Federal Law.
civil79-u14fe49a312265fb7e3-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-ub55c22d0f7dacb48cb-1.text: 6. Periods of a civil servant's temporary incapacity for work and other periods when they did not actually perform official duties are excluded from the probationary period.
civil79-ub55c22d0f7dacb48cb-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-u9b1707d7677d258416-1.text: 7. If probation is unsuccessful, the employer's representative may terminate the service contract before the probationary period expires, giving the civil servant written notice at least three days in advance and stating the reasons for finding that the civil servant failed probation.
civil79-u9b1707d7677d258416-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-u622c0f904c4e9d67e0-1.text: 8. A civil servant may challenge the employer's representative's decision in court.
civil79-u622c0f904c4e9d67e0-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-u9ca6514f4fdf114ec0-1.text: 9. If the probationary period expires and the civil servant continues to hold the civil service position, they are deemed to have passed probation.
civil79-u9ca6514f4fdf114ec0-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-u9dc357a2231b55b7a6-1.text: 10. Before the probationary period expires, a civil servant may terminate the service contract at their own request, giving the employer's representative written notice at least three days in advance.
civil79-u9dc357a2231b55b7a6-1.locator: Article 27. Probation in the civil service

civil79-uba5e48d1d8b6e644c9-1.text: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
civil79-uba5e48d1d8b6e644c9-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u01bb2c61a3a6acc626-1.text: 1. Transfer of a civil servant to another civil service position in the same state body, including in another locality, or to another civil service position in another state body in the cases established by this Federal Law is permitted:
civil79-u01bb2c61a3a6acc626-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u28d7949f862b809af8-1.text: 1) on the initiative of the employer's representative, with the civil servant's written consent, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law;
civil79-u28d7949f862b809af8-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u79e336db66b997b06e-1.text: 2) on the civil servant's initiative, by decision of the employer's representative.
civil79-u79e336db66b997b06e-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-ude79a630b5a3fee7c8-1.text: 2. Transfer to another civil service position in another state body on the civil servant's initiative is effected by agreement between the employer's representatives of the current and receiving state bodies, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law, and on the basis of the civil servant's written application sent to the employer's representative of the current state body at least two weeks before transfer.
civil79-ude79a630b5a3fee7c8-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u06f60dd22046919e82-1.text: 3. By agreement between the employer's representative of the state body with which the service contract has been concluded and the employer's representative of the state body with which a contract is planned, and with the civil servant's consent, the civil servant may be released from the current position and transferred to another position in the other state body before the date specified in the civil servant's written application.
civil79-u06f60dd22046919e82-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u1ff729f96b2f2ac21b-1.text: 4. When a service contract is terminated because of transfer to another civil service position in another state body, the civil servant's personnel file is transferred in the prescribed manner to the receiving state body.
civil79-u1ff729f96b2f2ac21b-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u0a41e2282a49a56ac4-1.text: 5. Transfer to another civil service position in the same state body takes place:
civil79-u0a41e2282a49a56ac4-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u09d393248b4cac53e9-1.text: 1) on the basis of a competition;
civil79-u09d393248b4cac53e9-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u3ea405bd035843a017-1.text: 2) on appointment without a competition in the cases provided for by points 1–3 and 5 of part 2 and parts 3 and 4 of Article 22 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u3ea405bd035843a017-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-ud6c2ef5c28c56f1db0-1.text: 3) because the civil servant is unable, for health reasons confirmed by a medical opinion, to perform the duties of the position held;
civil79-ud6c2ef5c28c56f1db0-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u084ab4047e3d9710f6-1.text: 4) because a civil servant who previously held the position is reinstated by court decision;
civil79-u084ab4047e3d9710f6-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u96ca64fdf9d49ead1a-1.text: 5) by decision of the employer's representative because the civil servant's access to state secrets necessary for official duties has been terminated or refused on the ground that close relatives specified in Article 21 of Law of the Russian Federation No. 5485-I of 21 July 1993 ‘On State Secrets’ permanently reside abroad and/or hold foreign citizenship (nationality) or a residence permit or other document confirming the right to permanent residence in a foreign State, as provided for by the fourth paragraph of part one of Article 22 of that Law;
civil79-u96ca64fdf9d49ead1a-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u620c34a76b26796ed4-1.text: 6) upon reduction of the position held by the civil servant in accordance with Article 31 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u620c34a76b26796ed4-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u8132cda6c01f565727-1.text: 7) in connection with rotation under Article 60.1 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u8132cda6c01f565727-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u423ddac487ec5c2edc-1.text: 8) in connection with demotion in the civil service and exclusion from the personnel reserve, if included in it, following attestation under point 3 of part 16 of Article 48 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u423ddac487ec5c2edc-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u4889fab5f725204b2e-1.text: 9) to eliminate direct subordination or accountability between civil servants who are close blood relatives or relatives by marriage, in order to comply with the restriction in point 5 of part 1 of Article 16 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u4889fab5f725204b2e-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-udc53ef2cdfa8db9ae1-1.text: 10) where a civil servant needs temporarily to fill another position under Article 30 of this Federal Law;
civil79-udc53ef2cdfa8db9ae1-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u5ac38222ca7f91644c-1.text: 11) upon refusal of a position offered through rotation in the cases provided for by parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 60.1 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u5ac38222ca7f91644c-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-ubabbb500bee9608c50-1.text: 12) where the civil servant does not agree to continue holding the position because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract under Article 29 of this Federal Law;
civil79-ubabbb500bee9608c50-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-ub6c401fcd28d13dab9-1.text: 13) upon expiry of the prescribed term of office of a civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ or ‘assistants (advisers)’ category, in the case provided for by part 4 of Article 35 of this Federal Law;
civil79-ub6c401fcd28d13dab9-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u426210519634cf6d3c-1.text: 14) where a civil servant holds foreign citizenship (nationality) that has not been terminated for reasons beyond their control, in exceptional cases and in the manner determined by the President of the Russian Federation, provided that the other position does not require clearance for access to state secrets, taking account of Article 26 of Federal Law No. 116-ФЗ of 30 April 2021 ‘On Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation’.
civil79-u426210519634cf6d3c-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u1e6f72a52e1560483a-1.text: 6. Transfer to another civil service position in another state body takes place:
civil79-u1e6f72a52e1560483a-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u09d393248b4cac53e9-2.text: 1) on the basis of a competition;
civil79-u09d393248b4cac53e9-2.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u3ea405bd035843a017-2.text: 2) on appointment without a competition in the cases provided for by points 1–3 and 5 of part 2 and parts 3 and 4 of Article 22 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u3ea405bd035843a017-2.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u20e8931b166f82c636-1.text: 3) upon reduction of a civil service position or abolition of a state body under Article 31 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u20e8931b166f82c636-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u6ca1bf4c132a0e4a77-1.text: 4) in connection with rotation under Article 60.1 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u6ca1bf4c132a0e4a77-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-ue5f16fed472ff74570-1.text: 5) upon refusal of a position offered through rotation in the cases provided for by parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 60.1 of this Federal Law.
civil79-ue5f16fed472ff74570-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u6d33b92d7cd19aa9af-1.text: 7. Transfer to another civil service position in the cases provided for by this Article requires the civil servant to meet the qualification requirements for that other position.
civil79-u6d33b92d7cd19aa9af-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-ua8ecd6c0357d9918b4-1.text: 8. Transfer with demotion in the cases provided for by points 3–5, 9 and 12–14 of part 5 of this Article is permitted only if transfer is impossible to a civil service position in the same category and group as the current position, with an official salary no lower than that of the current position.
civil79-ua8ecd6c0357d9918b4-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u2747dc31dd8e1c1ded-1.text: 9. Transfer to another civil service position in the same state body under this Article is formalized by a legal act of the state body and accompanied by amendment of the service contract through a supplementary agreement.
civil79-u2747dc31dd8e1c1ded-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u1252061aa5874d659e-1.text: 10. If transfer to another civil service position under points 3–5, 8, 9 and 12–14 of part 5 of this Article is impossible because no such position exists, or if the civil servant refuses transfer under this Article, the civil servant is subject to dismissal from the civil service unless otherwise provided by federal laws. In these cases the service contract is terminated, the civil servant is released from the position held and dismissed under point 8 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law, unless another ground for dismissal is expressly established by this Federal Law; by decision of the employer's representative and with the civil servant's consent, the civil servant is included in the personnel reserve (except the federal civil service personnel reserve), except in the case provided for by point 8 of part 5 of this Article.
civil79-u1252061aa5874d659e-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u36474f98c502d21260-1.text: 11. Reassignment to another structural subdivision of the same state body in the same locality is not a transfer to another civil service position and does not require the civil servant's consent if it does not change the terms of the service contract, except the term concerning the place of civil service.
civil79-u36474f98c502d21260-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-uadde5befe814bbb276-1.text: 12. Before the service contract is terminated in connection with transfer to another state body, the civil servant may withdraw their application or consent at any time.
civil79-uadde5befe814bbb276-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-ub47bff0b07f1b57777-1.text: 13. A civil servant who is subject to an internal service inquiry or a check of compliance with restrictions, prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and performance of duties established to combat corruption by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws may not be transferred to another position in the same state body or to another state body. The exception is transfer, in the cases specified in points 3–6, 9, 10, 13 and 14 of part 5 of this Article, to a position in the same state body with an official salary not exceeding that of the position currently held.
civil79-ub47bff0b07f1b57777-1.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

civil79-u043dfc278e4d8975ae-1.text: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
civil79-u043dfc278e4d8975ae-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-udf22d8d4187debd87d-1.text: 1. If changes in a civil servant's professional service conditions make it impossible to retain the service contract terms, those terms may be changed on the employer's representative's initiative, with the civil servant's written consent, without changing the civil servant's official duties.
civil79-udf22d8d4187debd87d-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-u3b85d72b2eb1988b0d-1.text: 2. Reasons for changes in professional service conditions entailing changes to service contract terms without changes to official duties include:
civil79-u3b85d72b2eb1988b0d-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-u1a043406ba862c67a8-1.text: 1) inclusion of the position held in the list of civil service positions subject to rotation, or removal of the position from that list;
civil79-u1a043406ba862c67a8-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-u8545972c9660c2bdf8-1.text: 2) relocation to another locality of the state body or its structural subdivision in which the civil servant holds a position;
civil79-u8545972c9660c2bdf8-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-ud8cf2efa1227871113-1.text: 3) changes to remuneration terms in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
civil79-ud8cf2efa1227871113-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-u0abaef0aabdf68ecad-1.text: 4) changes to the legislation of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u0abaef0aabdf68ecad-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-u068565e68fdafa60bf-1.text: 5) changes to the service contract terms provided for by point 7 of part 2 of Article 24 of this Federal Law.
civil79-u068565e68fdafa60bf-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-u4aad5b636a5ffc4f05-1.text: 3. The employer's representative must notify the civil servant in writing of forthcoming changes to the service contract terms and the reasons for them at least two months before they take effect, except for the changes provided for by points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article.
civil79-u4aad5b636a5ffc4f05-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-u4936392cd5c412347e-1.text: 4. If a civil servant does not agree to continue state service relations in the current position because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract, other than the changes in points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article, and the state body has other vacant civil service positions retaining those professional service conditions, the employer's representative must offer those vacancies in writing against acknowledgement of receipt, taking account of the category and group of the current position, provided that the civil servant meets the qualification requirements for the position.
civil79-u4936392cd5c412347e-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-u469204cb8137fc790a-1.text: 5. If a civil servant refuses in writing to continue state service relations in the current position because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract terms specified in points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article, the service contract is terminated under point 7 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law.
civil79-u469204cb8137fc790a-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-ufe72bc934029d2c55a-1.text: 6. If the civil servant refuses in writing another civil service position offered because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract, or if no such position exists in the same state body, the service contract is terminated under point 7 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law.
civil79-ufe72bc934029d2c55a-1.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions

civil79-u996b5f6e5b3d636219-1.text: Article 30. Temporary filling of another civil service position
civil79-u996b5f6e5b3d636219-1.locator: Article 30. Temporary filling of another civil service position

civil79-u6183e765b8e6000eba-1.text: 1. In the event of service necessity, the employer's representative may transfer a civil servant for up to one month to a civil service position in the same state body not specified in the service contract, with remuneration for the temporary position but not below the previously established remuneration. Such transfer is permitted to prevent a catastrophe or industrial accident, remedy the consequences of a catastrophe, industrial accident or natural disaster, prevent accidents, temporary suspension of professional service activity for economic, technological, technical or organizational reasons, or destruction of or damage to property, and to replace a temporarily absent civil servant. The civil servant may not be transferred to another position contraindicated for health reasons.
civil79-u6183e765b8e6000eba-1.locator: Article 30. Temporary filling of another civil service position

civil79-ub06f8c3eed90b8cb97-1.text: 2. Transfer to replace a temporarily absent civil servant may not exceed one month in a calendar year.
civil79-ub06f8c3eed90b8cb97-1.locator: Article 30. Temporary filling of another civil service position

civil79-u7c08f9258ac3525c38-1.text: 3. By agreement of the parties to the service contract, the employer's representative may appoint the civil servant to a position not specified in that contract which was previously held by a temporarily absent civil servant, including a position in a higher group, setting the official salary for the temporary position but no lower than that of the previous position, paying the supplements established for the temporary position and providing state social guarantees.
civil79-u7c08f9258ac3525c38-1.locator: Article 30. Temporary filling of another civil service position

civil79-u9e88598f5329d6054b-1.text: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
civil79-u9e88598f5329d6054b-1.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body

civil79-u4b21f15688dc64f2d3-1.text: 1. Upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body, state service relations continue if the civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in the body being abolished is offered, with their written consent, another civil service position in the same state body, in the state body receiving the abolished body's functions, or in another state body, taking account of:
civil79-u4b21f15688dc64f2d3-1.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body

civil79-ua3cb6c2a76a5c4c1ac-1.text: 1) the civil servant's professional level, specialty, field of training and length of civil service or work in the specialty or field of training;
civil79-ua3cb6c2a76a5c4c1ac-1.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body

civil79-ueee319232989a9d918-1.text: 2) the level of professional education and length of civil service or work in the specialty or field of training, provided that the civil servant receives additional professional education corresponding to the field and type of professional service activity of the position offered.
civil79-ueee319232989a9d918-1.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body

civil79-ueb1b98edb3af69359a-1.text: 2. A civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in a state body being abolished is personally notified by the employer's representative, against acknowledgement of receipt, of the forthcoming dismissal due to reduction of positions or abolition of the body at least two months before dismissal.
civil79-ueb1b98edb3af69359a-1.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body

civil79-ucef126f284edae7ddd-1.text: 3. During the period specified in part 2 of this Article, the state body may conduct an extraordinary attestation of civil servants under Article 48 of this Federal Law. On its results, civil servants with a preferential right to hold a civil service position may be offered other civil service positions, including in another state body.
civil79-ucef126f284edae7ddd-1.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body

civil79-u01f886e514d4c233df-1.text: 4. A preferential right to hold a civil service position is given to a civil servant with a higher professional level, a specialty and field of training corresponding to the field and type of their professional service activity, longer civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training, and better results of professional service activity.
civil79-u01f886e514d4c233df-1.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body

civil79-u5c2591a5a5c726ca77-1.text: 5. Within two months after notifying a civil servant of dismissal, the employer's representative of the state body reducing civil service positions, or of the state body receiving the functions of an abolished body, must offer the civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in the abolished body all vacant civil service positions available in the same body or the body receiving those functions, respectively, taking account of the category and group of the current position, the civil servant's professional level, specialty, field of training, and length of civil service or work in the specialty or field of training. If no such positions exist in those bodies, the representative may offer vacancies in other state bodies in the manner determined by the Government of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u5c2591a5a5c726ca77-1.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body

civil79-ueda395007ec5fd1312-1.text: 6. If a civil servant refuses another civil service position offered, including in another state body, upon reduction of positions or abolition of a state body, the civil servant is released from the position held and dismissed from the civil service. The service contract is then terminated under point 8.2 of part 1 of Article 37 of this Federal Law for reduction of positions, or under point 8.3 of part 1 of Article 37 for abolition of a state body.
civil79-ueda395007ec5fd1312-1.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body

civil79-ubcf7ee53982f0cf94e-1.text: 7. With the civil servant's written consent, the employer's representative may terminate the service contract before the period specified in part 2 of this Article expires, paying additional compensation equal to retained monetary remuneration calculated proportionately to the time remaining until expiry of the dismissal notice period.
civil79-ubcf7ee53982f0cf94e-1.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body

civil79-ucb53d2c6b06dd5a4c1-1.text: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
civil79-ucb53d2c6b06dd5a4c1-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u9a8a7d5c9539e1add7-1.text: 1. The employer's representative must suspend from the civil service position held (not permit to perform official duties) a civil servant:
civil79-u9a8a7d5c9539e1add7-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u2e24fee5561ed6c6c8-1.text: 1) who reports for service under the influence of alcohol, narcotic drugs or other toxic substances;
civil79-u2e24fee5561ed6c6c8-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u1fd731eb687e2b38b6-1.text: 2) who has not undergone the prescribed training and assessment of knowledge and skills in protection of professional service activity (occupational safety);
civil79-u1fd731eb687e2b38b6-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u2ab9dd772f28333756-1.text: 3) at the request of bodies or officials authorized by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u2ab9dd772f28333756-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u72954b03d0d80e3135-1.text: 2. The employer's representative may suspend a civil servant from the position held (not permit performance of official duties) for the period of:
civil79-u72954b03d0d80e3135-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u8aab8c79fd8786dbfa-1.text: 1) resolution of a conflict of interest;
civil79-u8aab8c79fd8786dbfa-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u117e93456da52d8545-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u45b7cca2abb66481b7-1.text: а) the accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted by the civil servant under Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws;
civil79-u45b7cca2abb66481b7-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u21f623d4433398736c-1.text: б) information submitted by the civil servant upon entry into the civil service under normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u21f623d4433398736c-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u896197df0f6082a749-1.text: в) the civil servant's compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and performance of duties established by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws;
civil79-u896197df0f6082a749-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-uf270a77c0331e5ed00-1.text: 3) an internal service inquiry under Article 59 of this Federal Law.
civil79-uf270a77c0331e5ed00-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u6a6559c1bde9401444-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u603e9cb4448a27cd2f-1.text: 3. The employer's representative suspends the civil servant from the position held (does not permit performance of official duties) for the entire period until the circumstances forming the grounds for suspension (non-admission to official duties) are eliminated.
civil79-u603e9cb4448a27cd2f-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u19a51297fdafddba66-1.text: 4. During suspension from the civil service position held (non-admission to official duties) on any ground in part 1 of this Article, monetary remuneration is not retained, except in cases provided for by other federal laws. During suspension (non-admission to official duties) on any ground in part 2 of this Article, monetary remuneration for the position held is retained throughout the suspension.
civil79-u19a51297fdafddba66-1.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held

civil79-u49262abd855a45fee6-1.text: Chapter 6. GROUNDS AND CONSEQUENCES OF TERMINATION OF A SERVICE CONTRACT
civil79-u49262abd855a45fee6-1.locator: Chapter 6. GROUNDS AND CONSEQUENCES OF TERMINATION OF A SERVICE CONTRACT

civil79-u2afd1bbae63f55a3d2-1.text: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
civil79-u2afd1bbae63f55a3d2-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u84227f45377c4e6726-1.text: 1. The general grounds for termination of a service contract, release from the civil service position held and dismissal from the civil service are:
civil79-u84227f45377c4e6726-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u8e0bb62eb1bb61450a-1.text: 1) agreement of the parties to the service contract (Article 34 of this Federal Law);
civil79-u8e0bb62eb1bb61450a-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u2163e7a42bc4737899-1.text: 2) expiry of a fixed-term service contract (Article 35 of this Federal Law);
civil79-u2163e7a42bc4737899-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-ud861db0d5400258fdc-1.text: 3) termination on the civil servant's initiative (Article 36 of this Federal Law);
civil79-ud861db0d5400258fdc-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-ubca65ccc5575726361-1.text: 4) termination on the employer's representative's initiative (part 7 of Article 27 and Article 37 of this Federal Law);
civil79-ubca65ccc5575726361-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-udafc831557b84f28db-1.text: 5) transfer of the civil servant, at their request or with their consent, to another type of state service;
