civil79-udafc831557b84f28db-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-ue9d21eadb09a14d06d-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u33b45003620a31af84-1.text: 7) refusal to continue state service relations in the current position or to accept another position offered in the cases provided for by Article 29 of this Federal Law, because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract;
civil79-u33b45003620a31af84-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-ubaa6eb4e3778707a1f-1.text: 8) refusal to transfer to another civil service position, with reasons for refusal stated, or absence of such a position in the state body, as provided for by part 10 of Article 28 of this Federal Law;
civil79-ubaa6eb4e3778707a1f-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u766b88e794fe1e147b-1.text: 9) refusal to transfer to another locality together with the state body;
civil79-u766b88e794fe1e147b-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-uf697168c7b2aeedf12-1.text: 10) circumstances beyond the control of the parties to the service contract (Article 39 of this Federal Law);
civil79-uf697168c7b2aeedf12-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-uc61a17e25b0a15f213-1.text: 11) breach of mandatory rules for concluding a service contract established by this Federal Law or other federal laws, if the breach precludes holding the civil service position (Article 40 of this Federal Law);
civil79-uc61a17e25b0a15f213-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-udecf79d8085da3f5f9-1.text: 12) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or possession of foreign citizenship (nationality), a residence permit or another document confirming the citizen's right to permanent residence in a foreign State (Article 41 of this Federal Law);
civil79-udecf79d8085da3f5f9-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u39d0c40a29e604e46f-1.text: 13) failure to comply with restrictions or fulfil obligations established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
civil79-u39d0c40a29e604e46f-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u157a04343a41805f0e-1.text: 14) violation of civil-service-related prohibitions provided for by Article 17 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u157a04343a41805f0e-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u1f6bb8c6b19f9c6d62-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u059bb7f4e804072bd1-1.text: 1.1. A general ground for termination of a service contract and release from the position held is transfer of the civil servant, at their request or with their consent, to another civil service position in another state body in the cases provided for by part 6 of Article 28 of this Federal Law.
civil79-u059bb7f4e804072bd1-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-ufc6e3db5d18f785060-1.text: 2. Termination of a service contract, release from the civil service position held and dismissal from the civil service are formalized by a legal act of the state body.
civil79-ufc6e3db5d18f785060-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u0b590eadc4c567b175-1.text: 3. On the final day of the civil servant's performance of official duties, the employer's representative must issue the work record book or provide employment history information for the period of civil service in that state body and make the final settlement. On the civil servant's written application, the employer's representative must also issue other documents relating to civil service and pension provision.
civil79-u0b590eadc4c567b175-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-u054f86a606d9e1314a-1.text: 4. Employment history information is provided by the method specified in the civil servant's application: duly certified on paper, or as an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature if the employer's representative has one. The civil servant submits the application in writing or sends it to the employer's representative's email address in the manner established by that representative.
civil79-u054f86a606d9e1314a-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-uc9baf0ffa6f483b25d-1.text: 5. On the day of release from the civil service position and/or dismissal from the civil service, the civil servant must surrender the official service identity card to the state body's subdivision responsible for state service and personnel.
civil79-uc9baf0ffa6f483b25d-1.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service

civil79-uf4813d5721c99a22ed-1.text: Article 34. Termination of a service contract by agreement of the parties
civil79-uf4813d5721c99a22ed-1.locator: Article 34. Termination of a service contract by agreement of the parties

civil79-uf103fda624988af65d-1.text: A service contract may be terminated at any time by agreement of its parties, with simultaneous release of the civil servant from the position held and dismissal from the civil service.
civil79-uf103fda624988af65d-1.locator: Article 34. Termination of a service contract by agreement of the parties

civil79-u05f99f5d26d2898edd-1.text: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract
civil79-u05f99f5d26d2898edd-1.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract

civil79-ud6bd41d1c1cf1c7c47-1.text: 1. A fixed-term service contract is terminated upon expiry. Unless otherwise established by this Federal Law, the civil servant must be notified in writing at least seven days before release from the position held and dismissal from the civil service.
civil79-ud6bd41d1c1cf1c7c47-1.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract

civil79-u2e07b754e65007c2f7-1.text: 2. A fixed-term service contract concluded for the performance of a specified assignment is terminated upon completion of that assignment, and the civil servant is released from the position held and dismissed from the civil service.
civil79-u2e07b754e65007c2f7-1.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract

civil79-u8230da38ef37eb9386-1.text: 3. A fixed-term service contract concluded to replace an absent civil servant whose position is retained under this Federal Law is terminated when that civil servant returns to service; the replacement is released from the position and dismissed from the civil service.
civil79-u8230da38ef37eb9386-1.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract

civil79-u8e561d092f0bef0c22-1.text: 4. Upon expiry of the prescribed term of office of a civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ or ‘assistants (advisers)’ category, the civil servant may be appointed to the position previously held or another civil service position, except where the civil servant has committed culpable acts, if such a condition is provided for by the fixed-term service contract.
civil79-u8e561d092f0bef0c22-1.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract

civil79-u1276a564207b0dd46f-1.text: 5. When a fixed-term service contract for a position held through rotation is terminated, and the civil servant is released from the position and dismissed in the cases specified in part 9 of Article 60.1 of this Federal Law, compensation equal to four months' monetary remuneration is paid. No severance allowance is paid in addition.
civil79-u1276a564207b0dd46f-1.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract

civil79-ufe65b12fb02eb88d36-1.text: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
civil79-ufe65b12fb02eb88d36-1.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative

civil79-u35b2fd633397f3b92f-1.text: 1. A civil servant may terminate the service contract and leave the civil service on their own initiative by giving the employer's representative two weeks' written notice.
civil79-u35b2fd633397f3b92f-1.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative

civil79-uc2a67451f44a0b3696-1.text: 2. Where the civil servant's application to terminate the service contract and leave the civil service on their own initiative is due to inability to continue official duties and civil service (enrolment in an organization conducting educational activities, retirement, taking up an elected office or other circumstances), or where the employer's representative has been found to have violated laws, other normative legal acts or the service contract, the employer's representative must terminate the contract on the date specified in the civil servant's application.
civil79-uc2a67451f44a0b3696-1.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative

civil79-ue18377c626cf0ad22e-1.text: 3. Before the notice period for termination and departure expires, the civil servant may withdraw the application at any time. Release from the position and dismissal do not take place unless another civil servant or citizen has been invited to take that position.
civil79-ue18377c626cf0ad22e-1.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative

civil79-u18dc65fb4ccfe8005b-1.text: 4. After the notice period for termination of the service contract and departure from the civil service expires, the civil servant may cease performing official duties.
civil79-u18dc65fb4ccfe8005b-1.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative

civil79-ud7de1dbc7dbc42d6e5-1.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative

civil79-u65fdc4ff1c4d81b66f-1.text: 6. Upon termination of the service contract and dismissal, the civil servant is removed from the state body's register of civil servants, and their personnel file is deposited in the state body's archive in the prescribed manner.
civil79-u65fdc4ff1c4d81b66f-1.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative

civil79-udf7ce2749f18404b98-1.text: 7. By agreement between the civil servant and the employer's representative, the civil servant may be released from the position and dismissed before the period specified in this Article expires.
civil79-udf7ce2749f18404b98-1.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative

civil79-uc549f85dfe3a6c7998-1.text: 8. On the civil servant's written application, release from the position and dismissal take place after annual paid leave has been granted or after the period of temporary incapacity for work ends.
civil79-uc549f85dfe3a6c7998-1.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative

civil79-u5d24ed1cd191682a79-1.text: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
civil79-u5d24ed1cd191682a79-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-uddac5a6f4ef3e29ca0-1.text: 1. The employer's representative may terminate the service contract, release the civil servant from the position held and dismiss them from the civil service in the event of:
civil79-uddac5a6f4ef3e29ca0-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-ub76c4aa18cebd54448-1.text: 1) the civil servant's unsuitability for the position held:
civil79-ub76c4aa18cebd54448-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u218a75ce00159f83f0-1.text: а) on health grounds in accordance with a medical report;
civil79-u218a75ce00159f83f0-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u054d2972d806093fbc-1.text: б) owing to an insufficient professional level confirmed by the results of attestation;
civil79-u054d2972d806093fbc-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u40ef13d3b8f740a193-1.text: 1.1) loss of the employer's representative's confidence in the civil servant in cases of non-compliance with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to perform duties established for the purpose of combating corruption by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws;
civil79-u40ef13d3b8f740a193-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u6a2cad20b0ac7fbf09-1.text: 2) repeated failure by a civil servant to perform official duties without valid reasons, if the civil servant has a disciplinary sanction;
civil79-u6a2cad20b0ac7fbf09-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-ue009857e018a6966d3-1.text: 3) a single gross breach of official duties by a civil servant:
civil79-ue009857e018a6966d3-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-ub2fda983086dc3e9ab-1.text: а) absenteeism (absence from the place of civil service without valid reasons for more than four consecutive hours during a service day);
civil79-ub2fda983086dc3e9ab-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-uee66cdcf3785949e28-1.text: б) reporting for service in a state of intoxication by alcohol, narcotics or other toxic substances;
civil79-uee66cdcf3785949e28-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-uf8f510a4aea5d3b8cb-1.text: в) disclosure of information constituting a state secret or another secret protected by federal law, and of official information, which became known to the civil servant in connection with the performance of official duties;
civil79-uf8f510a4aea5d3b8cb-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u29083afde397308ab0-1.text: г) theft (including petty theft) of another person's property, misappropriation, or intentional destruction of or damage to such property at the place of civil service, established by a court judgment that has entered into legal force or a resolution of a body authorized to consider cases of administrative offences;
civil79-u29083afde397308ab0-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u21fb2dd3addd24daf9-1.text: д) breach by a civil servant of the requirements for protection of professional service activities (occupational safety), if that breach caused grave consequences (an accident in service, a major accident or a disaster) or knowingly created a real threat of such consequences;
civil79-u21fb2dd3addd24daf9-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u0a3943df73df2c092d-1.text: 4) culpable acts by a civil servant directly handling monetary or commodity valuables, if those acts give the employer's representative grounds for losing confidence in the civil servant;
civil79-u0a3943df73df2c092d-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-ude09bd1991bb62b9f1-1.text: 5) adoption by a civil servant holding a civil service position in the ‘managers’ category of an unfounded decision that resulted in failure to safeguard property, its unlawful use or other damage to the property of the state body;
civil79-ude09bd1991bb62b9f1-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u20eec6b054a49bc14c-1.text: 6) a single gross breach of official duties by a civil servant holding a civil service position in the ‘managers’ category, resulting in harm to the state body and (or) a breach of the legislation of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u20eec6b054a49bc14c-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u8c86a1198fd5f1de56-1.text: 7) submission by a civil servant, upon entry into civil service and (or) during service, of forged documents and (or) knowingly false information confirming compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements whose breach precludes holding a civil service position, or failure by the civil servant to submit documents and (or) information indicating non-compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements whose breach precludes holding a civil service position;
civil79-u8c86a1198fd5f1de56-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u3bf0b4089d7d0ce15b-1.text: 8) termination of a civil servant's clearance for information constituting a state secret, or refusal to grant such clearance to a civil servant, if the performance of official duties requires access to such information;
civil79-u3bf0b4089d7d0ce15b-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u05eff08259471177c9-1.text: 8.1) absence from service for more than four consecutive months due to temporary incapacity for work, unless the legislation of the Russian Federation establishes a longer period for retaining the job (position) in the case of a particular illness or provides guarantees for retaining the job (position) for a particular category of citizens;
civil79-u05eff08259471177c9-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-uc72ecc860863884fbe-1.text: 8.2) reduction of civil service positions in a state body;
civil79-uc72ecc860863884fbe-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-uec0e47d330f78139f4-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-ud6f19df6cde5400e27-1.text: 8.4) failure by a civil servant to return to service upon the expiry of three months after completing military service upon mobilization, service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or military service under a contract concluded during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or after the expiry of a contract concluded by the civil servant for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, taking into account extension of that period by the period of the civil servant's temporary incapacity for work;
civil79-ud6f19df6cde5400e27-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u36051bc52ef8c0c0f1-1.text: 9) in other cases provided for by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
civil79-u36051bc52ef8c0c0f1-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u8f6eef366794785186-1.text: 2. Dismissal from civil service on the grounds provided for in points 1 and 8 of part 1 of this Article is permitted if it is impossible to transfer the civil servant, with their consent, to another civil service position.
civil79-u8f6eef366794785186-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u07c4b1021b806bb6d8-1.text: 2.1. Dismissal from civil service on the ground provided for in point 8 of part 1 of this Article is permitted if it is impossible to transfer the civil servant, with their consent, to another civil service position in the same state body in the case provided for in point 5 of part 5 of Article 28 of this Federal Law.
civil79-u07c4b1021b806bb6d8-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u911a23b68d1f38bf06-1.text: 3. A civil servant may not be released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service at the initiative of the employer's representative while on leave, during absence from service due to temporary incapacity for work for less than the periods specified in point 8.1 of part 1 of this Article, or during temporary incapacity for work due to injury, occupational disease or other damage to health connected with the performance of official duties, irrespective of the duration of that period.
civil79-u911a23b68d1f38bf06-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u173cc2c325a211f358-1.text: 3.1. If a service contract is terminated on the grounds provided for in points 8.1–8.3 of part 1 of this Article, the civil servant shall be paid compensation equal to four months' monetary remuneration. No severance allowance shall be paid in that case.
civil79-u173cc2c325a211f358-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-ud40f34f4f21339a448-1.text: 3.2. A civil servant dismissed from a state body located in the Far North or equivalent localities on the grounds provided for in points 8.2 and 8.3 of part 1 of this Article shall, in addition to the compensation specified in part 3.1 of this Article, be paid compensation for the fifth and sixth months from the date of dismissal by decision of the employment service body, provided that the civil servant applied to that body within one month after dismissal and was not placed in employment by it. That compensation shall be paid by the employer's representative of the state body in which the civil servant held a civil service position, from the funds of that state body.
civil79-ud40f34f4f21339a448-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-uc9e7d18cedd3d896eb-1.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative

civil79-u27d5607dd86f957a91-1.text: Article 38. Informing the elected trade union body when terminating a service contract
civil79-u27d5607dd86f957a91-1.locator: Article 38. Informing the elected trade union body when terminating a service contract

civil79-u41d7e4fd2259ab531f-1.text: When deciding on the possible termination of a civil servant's service contract in accordance with Article 33 of this Federal Law, the employer's representative shall inform the elected trade union body of that state body in writing no later than two months before the reduction of the relevant civil service position.
civil79-u41d7e4fd2259ab531f-1.locator: Article 38. Informing the elected trade union body when terminating a service contract

civil79-u822fcffbf8d824f5e3-1.text: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
civil79-u822fcffbf8d824f5e3-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-uf814e715ae8e9851be-1.text: 1. The service contract shall be terminated, the civil servant released from the civil service position held, dismissed from civil service and, with their consent, included in a personnel reserve, other than the federal civil service personnel reserve, in connection with:
civil79-uf814e715ae8e9851be-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-ucaa0abef15b690dc35-1.text: 1) conscription of the civil servant for military service, other than conscription upon mobilization, or assignment to alternative civilian service;
civil79-ucaa0abef15b690dc35-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-u166e8fe218753d825e-1.text: 2) reinstatement, by court decision, of a civil servant who previously held that civil service position (if it is impossible to transfer the civil servant to another civil service position in accordance with Article 28 of this Federal Law);
civil79-u166e8fe218753d825e-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-u404c4b5e296d567d9f-1.text: 3) election or appointment of the civil servant to a state office, except in the case established by part 2 of Article 4 of Federal Constitutional Law No. 4-ФКЗ of 6 November 2020 ‘On the Government of the Russian Federation’, or to a municipal office, or election of the civil servant to a paid elective position in a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body;
civil79-u404c4b5e296d567d9f-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-u6b148b46d9f7b22c75-1.text: 4) occurrence of extraordinary circumstances preventing the continuation of relations connected with civil service (military operations, a disaster, a natural calamity, a major accident, an epidemic or other extraordinary circumstances), if the circumstance is recognized as extraordinary by a decision of the President of the Russian Federation or a state authority of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u6b148b46d9f7b22c75-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-u9368a117dfc073d964-1.text: 5) performance by the civil servant of state duties in cases established by federal law.
civil79-u9368a117dfc073d964-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-uc4cfb260826ee28ecf-1.text: 2. The service contract shall be terminated, the civil servant released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service in connection with:
civil79-uc4cfb260826ee28ecf-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-ucdf2e49da718a361c7-1.text: 1) imposition on the civil servant, by a court judgment that has entered into legal force, of a punishment precluding the possibility of holding a civil service position;
civil79-ucdf2e49da718a361c7-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-u512d978830aaca20fe-1.text: 2) recognition of the civil servant as completely incapable of work in accordance with a medical report issued under the procedure established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u512d978830aaca20fe-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-u98af7c94e3819851db-1.text: 3) recognition of the civil servant as legally incapable or as having limited legal capacity by a court decision that has entered into legal force;
civil79-u98af7c94e3819851db-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-u37489894e8681fa41b-1.text: 4) attainment by the civil servant of the maximum age for civil service, except where, in accordance with part 1 of Article 25.1 of this Federal Law, the civil servant's term of civil service has been extended beyond the established maximum age for civil service;
civil79-u37489894e8681fa41b-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-u52f08ac4808a8a2135-1.text: 5) imposition on the civil servant of the administrative penalty of disqualification;
civil79-u52f08ac4808a8a2135-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-ucc8e908ef6603821f2-1.text: 6) acquisition by the civil servant of the status of a foreign agent.
civil79-ucc8e908ef6603821f2-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-ubbc16fb439b84a2924-1.text: 3. The service contract shall be terminated in the event of the civil servant's death (including death in the performance of duties), or recognition of the civil servant as missing or declaration of the civil servant as dead by a court decision that has entered into legal force.
civil79-ubbc16fb439b84a2924-1.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control

civil79-ub820d287dd54b4f4dd-1.text: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract
civil79-ub820d287dd54b4f4dd-1.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract

civil79-uc5e4e17e6552058e9f-1.text: 1. A service contract shall be terminated due to breach of the mandatory rules for its conclusion established by this Federal Law or other federal laws, if the breach precludes the civil servant from continuing to hold a civil service position and perform civil service, in the event of:
civil79-uc5e4e17e6552058e9f-1.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract

civil79-u4c53bce606e2cf7688-1.text: 1) conclusion of a service contract in breach of a court judgment that has entered into legal force depriving a person of the right to hold certain civil service positions or engage in certain activities;
civil79-u4c53bce606e2cf7688-1.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract

civil79-u9b929680a73527c113-1.text: 2) conclusion of a service contract for the performance of official duties contraindicated for the person on health grounds in accordance with a medical report;
civil79-u9b929680a73527c113-1.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract

civil79-u7993c55af9366baec5-1.text: 3) absence of the appropriate document certifying education and qualifications, where the performance of official duties requires special knowledge in accordance with this Federal Law or another regulatory legal act;
civil79-u7993c55af9366baec5-1.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract

civil79-u86cbd486e877ac5692-1.text: 4) other cases provided for by federal law.
civil79-u86cbd486e877ac5692-1.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract

civil79-ua4b9b5659b8d7510e9-1.text: 2. If the service contract is terminated in accordance with point 11 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law, the employer's representative shall pay the civil servant one month's monetary remuneration if the breach of the rules for concluding the service contract was not the civil servant's fault.
civil79-ua4b9b5659b8d7510e9-1.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract

civil79-u6bf619edb0d32757cb-1.text: Article 41. Termination of a service contract in connection with termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen's right to permanent residence in the territory of a foreign state
civil79-u6bf619edb0d32757cb-1.locator: Article 41. Termination of a service contract in connection with termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen's right to permanent residence in the territory of a foreign state

civil79-u24ae922d7ad878bb44-1.text: 1. The service contract shall be terminated, the civil servant released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service by decision of the employer's representative as from the day on which the employer's representative learned that the civil servant's citizenship of the Russian Federation had terminated.
civil79-u24ae922d7ad878bb44-1.locator: Article 41. Termination of a service contract in connection with termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen's right to permanent residence in the territory of a foreign state

civil79-u08a5da00dc27a30feb-1.text: 2. The service contract shall be terminated, the civil servant released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service by decision of the employer's representative as from the day on which the employer's representative learned that the civil servant possesses citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen's right to permanent residence in the territory of a foreign state, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u08a5da00dc27a30feb-1.locator: Article 41. Termination of a service contract in connection with termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen's right to permanent residence in the territory of a foreign state

civil79-u94ff7a3d0edb00fd95-1.text: Chapter 7. PERSONAL DATA OF A CIVIL SERVANT. THE PERSONNEL SERVICE OF A STATE BODY
civil79-u94ff7a3d0edb00fd95-1.locator: Chapter 7. PERSONAL DATA OF A CIVIL SERVANT. THE PERSONNEL SERVICE OF A STATE BODY

civil79-u9620d93dd6ce8fa4b4-1.text: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
civil79-u9620d93dd6ce8fa4b4-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-ud1be0a832e5dca27d6-1.text: 1. When processing a civil servant's personal data, the personnel service of a state body shall comply with the following requirements:
civil79-ud1be0a832e5dca27d6-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-u956e92d1ee60f9b75f-1.text: 1) a civil servant's personal data shall be processed to ensure compliance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, this Federal Law, the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, to assist the civil servant in performing civil service, training and career advancement, to ensure the personal safety of the civil servant and their family members, and to safeguard the civil servant's property, record the results of performance of official duties and safeguard the property of the state body;
civil79-u956e92d1ee60f9b75f-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-u917f1a3728e2f86176-1.text: 2) personal data shall be obtained directly from the civil servant. If it becomes necessary to obtain a civil servant's personal data from a third party, the civil servant shall be informed in advance, their written consent shall be obtained, and the civil servant shall be informed of the purposes, intended sources and methods of obtaining the personal data;
civil79-u917f1a3728e2f86176-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-u5d832e5b727e54c00c-1.text: 3) processing and adding to a civil servant's personal file personal data on their political, religious or other beliefs, private life, or membership of public associations, including trade unions, which are not provided for by this Federal Law or other federal laws, is prohibited;
civil79-u5d832e5b727e54c00c-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-u5f7ced85e8b2de3cf7-1.text: 4) decisions producing legal consequences for a civil servant or otherwise affecting their rights and legitimate interests may not be based on the civil servant's personal data obtained solely as a result of automated processing, except in cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data;
civil79-u5f7ced85e8b2de3cf7-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-udf4a34e34d869c68e7-1.text: 5) protection of a civil servant's personal data against unlawful use or loss shall be provided from the funds of the state body under the procedure established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
civil79-udf4a34e34d869c68e7-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-ud2638d5f9fe46de2f1-1.text: 6) a civil servant's personal data may not be transferred to a third party without the civil servant's written consent, except in cases established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data. The conditions for transfer of a civil servant's personal data to a third party shall be established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
civil79-ud2638d5f9fe46de2f1-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-uaafb4b3b6c6d90d12f-1.text: 2. A civil servant responsible for breaching the rules governing the processing of another civil servant's personal data shall be liable in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws.
civil79-uaafb4b3b6c6d90d12f-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-u9f67427714fff2d39b-1.text: 3. A civil servant's personal file shall contain their personal data and other information connected with entry into, performance of and dismissal from civil service that is necessary to support the activities of the state body.
civil79-u9f67427714fff2d39b-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-u22d20b00f46a107af6-1.text: 4. The regulations on personal data of a state civil servant of the Russian Federation and maintenance of their personal file shall be approved by the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u22d20b00f46a107af6-1.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file

civil79-uf5d83d12f24b118dfe-1.text: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation
civil79-uf5d83d12f24b118dfe-1.locator: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation

civil79-u5964d62100ebbfeb20-1.text: 1. The employer's representative shall maintain a register of civil servants.
civil79-u5964d62100ebbfeb20-1.locator: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation

civil79-u8b2f1d007be046ae4c-1.text: 2. Information from a civil servant's personal file shall be entered in the register of civil servants of the state body and stored in databases of the state information systems provided for in Article 44.1 of this Federal Law, with protection against unauthorized access and copying.
civil79-u8b2f1d007be046ae4c-1.locator: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation

civil79-u11811a94163cc579f4-1.text: 3. A civil servant who has died (including in the performance of duties), or has been recognized as missing or declared dead by a court decision that has entered into legal force, shall be removed from the register of civil servants on the day following the day of death or the day on which the court decision entered into legal force.
civil79-u11811a94163cc579f4-1.locator: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation

civil79-u04a2f9a769a797d5bf-1.locator: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation

civil79-u0503b939190f6d5d13-1.text: 1) forming the personnel complement to fill civil service positions, including recruiting and attracting personnel, assessing the professional level of applicants for civil service positions and checking compliance with the qualification requirements for such positions;

civil79-u37c6ab17ab6cc4e38c-1.text: 2) preparing proposals for implementing the provisions of this Federal Law, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts on civil service, and submitting those proposals to the employer's representative;

civil79-u98746441b2caa513f2-1.text: 3) organizing the preparation of draft acts of the state body concerning entry into and performance of civil service, conclusion of a service contract, appointment to a civil service position, release from a civil service position, dismissal from civil service and retirement on a length-of-service pension, and formalizing the corresponding decisions of the state body;

civil79-u1e813a8e9d9c419afd-1.text: 4) maintaining civil servants' employment record books (where available), compiling information on their employment activities during civil service and submitting that information, under the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on individual (personalized) records in the compulsory pension insurance system, for storage in the information resources of the Pension and Social Insurance Fund of the Russian Federation;

civil79-u04282432bdfa58877b-1.text: 6) maintaining the register of civil servants of the state body;

civil79-ub6242092031edd728a-1.text: 7) preparing and issuing civil servants' official identity cards;

civil79-u2681aa1ef9e4d5f46d-1.text: 8) supporting the activities of the commission for resolving conflicts of interest;

civil79-u139d3746d358dd1c61-1.text: 9) organizing and supporting competitions to fill vacant civil service positions and to include civil servants and citizens in the personnel reserve;

civil79-u647ebbc7db3a12a7c3-1.text: 10) organizing and supporting the attestation of civil servants;

civil79-u54928d99aab18dc758-1.text: 12) organizing the conclusion of targeted education agreements;

civil79-u328733c105ff442cd8-1.text: 14) forming the personnel reserve, organizing work with it and ensuring its effective use;

civil79-uaf2e80958cb67a3943-1.text: 16) organizing and conducting checks of information submitted by a citizen upon entry into civil service and by a civil servant during service;

civil79-u5e1098b1def6fd2a6e-1.text: 16.1) processing clearance of the prescribed form for access to information constituting a state secret;

civil79-u6eb48e20a40a02738f-1.text: 18) organizing checks of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and of civil servants' compliance with the restrictions established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;

civil79-u253de534e165607171-1.text: 19) advising civil servants on legal and other civil service matters.

civil79-u4ee27eba6e45e7da21-1.text: 2. The regulations on the state body's unit responsible for state service and personnel shall be approved by the head of the state body.

civil79-u7686641bd5e9c62311-1.text: 3. The state information systems provided for in Article 44.1 of this Federal Law shall be used in personnel work.

civil79-u45f9ff5870e9664803-1.text: Article 44.1. State information systems used in civil service
civil79-u45f9ff5870e9664803-1.locator: Article 44.1. State information systems used in civil service

civil79-u877533c29b37e709ab-1.text: 1. A federal state information system in the field of state service shall be used to provide information support for federal civil service and optimize the work of personnel services of federal state bodies and public authorities of a federal territory. The procedure for using the federal state information system in the field of state service shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u877533c29b37e709ab-1.locator: Article 44.1. State information systems used in civil service

civil79-u5797b40f2dad176db9-1.text: 2. Specific features of using the federal state information system in the field of state service in individual federal state bodies shall be determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u5797b40f2dad176db9-1.locator: Article 44.1. State information systems used in civil service

civil79-uf6549d64c13c04a242-1.text: 3. To provide information support for the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation and optimize the work of personnel services of its state bodies, a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity shall provide for use of the federal state information system in the field of state service or for creation of a state information system in the field of civil service of the constituent entity. The latter system must be compatible with the federal state information system in the field of state service and meet unified requirements for the scope and content of information on staffing state bodies that is to be stored, processed and transmitted electronically. Those requirements shall be established by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation.
civil79-uf6549d64c13c04a242-1.locator: Article 44.1. State information systems used in civil service

civil79-uf3394d1a0d4defa9c0-1.text: Chapter 8. SERVICE TIME AND REST TIME
civil79-uf3394d1a0d4defa9c0-1.locator: Chapter 8. SERVICE TIME AND REST TIME

civil79-ube0088ac4a83297e91-1.text: Article 45. Service time and rest time
civil79-ube0088ac4a83297e91-1.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time

civil79-u237f70403e13744c98-1.text: 1. Service time means the time during which a civil servant must perform official duties in accordance with the internal service rules of the state body, the service schedule or the terms of the service contract, as well as other periods classified as service time by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts.
civil79-u237f70403e13744c98-1.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time

civil79-u8049d2060cd7568b26-1.text: 2. The normal duration of service time for a civil servant may not exceed 40 hours per week. A five-day service week shall be established for civil servants.
civil79-u8049d2060cd7568b26-1.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time

civil79-u36f30192f21fc7605f-1.text: 3. An irregular service day shall be established for civil servants holding positions in the highest and principal groups of civil service positions. For civil servants holding positions in other groups, an irregular service day shall be established in accordance with the internal service rules of the state body, the corresponding list of positions and the service contract.
civil79-u36f30192f21fc7605f-1.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time

civil79-u03f2ae7172493c5776-1.text: 4. Civil servants subject to an irregular service day shall be granted additional annual paid leave for irregular service days in accordance with Article 46 of this Federal Law.
civil79-u03f2ae7172493c5776-1.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time

civil79-uce20aad3e1856c17f5-1.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time

civil79-u4f20a9aead6a4d7de1-1.text: 6. The right to rest shall be exercised by providing civil servants with time free from official duties (free time) outside the normal duration of service time established by this Federal Law.
civil79-u4f20a9aead6a4d7de1-1.locator: Article 45. Service time and rest time

civil79-ue8a28734a9b09073c4-1.text: 1. A civil servant shall be granted annual leave with retention of the civil service position held and monetary remuneration.

civil79-u35411561ee904f7448-1.text: 2. A civil servant's annual paid leave shall consist of basic paid leave and additional paid leave.

civil79-ub9b97ca865f6aed11f-1.text: 3. Civil servants shall be granted basic annual paid leave of 30 calendar days.

civil79-ua3e619bd0d22633159-1.text: 5. Civil servants shall be granted additional annual paid leave for length of service of the following duration:

civil79-u3f04857643be5ee5bf-1.text: 1) for civil service length from 1 year to 5 years — 1 calendar day;

civil79-u827082aceb3492c58f-1.text: 2) for civil service length from 5 to 10 years — 5 calendar days;

civil79-u8750b3448b744c74ff-1.text: 3) for civil service length from 10 to 15 years — 7 calendar days;

civil79-u909569ddea73ba3211-1.text: 4) for civil service length of 15 years or more — 10 calendar days.

civil79-u2027729981b6f91d0e-1.text: 6. In calculating the total duration of annual paid leave, basic annual paid leave shall be added to additional annual paid leave for length of service.

civil79-u1a83e0f0e03c947689-1.text: Additional leave for irregular service days and for arduous, harmful and (or) hazardous civil service conditions shall be granted in addition to the annual paid leave provided for in this part.

civil79-u570e1fe836338b4062-1.text: 6.1. Civil servants subject to an irregular service day shall be granted additional annual paid leave for irregular service days of three calendar days.

civil79-uedff8659fbab515493-1.text: 7. A civil servant shall be granted additional annual paid leave for arduous, harmful and (or) hazardous civil service conditions, including service in localities with special climatic conditions, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.

civil79-ud6c57f3bbb2b68344f-1.text: 9. Annual paid leave must be granted to a civil servant each year in accordance with the leave schedule approved by the employer's representative.

civil79-u4064cd81305b62869c-1.text: 9.1. The minimum duration of annual paid leave taken by a civil servant in the service year for which it is granted may not be less than 28 calendar days. At least one portion of the annual paid leave must be at least 14 calendar days.

civil79-u12fcc21bbaaba981fa-1.text: 9.2. In exceptional cases, if granting a civil servant annual paid leave in the current service year for the total duration calculated in accordance with part 6 of this Article may adversely affect the performance of the state body's tasks and functions or the exercise of the powers of a person holding a state office, the portion of annual paid leave exceeding 28 calendar days may, by decision of the employer's representative and with the civil servant's written consent, be carried over to the next service year. The portion carried over must be taken no later than 12 months after the end of the service year for which that portion of leave is granted.

civil79-ua0d7130c19b2c878ba-1.text: 9.3. The portion of annual paid leave exceeding 28 calendar days, or any number of days from that portion, may be replaced by monetary compensation upon the civil servant's written application.

civil79-u571f28b6a24742fb97-1.text: 10. A civil servant's monetary remuneration for the period of annual paid leave must be paid no later than 10 calendar days before the leave begins.

civil79-ufeff542a65a812cfe6-1.text: 11. When a federal civil servant is granted annual paid leave, a lump-sum payment equal to two monthly remuneration salaries shall be made once a year.

civil79-u62a884af9c8c4e9f33-1.text: 12. When a civil servant of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is granted annual paid leave, a lump-sum payment shall be made once a year in accordance with the legislation of that constituent entity.

civil79-u7f1f79c06e153f16b9-1.text: 13. Upon termination or cancellation of a service contract, release from the civil service position held and dismissal from civil service, the civil servant shall be paid monetary compensation for all unused leave. Upon the civil servant's written application, unused leave may be granted followed by dismissal (except where release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service are due to culpable acts). In that case, the last day of leave shall be considered the date of release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service.

civil79-u3bb674c523996fa100-1.text: 14. In the event of dismissal due to expiry of the service contract, leave followed by dismissal may also be granted where the leave falls wholly or partly beyond the term of the service contract. In that case, the last day of leave shall likewise be considered the date of release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service.

civil79-u73c1a0755fd1d853b8-1.text: 15. For family circumstances or other valid reasons, a civil servant may, upon their written application and by decision of the employer's representative, be granted leave without monetary remuneration for no more than one year. A civil servant shall also be granted leave without monetary remuneration in other cases provided for by federal laws.

civil79-u59863e1e418cd4e9cd-1.text: 16. During leave without monetary remuneration, the civil servant shall retain the civil service position held.

civil79-u1f6ec4e8769edd745a-1.text: 1. A civil servant's professional service activities shall be carried out in accordance with official duties regulations approved by the employer's representative.

civil79-u01cd04da583d91b160-1.text: 2. The official duties regulations shall include:

civil79-u12402fb9dd0331e527-1.text: 1) qualification requirements for holding the civil service position;

civil79-u2894e23defaabecb01-1.text: 3) a list of matters on which the civil servant is entitled or required to make managerial and other decisions independently;

civil79-u3c566ec9fe5e88aefe-1.text: 4) a list of matters on which the civil servant is entitled or required to participate in preparing draft regulatory legal acts and (or) draft managerial and other decisions;

civil79-uda312144c0cee6b07c-1.text: 5) time limits and procedures for preparing and considering draft managerial and other decisions, and the procedure for coordinating and adopting those decisions;

civil79-u7e6388739f1391842a-1.text: 6) the procedure for the civil servant's official interaction, in connection with the performance of official duties, with civil servants of the same state body, civil servants of other state bodies, other citizens and organizations;

civil79-u0a17038f30d72caec2-1.text: 7) a list of state services (types of activity) provided at the request of citizens and organizations in accordance with the administrative regulations (or another regulatory legal act) of the state body;

civil79-u8f715d90b77c4b9d51-1.text: 8) indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of the civil servant's professional service activities.

civil79-uc6671070d17ee1d82f-1.text: 3. The provisions of the official duties regulations shall be taken into account when conducting a competition to fill a vacant civil service position or for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve, when making an appointment to a civil service position without a competition, during attestation, and when planning the civil servant's professional service activities and professional development.

civil79-u79315e75dacba8e0e2-1.text: 4. A civil servant's compliance with the official duties regulations shall be taken into account when they participate in a competition to fill a vacant civil service position or are included in the state body's personnel reserve, when they are appointed to a civil service position without a competition, and when their professional service activities are assessed during attestation or when an incentive is granted.

civil79-u2dbd8c68f31ac33499-1.text: 5. Model official duties regulations shall be approved by the relevant state service management body.

civil79-u238dfe5090594e0f3e-1.text: 1. A civil servant's attestation shall be conducted to determine their suitability for the civil service position held. Attestation shall include assessment of the civil servant's professional service activities and professional level.

civil79-u24b2da1fdf1ae0c260-1.text: 2. For attestation, the civil servant's immediate supervisor shall submit a reasoned report on the civil servant's performance of official duties during the attestation period. The report shall be accompanied by information, contained in the civil servant's annual professional service activity reports, on assignments completed and draft documents prepared during the attestation period, and, where necessary, by the civil servant's explanatory note in response to the immediate supervisor's report.

civil79-u9b47379b41b3243ed4-1.text: 3. Civil servants holding civil service positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories under fixed-term service contracts shall not be subject to attestation, except for civil servants holding certain civil service positions to which appointment and from which release are made by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, where attestation is required respectively by a Presidential Decree or a Government Resolution.

civil79-u36255e7e65f991fbfe-1.text: 4. A civil servant's attestation shall be conducted once every three years. Attestation of civil servants holding certain civil service positions to which appointment and from which release are made by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, where attestation is required respectively by a Presidential Decree or a Government Resolution, may be conducted at other intervals established by those acts.

civil79-u30742e69521a52a3b3-1.text: 5. An extraordinary attestation of a civil servant may be conducted before the time specified in part 4 of this Article after a decision has been adopted under the established procedure:

civil79-u6aa851cea553efd467-1.text: 1) to reduce civil service positions in the state body;

civil79-udb237b6e1fd64c76c7-1.text: 2) to change the conditions of civil servants' remuneration.

civil79-ua3ad2f0469496757ba-1.text: 6. An extraordinary attestation of a civil servant may also be conducted by agreement between the parties to the service contract, taking into account the results of the civil servant's annual professional service activity report.

civil79-ubf4640accdfe153227-1.text: 7. Attestation shall take into account the civil servant's compliance with restrictions, absence of breaches of prohibitions, and fulfilment of the requirements for official conduct and obligations established by this Federal Law.

civil79-uefdbe101341409db78-1.text: 8. A civil servant on maternity leave or leave to care for a child until the child reaches three years of age shall undergo attestation no earlier than one year after returning from leave.

civil79-u66522348121be5e43e-1.text: 9. An attestation commission shall be established by a legal act of the state body to conduct the attestation of civil servants.

civil79-u888a56c69426c65a52-1.text: 10. The attestation commission shall include the employer's representative and (or) civil servants authorized by that representative (including those from the state service and personnel unit and from the unit in which the civil servant undergoing attestation holds a civil service position), as well as independent experts included in accordance with part 10.2 of this Article: representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations who are specialists in the relevant fields and types of civil servants' professional service activities, personnel technologies and civil service. Independent experts must constitute at least one quarter of the total membership of the attestation commission.

civil79-ud78c042a816e631623-1.text: 10.1. The attestation commission of a federal executive body under which a public council has been established in accordance with Article 20 of Federal Law No. 32-ФЗ of 4 April 2005 ‘On the Public Chamber of the Russian Federation’, and of an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation under which a public council has been established in accordance with a regulatory legal act of that constituent entity, shall include representatives of those public councils in addition to the persons specified in part 10 of this Article. The combined number of those representatives and independent experts must be at least one quarter of the total membership of the attestation commission.

civil79-u2d135b9c97483a21e1-1.text: 10.2. Representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations to be included in attestation commissions shall be invited and selected by the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of state civil service, or by an authorized state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, at the request of the employer's representative submitted without specifying independent experts' personal data. This shall be done under the procedure established by a regulatory legal act of the Government of the Russian Federation or by a regulatory legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted with due regard to the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Representatives of public councils included in attestation commissions shall be designated by decisions of the respective public councils.

civil79-u73b32aa501282e9e84-1.text: 10.3. An independent expert's total period of membership of a state body's attestation commission may not exceed three years. This period shall be calculated from the expert's first inclusion in the attestation commission. The same independent expert may be included in the attestation commission again no earlier than three years after the end of their period of membership.

civil79-u2beb88720b0f90acc2-1.text: 10.4. An independent expert's aggregate period of membership of the attestation and competition commissions of the same state body may not exceed three years.

civil79-ua59ac0f2dc7b34603a-1.text: 11. The membership of an attestation commission for civil servants holding civil service positions whose official duties involve the use of information constituting a state secret shall be formed with due regard to the provisions of the legislation of the Russian Federation on state secrets.

civil79-u658e64df6126945acb-1.text: 12. The attestation commission shall be composed so as to exclude the possibility of conflicts of interest that could affect its decisions.

civil79-ueeaac884b79d9135b7-1.text: 13. While a civil servant who is a member of the attestation commission is undergoing attestation, their membership of the commission shall be suspended.

civil79-u95fb1b1beb5061cc3f-1.text: 14. If a civil servant fails to attend attestation without valid reasons or refuses attestation, the civil servant shall be held disciplinarily liable in accordance with Article 56 of this Federal Law, and the attestation shall be postponed.

civil79-ue78d2770951641ce06-1.text: 15. Following a civil servant's attestation, the attestation commission shall adopt one of the following decisions:

civil79-ua5e73bc3500662fe74-1.text: 1) suitable for the civil service position held;

civil79-u2a23810259400907cf-1.text: 2) suitable for the civil service position held and recommended for inclusion in the personnel reserve to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement;

civil79-u7db54cf93896ae25dd-1.text: 3) suitable for the civil service position held subject to successful completion of further professional education;

civil79-ud85a619970ac8164e2-1.text: 4) not suitable for the civil service position held.

civil79-u32885fb4a43b0b9736-1.text: 16. Within one month after attestation, a legal act of the state body shall be issued on the basis of its results, stating that the civil servant:

civil79-u7f9c0b1e7eea8f463f-1.text: 1) is to be included in the personnel reserve to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement;

civil79-u8534ebb2b6b1e4d00d-1.text: 2) is to be sent for further professional education;

civil79-ue745d5032c92f7a99c-1.text: 3) is to be demoted in civil service and removed from the personnel reserve if included in it.

civil79-u86e1d74792c662c293-1.text: 17. If a civil servant refuses further professional education or transfer to another civil service position, the employer's representative may release the civil servant from the position held and dismiss them from civil service in accordance with this Federal Law.

civil79-u8709917b913ccbf1d8-1.text: 18. A civil servant may appeal against attestation results in accordance with this Federal Law.

civil79-ub61f3142a156fa3dcb-1.text: 19. The regulations on attestation of state civil servants of the Russian Federation shall be approved by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation.

civil79-u51f71320053b05040a-1.text: Article 49. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 645-ФЗ of 29.12.2022.
civil79-u51f71320053b05040a-1.locator: Article 49. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 645-ФЗ of 29.12.2022.

civil79-u1a82b55acb1bb129a2-1.text: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
civil79-u1a82b55acb1bb129a2-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u1846e5a0e98bb2912b-1.text: 1. A civil servant shall be paid in the form of monetary remuneration, which is the principal means of material support and of incentivizing professional service activities in the civil service position held.
civil79-u1846e5a0e98bb2912b-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u5dc49355787cab8fe7-1.text: 2. A civil servant's monetary remuneration shall consist of the monthly salary corresponding to the civil service position held (hereinafter the position salary) and the monthly salary corresponding to the civil service class rank, justice class rank or diplomatic rank conferred on the civil servant (hereinafter the class-rank salary), which together constitute the civil servant's monthly remuneration salary (hereinafter the remuneration salary), as well as monthly and other supplementary payments (hereinafter supplementary payments).
civil79-u5dc49355787cab8fe7-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u3e9c3a272f324b951f-1.text: 3. Position salaries and class-rank salaries of federal state civil servants shall be established by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation on the proposal of the Government of the Russian Federation. For certain civil service positions, a Presidential Decree may establish monetary remuneration as a single monetary emolument incorporating the position salary, the class-rank salary and monthly supplements to the position salary for length of civil service, special civil service conditions and work with information constituting a state secret, but excluding bonuses and the monthly monetary incentive.
civil79-u3e9c3a272f324b951f-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u3cd5ae8875185809ab-1.text: 4. Position salaries and class-rank salaries of state civil servants of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be established in accordance with a regulatory legal act of that constituent entity.
civil79-u3cd5ae8875185809ab-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-uf29f56e37491827888-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-udbb2be526c50fe4b56-1.text: 1) a monthly supplement to the position salary for length of civil service at the following rates:
civil79-udbb2be526c50fe4b56-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u6c7b40c17c84540030-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-ub5f639b4fa8adae379-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u5c1a95cb2bc1d0b170-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u2da0db3f9dce7ccc58-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-ud90bf6d24b9a80aaa9-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-uc6df4c20e2e15946f7-1.text: 2) a monthly supplement to the position salary for special civil service conditions of up to 200 percent of that salary;
civil79-uc6df4c20e2e15946f7-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u05fa633738f0750675-1.text: 3) a monthly percentage supplement to the position salary for work with information constituting a state secret, at the rates and under the procedure determined by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u05fa633738f0750675-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u86da292cfd5a638732-1.text: 4) bonuses, including for performance of particularly important and complex assignments, the payment procedure for which shall be determined by the employer's representative with due regard to fulfilment of the state body's tasks and functions and compliance with the official duties regulations (with no maximum limit);
civil79-u86da292cfd5a638732-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-udf0d3c7e57ce6effff-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u3ba8832b5d2d2ce56f-1.text: 6) a lump-sum payment when annual paid leave is granted and financial assistance, paid from the civil servants' payroll fund.
civil79-u3ba8832b5d2d2ce56f-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u7b07b80dc36b2a6a9d-1.text: 6. Monthly monetary incentives paid to federal civil servants shall be established at differentiated rates for federal state bodies by Decrees of the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u7b07b80dc36b2a6a9d-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u538bd343c3b4b2bec9-1.text: 7. The procedure for paying the monthly supplement for special civil service conditions shall be determined by the employer's representative.
civil79-u538bd343c3b4b2bec9-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u2e6e082332b998e861-1.text: 8. The procedure for paying financial assistance from the civil servants' payroll fund shall be determined by the relevant regulations approved by the employer's representative.
civil79-u2e6e082332b998e861-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u7bc1b52a6663b939b9-1.text: 8.1. In cases provided for by this Federal Law in which civil servants retain monetary remuneration or are paid monetary compensation, federal civil servants' monetary remuneration shall be calculated under the procedure determined by the Government of the Russian Federation; for civil servants of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, it shall be calculated under a regulatory legal act of that constituent entity, taking into account the provisions of the procedure determined by the Government of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u7bc1b52a6663b939b9-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u2d58bb8214e0b4ba59-1.text: 9. In cases established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, a regional coefficient (coefficient) shall apply to a civil servant's monetary remuneration.
civil79-u2d58bb8214e0b4ba59-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u68dc1163b67ee20857-1.text: 10. Civil servants shall receive other payments provided for by the relevant federal laws and other regulatory legal acts.
civil79-u68dc1163b67ee20857-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-ue3384de56a79d4eea9-1.text: 11. Remuneration salaries for federal civil service positions shall be increased (indexed) annually in accordance with the federal law on the federal budget for the relevant year, taking into account inflation (consumer prices). The decision to increase (index) remuneration salaries for federal civil service positions shall be made by the President of the Russian Federation on the proposal of the Government of the Russian Federation.
civil79-ue3384de56a79d4eea9-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u1eff4e6d590d178d82-1.text: 12. Remuneration salaries for civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be increased (indexed) annually in accordance with that constituent entity's law on its budget for the relevant year, taking into account inflation (consumer prices). The increase (indexation) of remuneration salaries for civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be carried out in accordance with that constituent entity's legislation.
civil79-u1eff4e6d590d178d82-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u12342151428563e1a5-1.text: 13. Federal civil servants holding civil service positions in a state body located outside the territory of the Russian Federation shall be paid monetary remuneration in foreign currency and in rubles under the procedure and at the rates established by the President of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u12342151428563e1a5-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-uea9d47656f6ef672f4-1.text: 14. A special remuneration procedure may be established for certain civil service positions, under which remuneration depends on indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of professional service activities specified in a fixed-term service contract. The remuneration conditions established by other parts of this Article shall not apply to civil servants paid under that special procedure. Generalized indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of state bodies' activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and legal, organizational and documentation support for implementation of those decisions, common to state bodies and civil servants, shall be approved respectively by the President of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation.
civil79-uea9d47656f6ef672f4-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u353f7dccbc4d4cae14-1.text: 15. The list of civil service positions for which a special remuneration procedure may be established, and the procedure for determining civil servants' remuneration provided for in part 14 of this Article, shall be approved respectively by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation on the proposal of the Government of the Russian Federation and by regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u353f7dccbc4d4cae14-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-ud9ed5d48e72771251a-1.text: 16. Remuneration provided for in part 14 of this Article shall be paid within the established civil servants' payroll fund.
civil79-ud9ed5d48e72771251a-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-u2c15ec5fd952c167a9-1.text: 17. Specific indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of a state body's activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and legal, organizational and documentation support for implementation of those decisions shall be approved by a legal act of the state body in accordance with the particular features of its tasks and functions.
civil79-u2c15ec5fd952c167a9-1.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant

civil79-uc3c9d63e36143b377d-1.text: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body
civil79-uc3c9d63e36143b377d-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-u1b494286c49702fa32-1.text: 1. The civil servants' payroll fund and the payroll fund for employees holding positions that are not civil service positions shall together constitute the payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body.
civil79-u1b494286c49702fa32-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-u527a849d36579e211d-1.text: 2. When forming state bodies' civil servants' payroll funds, provision shall be made for funds to make the payments established by parts 2 and 5 of Article 50 of this Federal Law.
civil79-u527a849d36579e211d-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-u7ec59dd21d87a78e34-1.text: 3. Payroll funds for federal civil servants of federal state bodies and for civil servants of constituent entities of the Russian Federation serving in state bodies of those constituent entities shall be formed from the respective budgets' funds allocated to finance payments established by parts 2 and 5 of Article 50 of this Federal Law, and to finance:
civil79-u7ec59dd21d87a78e34-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-ud9a8628d8f83b901f4-1.text: 1) payment of the regional coefficient (coefficient) in cases established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, at the rates established respectively by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
civil79-ud9a8628d8f83b901f4-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-u829288be5f829d041c-1.text: 2) payment in certain state bodies of increased monetary remuneration, the amount of which shall be established respectively by the President of the Russian Federation and by a regulatory legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u829288be5f829d041c-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-udfdf344a2f9f29c697-1.text: 3) other payments established respectively by this Federal Law, other federal laws, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
civil79-udfdf344a2f9f29c697-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-u25d4b7b322ec739a5c-1.text: 4. The procedure for forming payroll funds for federal civil servants of federal state bodies, specifying the number of position salaries (on an annual basis) used to determine the amount of funds allocated to payments established by parts 2 and 5 of Article 50 of this Federal Law, shall be approved by the President of the Russian Federation on the proposal of the Government of the Russian Federation.
