civil79-u25d4b7b322ec739a5c-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-ua5a3b63bb1d089ccb2-1.text: 5. In state bodies where civil servants are remunerated in accordance with part 14 of Article 50 of this Federal Law, the civil servants' payroll fund (or the relevant part of it) shall be formed on the basis of indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of the state body's activities.
civil79-ua5a3b63bb1d089ccb2-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-u71d09ce4b895c3db19-1.text: 6. The procedure for forming payroll funds for employees of federal state bodies holding positions that are not federal civil service positions shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u71d09ce4b895c3db19-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-ud492beb1489067cd24-1.text: 7. Payroll funds for civil servants and employees holding positions that are not civil service positions in the public authorities of the Sirius federal territory, the control and accounts body of the Sirius federal territory and the territorial electoral commission of the Sirius federal territory shall be formed in accordance with parts 1, 2, 3 (except point 1) and 4–6 of this Article.
civil79-ud492beb1489067cd24-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-u8d91efe78fb0f9e079-1.text: 8. The procedure for forming payroll funds for civil servants of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation serving in its state bodies and payroll funds for employees holding positions that are not civil service positions of that constituent entity shall be established by the constituent entity's legislation, taking into account the provisions of the regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation provided for in parts 4 and 6 of this Article.
civil79-u8d91efe78fb0f9e079-1.locator: Article 51. Payroll fund for civil servants and employees of a state body

civil79-ub0f236384e4a952681-1.text: Chapter 11. STATE GUARANTEES IN CIVIL SERVICE
civil79-ub0f236384e4a952681-1.locator: Chapter 11. STATE GUARANTEES IN CIVIL SERVICE

civil79-ud7073db5e5f7a51e92-1.text: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
civil79-ud7073db5e5f7a51e92-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u97c28d3e5254b0407b-1.text: 1. To ensure civil servants' legal and social protection, increase their motivation to perform official duties effectively, strengthen the stability of the professional civil service personnel complement, and compensate for the restrictions established by this Federal Law and other federal laws, civil servants shall be guaranteed:
civil79-u97c28d3e5254b0407b-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-uf22692e1aa1c483fd9-1.text: 1) equal remuneration conditions and comparable indicators for evaluating the effectiveness of professional service activity results when holding corresponding civil service positions, unless otherwise established by this Federal Law;
civil79-uf22692e1aa1c483fd9-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-ufc1cdac577eccc7fff-1.text: 2) the civil servant's right to receive monetary remuneration on time and in full;
civil79-ufc1cdac577eccc7fff-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u92e350e423028e8668-1.text: 3) civil service conditions that ensure the performance of official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations;
civil79-u92e350e423028e8668-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u234311d17e5b845750-1.text: 4) rest ensured by establishing normal service hours, granting weekly rest days and non-working public holidays, and granting basic and additional annual paid leave;
civil79-u234311d17e5b845750-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u798302a54b19b16530-1.text: 5) medical insurance for the civil servant and their family members, including after retirement on a length-of-service pension, in accordance with this Federal Law and the federal law on medical insurance for state servants of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u798302a54b19b16530-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u6af365723bc20d28fa-1.text: 6) compulsory state social insurance against illness or loss of capacity for work during civil service, or retention of monetary remuneration during temporary incapacity for work and while undergoing examination in a medical organization providing specialized medical care, in accordance with federal law;
civil79-u6af365723bc20d28fa-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-ud58a044b88c565d842-1.text: 7) payments under compulsory state insurance in the cases, under the procedure and at the rates established respectively by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
civil79-ud58a044b88c565d842-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-ud14c114c44dbf8ab8a-1.text: 8) reimbursement of expenses connected with official business trips. The procedure and conditions for sending a civil servant on business trips shall be established respectively by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation and by regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
civil79-ud14c114c44dbf8ab8a-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u1b378f74115c7b5a6a-1.text: 9) reimbursement of expenses connected with relocation of a civil servant and their family members to another locality when, at the initiative of the employer's representative, the civil servant is transferred to another civil service position in the same or another state body. The procedure and conditions for reimbursing the civil servant's expenses shall be established respectively by a Resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation and by regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u1b378f74115c7b5a6a-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-uc653fa272b9a7480a1-1.text: 9.1) when a civil servant is appointed by rotation to a civil service position in a state body located in another locality within the Russian Federation, reimbursement, from the funds of the state body to which the civil servant is assigned by rotation, of expenses connected with relocation of the civil servant and their family members to the place of civil service in another locality within the Russian Federation; and reimbursement, from the funds of the state body in which the civil servant last held a civil service position, of expenses connected with relocation of the civil servant and their family members to another locality within the Russian Federation after termination of the fixed-term service contract or release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service. The expenses provided for in this point shall be reimbursed under the procedure and conditions established for reimbursement of expenses connected with relocation of a civil servant and their family members to another locality within the Russian Federation when the civil servant is transferred to another state body;
civil79-uc653fa272b9a7480a1-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u81a0a61b378c491795-1.text: 9.2) provision of official accommodation to a civil servant appointed by rotation to a civil service position in a state body located in another locality within the Russian Federation, or, if official accommodation is unavailable at the new place of civil service, reimbursement of the civil servant's expenses for renting (subletting) accommodation. If the civil servant is the tenant of accommodation under a social tenancy agreement at the previous place of civil service, that agreement may not be terminated at the landlord's request during the term of the fixed-term service contract for holding a civil service position by rotation. The procedure and conditions for providing official accommodation to federal civil servants and the procedure and rates for reimbursing their expenses for renting (subletting) accommodation shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation; the procedure and conditions for providing official accommodation to civil servants of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and the procedure and rates for reimbursing their expenses for renting (subletting) accommodation shall be established by regulatory legal acts of those constituent entities;
civil79-u81a0a61b378c491795-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u30cb999ba383322858-1.text: 10) protection of the civil servant and their family members against violence, threats and other unlawful acts connected with the performance of official duties, in the cases, under the procedure and subject to the conditions established by federal law;
civil79-u30cb999ba383322858-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u85893d0f53b0f46341-1.text: 11) state pension provision under the procedure and conditions established by the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families.
civil79-u85893d0f53b0f46341-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u2f8e7f6d7cdafd18da-1.text: 1.1. Regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation, the Government of the Russian Federation or a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide civil servants appointed (being appointed) by rotation to civil service positions in state bodies located in other localities within the Russian Federation with other guarantees in addition to those provided for in points 9.1 and 9.2 of part 1 of this Article.
civil79-u2f8e7f6d7cdafd18da-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u5b76e71655a3468984-1.text: 2. If a civil servant is released from the position held in connection with election or appointment to a state office, election to an elective office in a local self-government body, or election (delegation) to a paid elective position in a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body, the conditions of that civil servant's pension provision shall be determined at their choice.
civil79-u5b76e71655a3468984-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u8b531402daa5a6efc5-1.text: 3. Civil servants shall also be provided with other state guarantees established by federal laws.
civil79-u8b531402daa5a6efc5-1.locator: Article 52. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u9525ff87f2d01dc5b4-1.text: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
civil79-u9525ff87f2d01dc5b4-1.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u431bbcbc985b98c902-1.text: Subject to certain conditions provided for by this Federal Law or other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, or by laws or other regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, civil servants may be granted the right to:
civil79-u431bbcbc985b98c902-1.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-ucebb2d2b4e9d65d2db-1.text: 1) further professional education with retention of the civil service position held and monetary remuneration for that period;
civil79-ucebb2d2b4e9d65d2db-1.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-ucbf5dca4f6d678efd7-1.text: 2) transport services in connection with the performance of official duties, depending on the category and group of the civil service position held, as well as compensation for the use of personal transport for official purposes and reimbursement of related expenses, in the cases and under the procedure established respectively by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
civil79-ucbf5dca4f6d678efd7-1.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u45c10d2a1ccaa4096d-1.text: 3) holding another civil service position in the event of reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body, in accordance with Article 31 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u45c10d2a1ccaa4096d-1.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u121a4a1b982352a6aa-1.text: 4) a one-time subsidy for purchasing residential premises, once during the entire period of civil service, under the procedure and conditions established respectively by a Resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation and a regulatory legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u121a4a1b982352a6aa-1.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-uaa909714a298515423-1.text: 4.1) the guarantees provided for in Article 53.1 of this Federal Law in connection with the civil servant's conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation;
civil79-uaa909714a298515423-1.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u1b7430e873d0758e33-1.locator: Article 53. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

civil79-u733872d46037e6caff-1.text: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation
civil79-u733872d46037e6caff-1.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation

civil79-ud3b05535957e9ea5f9-1.text: 1. Civil servants conscripted for military service upon mobilization, assigned to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or having concluded a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime (hereinafter in this Article, military service), or a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, shall be guaranteed retention of their civil service positions for the period of military service or provision of voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation. During that period, civil service shall be suspended and monetary remuneration shall neither accrue nor be paid.
civil79-ud3b05535957e9ea5f9-1.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation

civil79-ub229dab61421291147-1.text: 1.1. Civil service shall be suspended and resumed under the procedure and conditions provided for by the Federal Law ‘On the State Service System of the Russian Federation’.
civil79-ub229dab61421291147-1.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation

civil79-ueff939052d0ca1957d-1.text: 2. During military service or provision of voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the service contract may not be terminated at the initiative of the employer's representative, except in connection with abolition of the state body (public authority of a federal territory).
civil79-ueff939052d0ca1957d-1.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation

civil79-u484814594503543a33-1.text: 2.1. For the period of military service or provision of voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the running of the term of a fixed-term service contract shall be suspended, except for a fixed-term service contract concluded for the performance of a specific assignment or for replacing an absent civil servant whose civil service position is retained under federal laws.
civil79-u484814594503543a33-1.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation

civil79-u81949a77fa1def041b-1.text: 2.2. A fixed-term service contract whose term was suspended in the case provided for in part 2.1 of this Article shall resume for a period equal to the remainder of its term calculated as at the date of suspension, but not beyond the civil servant's attainment of the maximum age for civil service unless their civil service term has been extended in accordance with Article 25.1 of this Federal Law, except for a fixed-term service contract concluded for a civil service position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category. A fixed-term service contract concluded for a civil service position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category shall resume for a period not exceeding the term of office of the person holding a state office, head of a state body, head of a territorial body of a federal executive body or head of a state body's representative office whom the civil servant holding a position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category assists. Upon expiry of the term of office of the person holding a state office, head of a state body, head of a territorial body of a federal executive body or head of a state body's representative office whom the civil servant holding a position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category assists, or upon the civil servant's attainment of the maximum age for civil service unless their civil service term has been extended in accordance with Article 25.1 of this Federal Law, the term of that civil servant's fixed-term service contract shall not resume, except for a civil servant assisting a person holding a state office, where the state-service relations with that civil servant have been extended under the procedure provided for in Article 25.1 of this Federal Law.
civil79-u81949a77fa1def041b-1.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation

civil79-u8278db3508e47d5f70-1.text: 3. A civil servant who has completed military service or provision of voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation shall, upon application, be granted annual paid leave at any time convenient to them within six months after resuming civil service.
civil79-u8278db3508e47d5f70-1.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation

civil79-u3b82e2f474288bdc57-1.text: 4. The period of military service or provision of voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation shall count towards length of civil service.
civil79-u3b82e2f474288bdc57-1.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation

civil79-uab1e93ab5e6908a6cb-1.text: 5. The provisions of labour legislation shall apply to legal relations not regulated by this Article.
civil79-uab1e93ab5e6908a6cb-1.locator: Article 53.1. Guarantees in connection with civil servants' conscription for military service upon mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or conclusion of a contract for military service during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation

civil79-u76fbfca50a695cf978-1.text: 1. Length (total duration) of civil service shall include periods of holding:

civil79-uc50e50c1565c76b95f-1.text: 1) civil service positions, military positions and positions in other types of federal state service;

civil79-u43f67a7bf9a9c588c2-1.text: 5) other positions in accordance with federal laws.

civil79-uc7fffcf8e2c123b59a-1.text: 2. In addition to periods of holding the positions specified in part 1 of this Article, other periods of holding positions on a list approved by the President of the Russian Federation shall be included (credited) in length of civil service for establishing a civil servant's monthly supplement to the position salary for length of civil service, determining the duration of additional annual paid leave for length of service and the amount of incentives for impeccable and effective civil service, in accordance with the procedure for calculating length of civil service established by the President of the Russian Federation.

civil79-u63f0b6a3fd370a0ceb-1.text: 3. Length of state civil service of the Russian Federation for granting civil servants a length-of-service pension shall be determined in accordance with the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families.

civil79-u876893d60732047fce-1.text: Chapter 12. INCENTIVES AND AWARDS. SERVICE DISCIPLINE IN CIVIL SERVICE
civil79-u876893d60732047fce-1.locator: Chapter 12. INCENTIVES AND AWARDS. SERVICE DISCIPLINE IN CIVIL SERVICE

civil79-u3b27e82e699f133b3c-1.text: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
civil79-u3b27e82e699f133b3c-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u5c09536434cfa202e6-1.text: 1. The following types of incentives and awards shall apply for impeccable and effective civil service:
civil79-u5c09536434cfa202e6-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u4084efe5292381d1d5-1.text: 1) a declaration of gratitude with payment of a lump-sum incentive;
civil79-u4084efe5292381d1d5-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-ufa9241b87368622059-1.text: 2) award of a certificate of honour of the state body, with payment of a lump-sum incentive or presentation of a valuable gift;
civil79-ufa9241b87368622059-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-ub0cba570c46536c199-1.text: 3) other types of incentives and awards of the state body;
civil79-ub0cba570c46536c199-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-ub7e977fbd2a6dec83d-1.text: 4) payment of a lump-sum incentive upon retirement on a state length-of-service pension;
civil79-ub7e977fbd2a6dec83d-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u6d64708e073bb7f52e-1.text: 5) an incentive granted by the Government of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u6d64708e073bb7f52e-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u3fd325e8bed826b1a0-1.text: 6) an incentive granted by the President of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u3fd325e8bed826b1a0-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u28ecabb04db03bef11-1.text: 7) award of state honours of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u28ecabb04db03bef11-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u6b45c55119666b2787-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-ua1372f2a41069342ea-1.text: 1.1. To encourage and reward civil servants of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation for impeccable and effective civil service, the constituent entity's laws may provide for incentives granted by its highest official and for the award of honours of that constituent entity.
civil79-ua1372f2a41069342ea-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u99eebb95eb37f9dd3e-1.text: 2. A decision to grant an incentive or award to a civil servant in accordance with points 1–4 of part 1 of this Article shall be made by the employer's representative; a decision to grant an incentive or award in accordance with points 5–7 of part 1 of this Article shall be made on the proposal of the employer's representative under the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u99eebb95eb37f9dd3e-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-ub97526f6c3dd0f4f69-1.text: 3. A civil servant shall be paid the lump-sum incentive provided for in points 1–3 of part 1 of this Article under the procedure and at the rates approved by the employer's representative within the established civil servants' payroll fund.
civil79-ub97526f6c3dd0f4f69-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-uce48447c07c0051d3b-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u836080ef7b0672f05e-1.text: 5. Decisions on incentives or awards under points 1–4 of part 1 of this Article shall be formalized by a legal act of the state body, and those under points 5–7 of part 1 of this Article by legal acts of the Russian Federation. The corresponding record of the incentive or award shall be entered in the civil servant's employment record book (where available) and personal file.
civil79-u836080ef7b0672f05e-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-uc1be7a76fc5efaaea1-1.text: 5.1. Civil servants, and citizens dismissed from civil service after being nominated for an award or incentive in accordance with part 2 of this Article, shall, upon receiving state honours of the Russian Federation or an incentive from the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, be paid a lump-sum incentive from the civil servants' payroll fund.
civil79-uc1be7a76fc5efaaea1-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u4503545aa6dc41b43f-1.text: 5.2. In the event of the death of a civil servant or of a citizen specified in part 5.1 of this Article who has received a state honour of the Russian Federation or an incentive from the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, and in the event of a posthumous state honour of the Russian Federation, the lump-sum incentive shall be paid to the civil servant's or citizen's family members. In such cases, the lump-sum incentive shall be paid no later than one month after expiry of the six-month period during which family members of the deceased civil servant or citizen may apply for that payment to the state body in which the person held a position. That period shall run from the date of issue of the legal act of the Russian Federation awarding the honour or incentive to the civil servant or citizen. If several family members apply for the lump-sum incentive not received by the civil servant or citizen owing to death, the amount shall be divided equally among the family members.
civil79-u4503545aa6dc41b43f-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u2c0dfee6b4f02a5823-1.text: 5.3. The following shall be considered family members entitled to the lump-sum incentive provided for in parts 5.1 and 5.2 of this Article:
civil79-u2c0dfee6b4f02a5823-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u4fc2d689a452fa4602-1.text: 1) the wife (husband) who was married to the civil servant or the citizen dismissed from civil service on the day of their death;
civil79-u4fc2d689a452fa4602-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u1f162edacf0f7e235a-1.text: 2) the parents of the civil servant or citizen dismissed from civil service;
civil79-u1f162edacf0f7e235a-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u2e6e45c126bb95ccf0-1.text: 3) the children of the civil servant or citizen dismissed from civil service;
civil79-u2e6e45c126bb95ccf0-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u1d024371cc19deef03-1.text: 4) persons who were dependent on the deceased civil servant or deceased citizen dismissed from civil service.
civil79-u1d024371cc19deef03-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u3d131b1e964420b2f1-1.text: 5.4. The rates and procedure for paying the lump-sum incentive to federal civil servants, citizens dismissed from federal civil service and their family members in the cases provided for in parts 5.1 and 5.2 of this Article shall be established by the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u3d131b1e964420b2f1-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u7218e0d4ac86d8c5de-1.text: 6. Laws and other regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall establish the rates, procedure and conditions for paying a lump-sum incentive to civil servants of that constituent entity and citizens dismissed from its civil service after nomination for an award or incentive, taking into account the provisions of this Article.
civil79-u7218e0d4ac86d8c5de-1.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service

civil79-u7225457a705bd6928b-1.text: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service
civil79-u7225457a705bd6928b-1.locator: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service

civil79-ube77316cf9ea2bd2e9-1.text: 1. Service discipline in civil service means civil servants' mandatory compliance with the internal service rules of the state body and official duties regulations established in accordance with this Federal Law, other federal laws, other regulatory legal acts, regulatory acts of the state body and the service contract.
civil79-ube77316cf9ea2bd2e9-1.locator: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service

civil79-u54aefbba81cbe4afdf-1.text: 2. In accordance with this Federal Law, other federal laws, other regulatory legal acts on civil service, regulatory acts of the state body and the service contract, the employer's representative shall create the conditions necessary for civil servants to observe service discipline.
civil79-u54aefbba81cbe4afdf-1.locator: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service

civil79-u88d0066023657e93cb-1.text: 3. The internal service rules of a state body shall be determined by a regulatory act of that body governing the service (work) schedule and rest time.
civil79-u88d0066023657e93cb-1.locator: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service

civil79-u046e01c45a5b92830b-1.text: 4. The internal service rules of the state body shall be approved by the employer's representative, taking into account the opinion of that state body's elected trade union body.
civil79-u046e01c45a5b92830b-1.locator: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service

civil79-u36e16812b5f4ee3b5b-1.text: 1. For a disciplinary offence, namely culpable non-performance or improper performance by a civil servant of the service duties assigned to them, the employer's representative may impose the following disciplinary sanctions:

civil79-ub1ec7b3f6ba7cd9a44-1.text: 3) a warning of incomplete suitability for the position;

civil79-u3defa79bce042db121-1.text: 5) dismissal from civil service on the grounds established by point 2, subpoints ‘а’–‘г’ of point 3, and points 5 and 6 of part 1 of Article 37 of this Federal Law.

civil79-u61c7bd4d8b71a51036-1.text: 2. Only one disciplinary sanction may be imposed for each disciplinary offence.

civil79-u4321d6f1406c8498c4-1.text: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
civil79-u4321d6f1406c8498c4-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-ueb51ace89bcef4b00a-1.text: 1. Before imposing a disciplinary sanction, the employer's representative must request a written explanation from the civil servant. If the civil servant refuses to provide such an explanation, a corresponding statement shall be drawn up. A civil servant's refusal to provide a written explanation shall not prevent imposition of a disciplinary sanction.
civil79-ueb51ace89bcef4b00a-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-u427a5122d358051185-1.text: 2. An internal service inquiry shall be conducted before a disciplinary sanction is imposed.
civil79-u427a5122d358051185-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-u2ed5833c88ade3f816-1.text: 3. When imposing a disciplinary sanction, the seriousness of the civil servant's disciplinary offence, degree of fault, the circumstances in which it was committed and the civil servant's previous performance of official duties shall be taken into account.
civil79-u2ed5833c88ade3f816-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-u63700cbcf995b35892-1.text: 4. A disciplinary sanction shall be imposed promptly after discovery of the disciplinary offence, but no later than one month from its discovery, excluding periods of the civil servant's temporary incapacity for work, leave, other absence from service for valid reasons, and the time taken by the internal service inquiry.
civil79-u63700cbcf995b35892-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-uc53e6d6b938b791f4e-1.text: 5. A disciplinary sanction may not be imposed later than six months after the disciplinary offence was committed, or, following an inspection of financial and economic activities or an audit, later than two years after it was committed. Time spent on criminal proceedings shall not be included in those periods.
civil79-uc53e6d6b938b791f4e-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-u9b790a19839e0dda58-1.text: 6. A copy of the act imposing a disciplinary sanction on a civil servant, stating the grounds for its imposition, shall be delivered to the civil servant against signature within five days after the relevant act is issued.
civil79-u9b790a19839e0dda58-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-u2ff7c0681fae82bb52-1.text: 7. A civil servant may appeal against a disciplinary sanction in writing to the state body's service disputes commission or to a court.
civil79-u2ff7c0681fae82bb52-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-u92876dcdbe7f8d39d6-1.text: 8. If, within one year from imposition of a disciplinary sanction provided for in points 1–3 of part 1 of Article 57 of this Federal Law and a sanction provided for in Article 59.1 of this Federal Law, a civil servant is not subjected to a new disciplinary sanction, they shall be deemed to have no disciplinary sanction.
civil79-u92876dcdbe7f8d39d6-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-u48ff2f5dd128ce08eb-1.text: 9. The employer's representative may lift a civil servant's disciplinary sanction before one year has elapsed from its imposition, on their own initiative, on the civil servant's written application or on a request from the civil servant's immediate supervisor.
civil79-u48ff2f5dd128ce08eb-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-u70f8ec016d9cf75517-1.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

civil79-u6b95126b88c2a24378-1.text: 1. An internal service inquiry shall be conducted by decision of the employer's representative or on a civil servant's written application.

civil79-u43f79ecfe1eb61d3d4-1.text: 2. An internal service inquiry must establish fully, objectively and comprehensively:

civil79-u2e9e204acd23207d47-1.text: 1) whether the civil servant committed a disciplinary offence;

civil79-ueba981910fe3009b50-1.text: 3) the causes and conditions that contributed to the civil servant's disciplinary offence;

civil79-u0e02885b31fd0df080-1.text: 4) the nature and extent of the harm caused by the civil servant as a result of the disciplinary offence;

civil79-uacf52a7a3e9eee0a6c-1.text: 5) the circumstances forming the grounds for the civil servant's written application for an internal service inquiry.

civil79-uabd6874d04b5fb3c2c-1.text: 3. The employer's representative who ordered the internal service inquiry shall monitor its timeliness and proper conduct.

civil79-uc966dd193dc7a612b2-1.text: 4. The internal service inquiry shall be entrusted to the state body's state service and personnel unit, with participation of its legal unit and elected trade union body.

civil79-ub3f240ca33bbd19e1d-1.text: 5. A civil servant with a direct or indirect interest in the outcome of an internal service inquiry may not participate in it. In such cases, they shall submit a written application to the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry, requesting release from participation. If this requirement is not met, the results of the internal service inquiry shall be considered invalid.

civil79-u41ff805912d8d3832f-1.text: 6. An internal service inquiry must be completed within no more than 60 calendar days from the decision to conduct it. Its duration may be extended to 90 calendar days by the persons who made that decision. Upon completion, the results shall be reported in a written conclusion to the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry.

civil79-u4e2aee9f8ae9ff26d7-1.text: 7. A civil servant subject to an internal service inquiry may be temporarily suspended from the civil service position held for the duration of the inquiry, with retention of the monetary remuneration for that position during that period. Such temporary suspension shall be effected by the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry.

civil79-uc62bda8cc6b763a5e8-1.text: 8. A civil servant subject to an internal service inquiry shall have the right to:

civil79-uea2d0cd84168158219-1.text: 1) give oral or written explanations and submit statements, requests and other documents;

civil79-u40f6dfd78c4132e18e-1.text: 2) appeal to the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry against decisions and actions (inaction) of the civil servants conducting it;

civil79-ud3317cb4bee60b663c-1.text: 3) upon completion of the inquiry, examine the written conclusion and other materials relating to its results, unless this conflicts with requirements prohibiting disclosure of information constituting a state secret or another secret protected by federal law.

civil79-u8abc72df6f7d3ccd34-1.text: 9. The written conclusion on the results of the internal service inquiry shall specify:

civil79-u152ef6667517259cd1-1.text: 1) the facts and circumstances established by the inquiry;

civil79-u2e3aa5450ff0cc70b9-1.text: 2) a proposal to impose or not to impose a disciplinary sanction on the civil servant.

civil79-uf3913ce0e84fe23358-1.text: 10. The written conclusion on the results of the internal service inquiry shall be signed by the head of the state body's state service and personnel unit and other participants in the inquiry, and added to the personal file of the civil servant who was the subject of the inquiry.

civil79-ua069dc9425ec99f012-1.text: 11. Procedures for conducting internal service inquiries may be approved by regulatory legal acts of federal state bodies and public authorities of a federal territory for federal civil servants, and by regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for their civil servants, respectively, taking into account the provisions of this Article.

civil79-uba3e0251594a76a6b9-1.text: Article 59.1. Sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for the purpose of combating corruption
civil79-uba3e0251594a76a6b9-1.locator: Article 59.1. Sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for the purpose of combating corruption

civil79-u347e4cc06b0fc26a7e-1.text: 1. The following sanctions shall be imposed for a civil servant's failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or to perform duties established for the purpose of combating corruption by this Federal Law, Federal Law 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws:
civil79-u347e4cc06b0fc26a7e-1.locator: Article 59.1. Sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for the purpose of combating corruption

civil79-uf230fd80de0c8e8920-2.locator: Article 59.1. Sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for the purpose of combating corruption

civil79-ufc982edcbafa5c8093-2.locator: Article 59.1. Sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for the purpose of combating corruption

civil79-u52dd2013f60f65eb92-1.text: 3) a warning of incomplete suitability for the position.
civil79-u52dd2013f60f65eb92-1.locator: Article 59.1. Sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for the purpose of combating corruption

civil79-uff2798003ee5bb848f-1.text: 2. A civil servant shall be exempt from liability for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or to perform duties established by this Federal Law and other federal laws for the purpose of combating corruption, if that non-compliance or failure is recognized as resulting from circumstances beyond their control under the procedure provided for in parts 3–6 of Article 13 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’.
civil79-uff2798003ee5bb848f-1.locator: Article 59.1. Sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for the purpose of combating corruption

civil79-ud323d54ecdcee91452-1.text: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence
civil79-ud323d54ecdcee91452-1.locator: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence

civil79-u422a6d20db857cd025-1.text: 1. A civil servant shall be dismissed due to loss of confidence in the event of:
civil79-u422a6d20db857cd025-1.locator: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence

civil79-u87070b48f0693c9359-1.text: 1) failure to take measures to prevent and (or) resolve a conflict of interest to which the civil servant is a party, except in cases established by federal laws;
civil79-u87070b48f0693c9359-1.locator: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence

civil79-u1ecc93c894252108d5-1.text: 2) failure to submit information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and information on expenditure provided for by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons and Their Income’; submission of knowingly incomplete information, except in cases established by federal laws; or submission of knowingly inaccurate information;
civil79-u1ecc93c894252108d5-1.locator: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence

civil79-uf3f11d6dcd085715a9-1.text: 3) participation for remuneration in the activities of the management body of a commercial organization, except in cases established by federal law;
civil79-uf3f11d6dcd085715a9-1.locator: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence

civil79-u8706b6b67d8c2ca40b-1.locator: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence

civil79-ud309745968f5f09e5f-1.text: 5) membership of management bodies, boards of trustees, supervisory boards or other bodies of foreign non-profit non-governmental organizations or their structural subdivisions operating in the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation;
civil79-ud309745968f5f09e5f-1.locator: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence

civil79-u47fc3f2ccbc3849a21-1.text: 6) breach by the civil servant, their spouse and minor children of the prohibition on opening or holding accounts (deposits), keeping cash or valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or owning and (or) using foreign financial instruments, except in cases established by federal laws.
civil79-u47fc3f2ccbc3849a21-1.locator: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence

civil79-u77653458724ddad9b0-1.text: 2. An employer's representative who becomes aware that a civil servant has a personal interest that leads or may lead to a conflict of interest shall also be dismissed due to loss of confidence if the representative fails to take measures to prevent and (or) resolve a conflict of interest involving a subordinate civil servant, except in cases established by federal laws.
civil79-u77653458724ddad9b0-1.locator: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence

civil79-u77066429a08d378f53-1.text: 3. Information on imposition on a civil servant of the sanction of dismissal due to loss of confidence for a corruption offence shall be entered by the state body in which the civil servant served in the register of persons dismissed due to loss of confidence provided for in Article 15 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’.
civil79-u77066429a08d378f53-1.locator: Article 59.2. Dismissal due to loss of confidence

civil79-u158e246199a0c0682c-1.text: Article 59.3. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
civil79-u158e246199a0c0682c-1.locator: Article 59.3. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

civil79-u2ece8369c658c5c641-1.text: 1. The sanctions provided for in Articles 59.1 and 59.2 of this Federal Law shall be imposed by the employer's representative on the basis of a report on an inspection conducted by the relevant state body's personnel service unit for prevention of corruption and other offences, or by an authorized unit of the Administration of the President of the Russian Federation in accordance with Article 13.4 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’; if the inspection report was referred to the commission for resolving conflicts of interest, its recommendation shall also serve as a basis. With the civil servant's consent and provided that they admit committing a corruption offence, a sanction other than dismissal due to loss of confidence may be imposed on the basis of a report by the relevant state body's personnel service unit for prevention of corruption and other offences, setting out the factual circumstances of the corruption offence, and the civil servant's written explanation.
civil79-u2ece8369c658c5c641-1.locator: Article 59.3. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

civil79-u39109d56757dd8297a-1.text: 2. When imposing the sanctions provided for in Articles 59.1 and 59.2 of this Federal Law, account shall be taken of the nature and seriousness of the civil servant's corruption offence, the circumstances in which it was committed, compliance with other restrictions and prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, performance of duties established for the purpose of combating corruption, and previous results of the civil servant's performance of official duties.
civil79-u39109d56757dd8297a-1.locator: Article 59.3. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

civil79-ue987d4dd00b61267d6-1.text: 3. The sanctions provided for in Articles 59.1 and 59.2 of this Federal Law shall be imposed no later than six months after receipt of information that the civil servant committed a corruption offence, excluding periods of temporary incapacity for work, leave and other absence from service for valid reasons, and no later than three years after the offence was committed. Time spent on criminal proceedings shall not be included in those periods.
civil79-ue987d4dd00b61267d6-1.locator: Article 59.3. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

civil79-ue1f81f404662abe322-1.text: 3.1. An admonition may be imposed on a civil servant where their corruption offence is insignificant.
civil79-ue1f81f404662abe322-1.locator: Article 59.3. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

civil79-ue41750e2a150c417b5-1.text: 4. An act imposing a sanction on a civil servant for a corruption offence shall cite Article 59.1 or 59.2 of this Federal Law as the ground for the sanction.
civil79-ue41750e2a150c417b5-1.locator: Article 59.3. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

civil79-u8aea8ad6b7ed922102-1.text: 5. A copy of the act imposing a sanction on a civil servant, specifying the corruption offence and the regulatory legal acts whose provisions were breached, or of the act declining to impose such a sanction, stating the reasons, shall be delivered to the civil servant against signature within five days after the relevant act is issued.
civil79-u8aea8ad6b7ed922102-1.locator: Article 59.3. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

civil79-u63046f1847185cb224-1.text: 6. A civil servant may appeal against a sanction in writing to the state body's service disputes commission or to a court.
civil79-u63046f1847185cb224-1.locator: Article 59.3. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

civil79-u05c4aeb68f707f2319-1.text: 7. If, within one year from imposition of a sanction, a civil servant has not been subjected to a disciplinary sanction provided for in point 1, 2 or 3 of part 1 of Article 57 of this Federal Law, or a sanction provided for in point 1, 2 or 3 of Article 59.1 of this Federal Law, they shall be deemed to have no sanction.
civil79-u05c4aeb68f707f2319-1.locator: Article 59.3. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

civil79-u0e7de79350cfedefb3-1.text: Chapter 13. FORMATION OF THE CIVIL SERVICE PERSONNEL COMPLEMENT
civil79-u0e7de79350cfedefb3-1.locator: Chapter 13. FORMATION OF THE CIVIL SERVICE PERSONNEL COMPLEMENT

civil79-u81a0600a7c9ef45aaa-1.text: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement
civil79-u81a0600a7c9ef45aaa-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-u06c0af5a8926082da2-1.text: 1. The civil service personnel complement of a state body shall be formed on the basis of the following principles:
civil79-u06c0af5a8926082da2-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-u6fbe4e8320f38e4363-1.text: 1) appointment of civil servants to civil service positions taking into account their merits in professional service activities;
civil79-u6fbe4e8320f38e4363-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-u21ecc0671305fa5dde-1.text: 2) improvement of civil servants' professional level.
civil79-u21ecc0671305fa5dde-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-u0281cd6f2edfc1da8c-1.text: 2. Priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement shall be:
civil79-u0281cd6f2edfc1da8c-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-ue1eaac1cf751fe8fad-1.text: 1) training personnel for civil service and professional development of civil servants;
civil79-ue1eaac1cf751fe8fad-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-u0d87899696e4de48d7-1.text: 2) facilitating civil servants' career advancement on a competitive basis;
civil79-u0d87899696e4de48d7-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-uee9a4adf5bd96ff35f-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-ue7f392f4731c4cf251-1.text: 4) formation and effective use of the personnel reserve;
civil79-ue7f392f4731c4cf251-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-ude91e7c92710b4771c-1.text: 5) assessment of civil servants' professional service activity results through attestation;
civil79-ude91e7c92710b4771c-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-u976cf3ab1475ce9bb2-1.text: 6) use of modern personnel technologies upon entry into and during civil service.
civil79-u976cf3ab1475ce9bb2-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-u674e36688c2c4926de-1.text: 3. Repealed with effect from 1 January 2013. — Federal Law No. 395-ФЗ of 06.12.2011.
civil79-u674e36688c2c4926de-1.locator: Article 60. Principles and priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement

civil79-uf38a9b7760a56c309d-1.text: 1. Civil servants shall be rotated to improve the effectiveness of civil service and combat corruption by appointing them to other civil service positions in the same or another state body.

civil79-ueb6ea284cc9b099b40-1.text: 2. Federal civil servants shall be rotated in territorial bodies of federal executive bodies exercising control and supervisory functions. Federal civil servants holding the positions of heads of those bodies shall be subject to rotation. Rotation of federal civil servants holding other federal civil service positions in the ‘managers’ category whose duties involve control or supervisory functions in territorial bodies of a federal executive body whose activities are directed by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation may be conducted under a list of positions approved by the head of the federal executive body; in territorial bodies of a federal executive body subordinate to a federal ministry, it may be conducted under a list approved by the head of the federal executive body in agreement with the federal minister.

civil79-u35ae21a954a708a49a-1.text: 2.2. Rotation of federal civil servants may be conducted:

civil79-ue3abc0f880c2c51872-1.text: 1) in federal executive bodies whose activities are directed by the President of the Russian Federation, under lists of federal civil service positions approved by the President of the Russian Federation and drawn up on the basis of proposals from those federal executive bodies;

civil79-ue75b32d7911ee9c62a-1.text: 2) in federal executive bodies whose activities are directed by the Government of the Russian Federation, under lists of federal civil service positions approved by the Government of the Russian Federation and drawn up on the basis of proposals from those federal executive bodies;

civil79-ub47964182a26fc7c18-1.text: 3) in other federal state bodies, under lists of federal civil service positions approved by the President of the Russian Federation and drawn up on the basis of proposals from the heads of those federal state bodies, under the procedure established by the President of the Russian Federation.

civil79-u7dbc928a0ef888d98d-1.text: 3. The rotation plan for federal civil servants shall be approved by the head of the federal state body. The form of the rotation plan and the procedure for its approval shall be established by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation.

civil79-u5f8c0d854bafbefd8f-1.text: 4. Rotation of a federal civil servant holding a federal civil service position in a federal executive body or its territorial body, or in another federal state body, to another federal executive body or its territorial body, or to another federal state body, shall be conducted by agreement between the heads of the relevant federal executive bodies and (or) other federal state bodies empowered to appoint to and release from the federal civil service position subject to rotation. Rotation of a federal civil servant to a federal executive body subordinate to a federal ministry, or to a territorial body of such a federal executive body, shall also require agreement with the federal minister.

civil79-u8e9a0e5a1c05896206-1.text: 5. When a civil servant is appointed by rotation to another civil service position, their professional level, speciality, field of training and length of civil service or work in their speciality or field of training shall be taken into account. A civil servant shall be appointed by rotation to a civil service position whose position salary is no lower than that of the position they currently hold, except in the case provided for in this part. With their written consent, a civil servant may be appointed by rotation to a civil service position with a lower position salary than that of the position they hold. A civil servant may be appointed to a civil service position by rotation during the final year of a fixed-term service contract at the times provided for in the federal state body's rotation plan for federal state civil servants.

civil79-u4cbed48bb737f8380a-1.text: 6. A civil service position shall be held by rotation for a term of three to five years, unless otherwise provided for by this Federal Law.

civil79-u3b62228fa5bdb170f2-1.text: 6.1. A civil servant's term in a civil service position held by rotation may be extended by decision of the employer's representative and with the civil servant's written consent. The employer's representative shall decide on extension, taking into account the recommendation of the commission for resolving conflicts of interest, no later than seven months before the civil servant's service contract expires.

civil79-ub1219997542027526c-1.text: 6.2. A civil servant may not hold the same civil service position to which they were appointed by rotation for more than ten years.

civil79-ub69627d0f1cee1d706-1.text: 7. At least six months before the civil servant's service contract expires, the employer's representative shall notify the civil servant in writing, against signature, of their forthcoming appointment by rotation to another civil service position, specifying the terms of the service contract for the new position, or of the forthcoming extension of their term in the civil service position held by rotation, specifying the terms of the new service contract for that position.

civil79-ua448d88d9d5cae5a0b-1.text: 7.1. A civil servant shall be transferred by rotation to a civil service position in another state body with their written consent in accordance with part 1.1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law.

civil79-u36aebe1396466fdf41-1.text: 8. A civil servant may refuse to take another civil service position by rotation for the following reasons:

civil79-uc3e1d794327043df50-1.text: 1) an illness preventing the civil servant and (or) their family members (spouse, minor children, children over 18 who became disabled before reaching 18, children under 23 studying full-time at organizations carrying out educational activities, parents, and persons dependent on and living with the civil servant) from living in the locality to which the civil servant is appointed by rotation. The list of such illnesses shall be approved by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation;

civil79-uea02125bf1abdcf5fc-1.text: 2) the need to provide constant care for a father, mother, brother, sister, grandfather, grandmother or adoptive parent living separately, who is not fully supported by the state and, according to a conclusion of the federal medical and social assessment institution at their place of residence, requires constant care (assistance or supervision) by another person.

civil79-uc8edea05141618ca4d-1.text: 9. If a civil servant refuses a civil service position offered by rotation for the reasons specified in part 8 of this Article, they must, no later than 30 days before the fixed-term service contract expires, be offered in writing another vacant civil service position in the same or another state body, including a position with a lower position salary than that of the position they hold, taking into account the professional level, speciality, field of training and length of civil service or work in the speciality or field of training required to perform the official duties. If the civil servant refuses the other position offered in the same or another state body, or is not provided with another civil service position, they shall be released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service, and the service contract shall be terminated in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law.

civil79-ua66efc90b552f27d8f-1.text: 9.1. If a civil servant refuses a civil service position offered by rotation for reasons not specified in part 8 of this Article, they may be offered in writing another vacant civil service position in the same or another state body, including a position with a lower position salary than that of the position they hold, taking into account the professional level, speciality, field of training and length of civil service or work in the speciality or field of training required to perform the official duties. If the civil servant refuses the other position offered in the same or another state body, or is not provided with another civil service position, they shall be released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service, and the service contract shall be terminated in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law.

civil79-u7c1b4c203a39ab0533-1.text: 10. The list of civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation subject to rotation, and the rotation plan for its civil servants, shall be approved by regulatory legal acts of that constituent entity.

civil79-ue0d0a8c01fe599a285-1.text: Article 61. Training personnel for civil service
civil79-ue0d0a8c01fe599a285-1.locator: Article 61. Training personnel for civil service

civil79-u8b44daf46146213325-1.text: 1. Personnel for civil service shall be trained in vocational education organizations and higher education organizations in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u8b44daf46146213325-1.locator: Article 61. Training personnel for civil service

civil79-u214e4fa8b992904996-1.text: 2. A targeted education agreement between a state body and a citizen, with an obligation to perform civil service for a specified period after completing education, shall be concluded on a competitive basis under the procedure established respectively by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation, a regulatory legal act of the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation, and the legislation of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u214e4fa8b992904996-1.locator: Article 61. Training personnel for civil service

civil79-u0695179bdd2512d903-1.text: 3. Training personnel for civil service shall be coordinated by the relevant state service management body.
civil79-u0695179bdd2512d903-1.locator: Article 61. Training personnel for civil service

civil79-u55907e7f01a2553dc2-1.text: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant
civil79-u55907e7f01a2553dc2-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-ub387a12a6adc984494-1.text: 1. A civil servant's professional development shall aim to maintain and improve their professional level and shall include further professional education and other professional development activities.
civil79-ub387a12a6adc984494-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u683e83a06bf5a7d4af-1.text: 2. A civil servant's professional development shall take place throughout their entire period of civil service.
civil79-u683e83a06bf5a7d4af-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-ud5afea6b7cac6f05a0-1.text: 3. The grounds for sending a civil servant to participate in professional development activities shall be:
civil79-ud5afea6b7cac6f05a0-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u94bcecc8b182736192-1.text: 1) a decision of the employer's representative;
civil79-u94bcecc8b182736192-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-ub661d9c09c917623cf-1.text: 2) the results of the civil servant's attestation;
civil79-ub661d9c09c917623cf-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u00f08d0ae3c12b20c0-1.text: 3) appointment of the civil servant to another civil service position in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 31 of this Federal Law;
civil79-u00f08d0ae3c12b20c0-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-ufc5251a2097b7de9c1-1.text: 4) the civil servant's first appointment by way of career advancement to a civil service position in the ‘managers’ category in the highest or principal group, or to a civil service position in the ‘specialists’ category in the highest group;
civil79-ufc5251a2097b7de9c1-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u3011c94cca276f2abe-1.text: 5) a citizen's first entry into civil service.
civil79-u3011c94cca276f2abe-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u6f9c802e42f7e69764-1.text: 4. A civil servant's professional development activities may be implemented:
civil79-u6f9c802e42f7e69764-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u78c32a902c87f1c1d5-1.text: 1) through a state order for civil servants' professional development activities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs;
civil79-u78c32a902c87f1c1d5-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u6793f79bf3314ea57a-1.text: 2) as part of a state assignment under the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation or regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u6793f79bf3314ea57a-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u946ccd1f8d2b873190-1.text: 3) at the expense of the state body in which the civil servant holds a civil service position, in an organization delivering further professional education programmes selected under the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
civil79-u946ccd1f8d2b873190-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u5b1009ee5bc25d4634-1.text: 5. A civil servant's professional development activities may take place outside the territory of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u5b1009ee5bc25d4634-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u0ece1601d6f7ef97bc-1.text: 6. A civil servant's professional development activities shall take place with or without release from civil service duties.
civil79-u0ece1601d6f7ef97bc-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u7b532b98a4d67dd5e4-1.text: 7. A civil servant's professional development shall be carried out under the procedure determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u7b532b98a4d67dd5e4-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u3469db83371a199f19-1.text: 8. The employer's representative, educational organization, state body or other organization shall create conditions for the professional development of a civil servant participating in professional development activities.
civil79-u3469db83371a199f19-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u0746f9490fd5e6e149-1.text: 9. A civil servant's further professional education shall include professional retraining and advanced training.
civil79-u0746f9490fd5e6e149-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u01b11d05ac07b36a3d-1.text: 10. A civil servant's further professional education shall take place in organizations delivering further professional education programmes, including on the basis of a state educational certificate for a civil servant's further professional education (hereinafter a certificate).
civil79-u01b11d05ac07b36a3d-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-u0574e30761f52ed2a5-1.text: 11. The procedure for granting a certificate, its form, the rules for applying for a certificate and the rules for issuing a certificate (or duplicate) shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u0574e30761f52ed2a5-1.locator: Article 62. Professional development of a civil servant

civil79-ub4c7aac7446673060c-1.text: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities
civil79-ub4c7aac7446673060c-1.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities

civil79-u9b432eb2c4d4bfdc2b-1.text: 1. The state order for civil servants' professional development activities for the following year shall include:
civil79-u9b432eb2c4d4bfdc2b-1.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities

civil79-u37035414fae90cb1a5-1.text: 1) a state order for civil servants' further professional education, including outside the territory of the Russian Federation;
civil79-u37035414fae90cb1a5-1.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities

civil79-u724e1448060d6cf78f-1.text: 2) a state order for other professional development activities for civil servants.
civil79-u724e1448060d6cf78f-1.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities

civil79-u2c7b6e2869c44281bb-1.text: 2. That state order shall be formed by the relevant state service management body on the basis of applications from state bodies, taking into account their functions and specialization and professional education for the civil service positions held in those bodies.
civil79-u2c7b6e2869c44281bb-1.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities

civil79-uf74403554c4d50230c-1.text: 3. The state order for federal civil servants' professional development activities, including its volume and structure, shall be approved by the Government of the Russian Federation after the federal law on the federal budget for the relevant financial year and planning period enters into force.
civil79-uf74403554c4d50230c-1.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities

civil79-u6cd83881814a9c71c0-1.text: 4. A constituent entity of the Russian Federation's state order for its civil servants' professional development activities, including its volume and structure, shall be approved by a law or other regulatory legal act of that constituent entity, taking into account the provisions of this Article.
civil79-u6cd83881814a9c71c0-1.locator: Article 63. State order for civil servants' professional development activities

civil79-uaebe4ae00a7e7d9d71-1.text: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service
civil79-uaebe4ae00a7e7d9d71-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u1b6a343f2bd6500123-1.text: 1. To fill vacant civil service positions, a federal civil service personnel reserve, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation's personnel reserve, a federal state body's personnel reserve, a federal territory public authority's personnel reserve and a constituent entity state body's personnel reserve shall be formed from civil servants and citizens.
civil79-u1b6a343f2bd6500123-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u78536d1ce085009ef6-1.text: 2. The regulations on the federal civil service personnel reserve, determining the categories and groups of federal civil service positions for which the reserve is formed and the procedure for forming and working with it, shall be approved by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u78536d1ce085009ef6-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u6b7fc408d6625ceca4-1.text: 3. A constituent entity of the Russian Federation's personnel reserve shall be formed by its state service management body to fill civil service positions of the highest, principal and leading groups, from civil servants and citizens included in the personnel reserves of that constituent entity's state bodies.
civil79-u6b7fc408d6625ceca4-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u862acb171f88712510-1.text: 4. The personnel reserve of a federal state body, of a public authority of a federal territory and of a state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation (hereinafter also a state body's personnel reserve) shall be formed by the respective employer's representative.
civil79-u862acb171f88712510-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-uee0cc4dfeb4f0abe7e-1.text: 5. Civil servants and citizens shall be included in a state body's personnel reserve with an indication of the group of civil service positions to which they may be appointed.
civil79-uee0cc4dfeb4f0abe7e-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u0fb1be7ffc47bd96e8-1.text: 6. Inclusion in a state body's personnel reserve shall take place:
civil79-u0fb1be7ffc47bd96e8-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u960ef8cad79841f031-1.text: 1) for citizens, on the basis of a competition for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve;
civil79-u960ef8cad79841f031-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-uea5c09925fb58c9987-1.text: 2) for citizens, on the basis of a competition to fill a vacant civil service position, with their consent;
civil79-uea5c09925fb58c9987-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u539aacf09d8a1b60be-1.text: 3) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement, on the basis of a competition for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve;
civil79-u539aacf09d8a1b60be-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u0075350cec5eeb2f9d-1.text: 4) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement, on the basis of a competition to fill a vacant civil service position, with their consent;
civil79-u0075350cec5eeb2f9d-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u4140a27c6853f09d96-1.text: 5) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement, on the basis of attestation results in accordance with point 1 of part 16 of Article 48 of this Federal Law, with their consent;
civil79-u4140a27c6853f09d96-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u04dad2cad655c276eb-1.text: 6) for civil servants dismissed due to reduction of civil service positions in accordance with point 8.2 of part 1 of Article 37 of this Federal Law or abolition of a state body in accordance with point 8.3 of part 1 of Article 37 of this Federal Law, by decision of the employer's representative of the state body in which positions are being reduced or the state body to which the abolished body's functions have been transferred, with the civil servants' consent;
