civil79-u04dad2cad655c276eb-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u7938a4ddf0b5f36b1b-1.text: 7) for civil servants dismissed on the grounds provided for in part 1 of Article 39 of this Federal Law, with their consent;
civil79-u7938a4ddf0b5f36b1b-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u7a7988eb61e090c8dc-1.text: 8) for civil servants dismissed because transfer to another civil service position in accordance with points 3–5, 9 and 12–14 of part 5 of Article 28 of this Federal Law is impossible owing to the absence of such a position, or because the civil servant refuses transfer to another civil service position in accordance with Article 28 of this Federal Law, by decision of the employer's representative, with the civil servants' consent.
civil79-u7a7988eb61e090c8dc-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-uf64cad216e036fac63-1.text: 7. Civil servants shall be included in a state body's personnel reserve in accordance with points 6–8 of part 6 of this Article to fill civil service positions in the same group as the last civil service position held by them.
civil79-uf64cad216e036fac63-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u9a07e1272b15025c40-1.text: 8. A competition for inclusion in a state body's personnel reserve shall be conducted by that body's competition commission.
civil79-u9a07e1272b15025c40-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u96071f422b1474e1f3-1.text: 9. Inclusion of civil servants and citizens in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation's personnel reserve shall be formalized by a legal act of that constituent entity's state service management body; inclusion in a state body's personnel reserve shall be formalized by a legal act of that state body.
civil79-u96071f422b1474e1f3-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u6198eb6f0d6a2733b8-1.text: 10. A civil servant or citizen in the personnel reserve shall be appointed to a vacant civil service position with their consent by decision of the employer's representative.
civil79-u6198eb6f0d6a2733b8-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-ue1959fd945513d2255-1.text: 11. The regulations on the personnel reserves of a federal state body and of a public authority of a federal territory, determining the procedure for forming and working with those reserves, shall be approved by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
civil79-ue1959fd945513d2255-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-ufe1025dc87c4cf396b-1.text: 12. The regulations on the civil service personnel reserve of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, establishing the procedure for forming and working with that constituent entity's personnel reserve and the personnel reserves of its state bodies, shall be approved by a regulatory legal act of that constituent entity.
civil79-ufe1025dc87c4cf396b-1.locator: Article 64. Personnel reserve in civil service

civil79-u78eb3e9ecde932a0ed-1.text: Chapter 14. FINANCING OF CIVIL SERVICE. DEVELOPMENT OF CIVIL SERVICE
civil79-u78eb3e9ecde932a0ed-1.locator: Chapter 14. FINANCING OF CIVIL SERVICE. DEVELOPMENT OF CIVIL SERVICE

civil79-uf6dfbc8b6a2e80925c-1.text: Federal civil service and the civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be financed respectively from the federal budget, the budget of the Sirius federal territory with due regard to Article 47 of Federal Law No. 437-ФЗ of 22 December 2020 ‘On the Sirius Federal Territory’, and the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, under the procedure determined by this Federal Law, other federal laws, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, and laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.

civil79-u3e9307bfdc9e983ff2-1.text: 1. Federal civil service shall be developed in accordance with its principal development directions determined by the President of the Russian Federation and (or) state programmes of the Russian Federation.

civil79-uc895016d67cbedaf85-1.text: 2. The civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be developed in accordance with its principal development directions determined by regulatory legal acts of those constituent entities and (or) their state programmes, taking into account the principal directions for development of federal civil service determined by the President of the Russian Federation.

civil79-u098217edcafba8f439-1.text: 3. Experiments applying new approaches to organizing civil service and supporting civil servants' activities may be conducted in a state body, its autonomous structural subdivision or territorial body, or in several state bodies (hereinafter an experiment).

civil79-u9a8500a698cbee3b57-1.text: 4. For the duration of an experiment, but for no more than one year, the terms of the service contracts of participating civil servants may be changed. Such changes shall be made under the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation and must not reduce a participating civil servant's monetary remuneration below the amount payable at the start of the experiment or demote the civil servant relative to the position held at that time.

civil79-ue926774da391d301ad-1.text: 5. The procedure for organizing and requirements for conducting experiments aimed at developing federal civil service shall be established by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation.

civil79-uf643303fe78904f109-1.text: 6. The procedure for organizing and requirements for conducting experiments aimed at developing the civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be established by regulatory legal acts of those constituent entities.

civil79-u08b1022283e98a1dab-1.text: Chapter 15. STATE SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OVER COMPLIANCE WITH THE LEGISLATION OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION ON THE STATE CIVIL SERVICE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
civil79-u08b1022283e98a1dab-1.locator: Chapter 15. STATE SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OVER COMPLIANCE WITH THE LEGISLATION OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION ON THE STATE CIVIL SERVICE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION

civil79-uc5f58237cb1aca4205-1.text: Article 67. Bodies for state supervision and control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
civil79-uc5f58237cb1aca4205-1.locator: Article 67. Bodies for state supervision and control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u43ef1d9f1a1a3b0d87-1.text: 1. State supervision and extra-departmental control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation shall be exercised by specially authorized state bodies designated by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u43ef1d9f1a1a3b0d87-1.locator: Article 67. Bodies for state supervision and control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-uf34c634ab1586ae071-1.text: 2. Federal state bodies and state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall exercise intra-departmental control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation in subordinate state bodies.
civil79-uf34c634ab1586ae071-1.locator: Article 67. Bodies for state supervision and control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-ue116b03c806bbf5421-1.text: 3. The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation and subordinate prosecutors shall exercise state supervision over precise and uniform compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation, in accordance with federal law.
civil79-ue116b03c806bbf5421-1.locator: Article 67. Bodies for state supervision and control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-ud980693558ee9a5aa1-1.text: Article 68. Liability for breach of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
civil79-ud980693558ee9a5aa1-1.locator: Article 68. Liability for breach of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u7351461a4e66c92bea-1.text: Persons responsible for breaching the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation shall be held liable under the procedure established by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
civil79-u7351461a4e66c92bea-1.locator: Article 68. Liability for breach of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation

civil79-u56060de339cecd62bc-1.text: Chapter 16. CONSIDERATION OF INDIVIDUAL SERVICE DISPUTES
civil79-u56060de339cecd62bc-1.locator: Chapter 16. CONSIDERATION OF INDIVIDUAL SERVICE DISPUTES

civil79-u0758da4e7bda769ddf-1.text: An individual service dispute means unresolved disagreements between the employer's representative and a civil servant, or a citizen entering or formerly in civil service, concerning the application of laws, other regulatory legal acts on civil service or the service contract, which have been submitted to a body for consideration of individual service disputes.

civil79-ue08151a79f51d9ec8e-1.text: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
civil79-ue08151a79f51d9ec8e-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u2c0af045840713c878-1.text: 1. Individual service disputes (hereinafter service disputes) shall be considered by the following bodies for consideration of individual service disputes (hereinafter service dispute bodies):
civil79-u2c0af045840713c878-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u2913ac7fbc8cefd28b-1.text: 1) the state body's service disputes commission;
civil79-u2913ac7fbc8cefd28b-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u162ce6df56b94beb2c-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u6b2e0927e21b99896b-1.text: 2. The procedure for considering service disputes in service dispute bodies shall be governed by this Federal Law and other federal laws; the procedure for hearing service dispute cases in courts shall also be determined by the civil procedural legislation of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u6b2e0927e21b99896b-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-ub6bb4828ea71d7f5d5-1.text: 3. The state body's service disputes commission (hereinafter the service disputes commission) shall be established by decision of the employer's representative and consist of equal numbers of representatives appointed by the employer's representative and representatives of civil servants elected at a meeting (conference) of the state body's civil servants, including a representative (representatives) of the elected trade union body (bodies) of that state body.
civil79-ub6bb4828ea71d7f5d5-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-udeb9c41680238477f0-1.text: 4. A meeting (conference) of the state body's civil servants shall be held by decision of the employer's representative, including in response to a request from civil servants or the state body's elected trade union body.
civil79-udeb9c41680238477f0-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-uac8ad2208d0f0ec84c-1.text: 4.1. A meeting of the state body's civil servants shall have a quorum if more than half of the state body's civil servants are present.
civil79-uac8ad2208d0f0ec84c-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-ufcc794d5616dd9927b-1.text: 4.2. A conference of the state body's civil servants shall have a quorum if at least two thirds of the civil servants elected as delegates from the state body's subdivisions at their respective meetings, including in its territorial bodies, are present.
civil79-ufcc794d5616dd9927b-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-uab65f39c7f24baa4cb-1.text: 4.3. A decision of the state body's civil servants' meeting (conference) shall be adopted by a majority of the votes of the civil servants (delegates) present.
civil79-uab65f39c7f24baa4cb-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u9113f7d784a67daa61-1.text: 4.4. The employer's representative shall create the necessary organizational conditions for holding the state body's civil servants' meeting (conference).
civil79-u9113f7d784a67daa61-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u0af8d43f4bbcc6a290-1.text: 5. The service disputes commission shall have its own seal. Organizational and technical support for its activities shall be provided by the state body.
civil79-u0af8d43f4bbcc6a290-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-ucef3e380a7105a5239-1.text: 6. The service disputes commission shall elect a chairperson and secretary from among its members.
civil79-ucef3e380a7105a5239-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-ub6d0592fecd78b2003-1.text: 7. A service dispute shall be considered by the service disputes commission if the civil servant, acting independently or with a representative, has not resolved the disagreements through direct negotiations with the employer's representative.
civil79-ub6d0592fecd78b2003-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u5928cd221927632a78-1.text: 8. A civil servant, or a citizen entering or formerly in civil service, may apply to the service disputes commission within three months from the day on which they learned or should have learned that their right had been violated.
civil79-u5928cd221927632a78-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-uc3c2b8d545392da547-1.text: 9. If the time limit established by part 8 of this Article has been missed for valid reasons, the service disputes commission may restore it and consider the merits of the dispute. A written application received by the commission from a civil servant, or a citizen entering or formerly in civil service, must be registered by the commission on the day it is submitted.
civil79-uc3c2b8d545392da547-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-ue47e57756bb50d4cbd-1.text: 10. The service disputes commission must consider a service dispute within ten calendar days from submission of the written application by a civil servant, or a citizen entering or formerly in civil service.
civil79-ue47e57756bb50d4cbd-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u9976f26d2619121337-1.text: 11. A meeting of the service disputes commission shall have a quorum if at least half of its members representing the employer's representative and at least half of its members representing civil servants are present. If one or more representatives of the state body's elected trade union body (bodies) have been elected to the commission, the commission may not meet without their participation.
civil79-u9976f26d2619121337-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u6378b24322acc60526-1.text: 11.1. If a conflict of interest arises or may arise during consideration of a service dispute, a commission member with a direct or indirect personal interest in the decision must declare it before the commission meeting begins or during consideration of the dispute. That member shall then take no further part in considering or deciding the dispute.
civil79-u6378b24322acc60526-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-ufb94aa9c6c9ab78bf0-1.text: 11.2. A member of the service disputes commission who is directly subordinate to or under the control of the civil servant concerned in the dispute, or who is closely related to that civil servant by blood or marriage (parents, spouses, children, brothers, sisters, and the spouse's brothers, sisters, parents and children, and children's spouses), shall not participate in the commission meeting or in deciding that service dispute.
civil79-ufb94aa9c6c9ab78bf0-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u92ec4399655e8eab15-1.text: 11.3. A service dispute shall be considered in the presence of the civil servant, or citizen entering or formerly in civil service, who submitted a written application to the service disputes commission, or a representative authorized by that civil servant or citizen (hereinafter in this Article an authorized representative). Consideration in the absence of that civil servant or citizen or the authorized representative shall be permitted only upon the civil servant's or citizen's written request.
civil79-u92ec4399655e8eab15-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-udf1c88d4a29e0b5606-1.text: 11.4. If the civil servant, citizen entering or formerly in civil service, or authorized representative fails to attend the service disputes commission meeting for a valid reason, consideration of the dispute shall be postponed. If the civil servant, citizen or authorized representative fails to attend a second time, the commission may decide to remove the dispute from consideration; this shall not deprive the civil servant or citizen of the right to apply for consideration again within the time limit established by part 8 of this Article.
civil79-udf1c88d4a29e0b5606-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u99971e02eeed0f33a7-1.text: 11.5. If the service disputes commission has not considered a service dispute within ten days, the civil servant, or citizen entering or formerly in civil service, may transfer consideration of the dispute to a court.
civil79-u99971e02eeed0f33a7-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-uaf54250401771d0586-1.text: 11.6. The service disputes commission may summon witnesses to its meeting, invite specialists and request information and materials necessary to consider the service dispute, which shall be supplied to the commission within the time limit it sets.
civil79-uaf54250401771d0586-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u82a9f8140d8570bde6-1.text: 11.7. The service disputes commission shall decide by secret ballot by a simple majority of the votes of members present. A copy of the decision, signed by the commission's chairperson or deputy chairperson and certified with its seal, shall be delivered to the employer's representative and to the civil servant, citizen entering or formerly in civil service, or authorized representative within three days from the decision.
civil79-u82a9f8140d8570bde6-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u8af666728cf06fc04c-1.text: 12. Either party may appeal against the service disputes commission's decision to a court within ten days after receiving a copy. If this time limit has been missed for valid reasons, the court may restore it and consider the merits of the service dispute.
civil79-u8af666728cf06fc04c-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u0171518f4355f42c5e-1.text: 13. Courts shall consider service disputes on written applications from a civil servant, a citizen entering or formerly in civil service, the employer's representative or a representative of the state body's elected trade union body, if at least one of them disagrees with the service disputes commission's decision or if the civil servant or employer's representative applies directly to the court without applying to the commission; courts shall also consider applications from a prosecutor if the commission's decision does not comply with federal laws or other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u0171518f4355f42c5e-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u432d8c87dbb9cf2576-1.text: 14. Courts shall directly consider service disputes on written applications from:
civil79-u432d8c87dbb9cf2576-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u8b0e2972e4473d4ede-1.text: 1) a civil servant or a citizen formerly in civil service, concerning reinstatement in the civil service position previously held, irrespective of the grounds for termination or cancellation of the service contract, release from the civil service position or dismissal from civil service; a change to the date of release from the position or wording of the reason for release; transfer to another civil service position without consent; pay for a period of enforced absence or payment of the difference in monetary remuneration for the period of performing duties in a lower-paid civil service position; or unlawful actions (inaction) of the employer's representative or persons authorized by them in processing and protecting the civil servant's personal data;
civil79-u8b0e2972e4473d4ede-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u897ac2e8391cce1441-1.text: 2) the employer's representative, concerning compensation by the civil servant for damage caused to the state body, unless otherwise provided for by federal laws.
civil79-u897ac2e8391cce1441-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-ud995c55482979fddfe-1.text: 15. Courts shall also directly consider service disputes:
civil79-ud995c55482979fddfe-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-ubbcf90e9366b7650a5-1.text: 1) concerning unlawful refusal of entry into civil service;
civil79-ubbcf90e9366b7650a5-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u70089330d09679c4fc-1.text: 2) on written applications from civil servants who consider that they have suffered discrimination.
civil79-u70089330d09679c4fc-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u05cb3f338162e67117-1.text: 16. Where release from a civil service position and dismissal from civil service are based on grounds not provided for by this Federal Law or breach the established procedure, or where transfer to another civil service position is unlawful, the court may, upon the civil servant's written application, order monetary compensation for the non-pecuniary harm caused to them. The amount shall be determined by the court.
civil79-u05cb3f338162e67117-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-u5297143d9a50bc4ff8-1.text: 17. Time limits for applying to a court for consideration of a service dispute and the procedure for exempting civil servants from court costs; the procedure for deciding service disputes concerning release from a civil service position and dismissal from civil service or transfer to another civil service position without consent; the procedure for satisfying civil servants' monetary claims and enforcing decisions on reinstatement in a previously held civil service position; and restrictions on recovery of sums paid under decisions of service dispute bodies shall be determined under the procedure established by labour legislation for consideration and resolution of individual labour disputes.
civil79-u5297143d9a50bc4ff8-1.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes

civil79-uf6c198a0f99bd63453-1.text: Chapter 17. ENTRY INTO FORCE OF THIS FEDERAL LAW
civil79-uf6c198a0f99bd63453-1.locator: Chapter 17. ENTRY INTO FORCE OF THIS FEDERAL LAW

civil79-u47cf0da24705ad57ab-1.text: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
civil79-u47cf0da24705ad57ab-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-udbc4c18fbf72d64173-1.text: 1. This Federal Law shall enter into force six months after the day of its official publication, except for Articles 50, 51 and 55 of this Federal Law.
civil79-udbc4c18fbf72d64173-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-u0134786a4d86a50fa0-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-u464c33d1d3a42642d7-1.text: 3. The provisions of Articles 50, 51 and 55 of this Federal Law shall enter into force for federal civil servants simultaneously with the entry into force of the Decree of the President of the Russian Federation on federal civil servants' monetary remuneration.
civil79-u464c33d1d3a42642d7-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-ud87ba5edcf2358a9a4-1.text: 4. The procedure for entry into force of Articles 50, 51 and 55 of this Federal Law for civil servants of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be determined by laws and other regulatory legal acts of those constituent entities, taking into account the provisions of this Article.
civil79-ud87ba5edcf2358a9a4-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-uf9783a066a760a4f97-1.text: 5. The conditions for payment of monetary remuneration or monetary emoluments to state servants recognized as civil servants under this Federal Law, as established on the date this Federal Law enters into force, including the amounts of monetary emoluments, position salaries and established supplements and the conditions and procedure for their payment, shall apply until regulatory legal acts establishing civil servants' monetary remuneration in accordance with this Federal Law enter into force.
civil79-uf9783a066a760a4f97-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-udd988fe3cc765c1450-1.text: 6. Until the relevant state service management body is established, its tasks and functions shall be performed by state bodies in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and the legislation of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
civil79-udd988fe3cc765c1450-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-uecebff02ce1d548175-1.text: 7. Monetary remuneration established for civil servants in accordance with this Federal Law may not be lower than the monetary remuneration established for state servants on the date this Federal Law enters into force.
civil79-uecebff02ce1d548175-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-ua393bb1a64b285da2f-1.text: 8. Qualification grades previously conferred on federal state servants shall be deemed to be the corresponding civil service class ranks provided for in Article 11 of this Federal Law.
civil79-ua393bb1a64b285da2f-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-u8a55181ef5538eb6ed-1.text: 9. Periods of work (service) previously included (credited) under the established procedure in length of civil service shall count towards that length for granting monthly supplements to the position salary for length of civil service, additional annual paid leave for length of service and incentives for civil service in accordance with this Federal Law and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
civil79-u8a55181ef5538eb6ed-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-u39048fc83117fc8cc7-1.text: 10. The conditions of medical and sanatorium-resort services for state servants recognized as civil servants under this Federal Law and their family members, including after the state servants retire on a length-of-service pension, shall be retained until the federal law on medical insurance for state servants of the Russian Federation enters into force.
civil79-u39048fc83117fc8cc7-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law

civil79-u2aad89a351962b703c-1.text: 11. Length-of-service pension provision for federal state servants shall be retained until the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families enters into force.
civil79-u2aad89a351962b703c-1.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
